plugin_asdk_app_69a8f78087e081919e52caca.productIntro: Flaim 将 ChatGPT 连接到用户的 ESPN、Yahoo 和 Sleeper Fantasy 联赛，以便 ChatGPT 可以使用用户的实际联赛背景来回答有关当前联赛、排名、名单、对决、选秀和选秀权所有权、可用球员、球员搜索、最近联赛转会、联赛信息和过去赛季的问题。它的 11 个工具中有 10 个是只读的。第十一个，refresh_leagues，是一个有界写入，通过用户的连接帐户重新发现联赛，并仅更新 Flaim 自己的连接联赛注册表。
plugin_asdk_app_69a8f78087e081919e52caca.productIntroEn: Flaim connects ChatGPT to a user's ESPN, Yahoo, and Sleeper fantasy leagues so ChatGPT can answer questions about current leagues, standings, rosters, matchups, drafts and draft-pick ownership, available players, player search, recent league moves, league info, and past seasons using the user's actual league context. Ten of its eleven tools are read-only.
plugin_asdk_app_69a8f78087e081919e52caca.longDescription: Flaim connects ChatGPT to a user's ESPN, Yahoo, and Sleeper fantasy leagues so ChatGPT can answer questions about current leagues, standings, rosters, matchups, drafts and draft-pick ownership, available players, player search, recent league moves, league info, and past seasons using the user's actual league context. Ten of its eleven tools are read-only. The eleventh, refresh_leagues, is a bounded write that re-discovers leagues through the user's connected accounts and updates only Flaim's own connected-league registry. Flaim never makes trades, adds or drops players, edits lineups, or modifies league data on ESPN, Yahoo, or Sleeper. This application uses fantasy data provided by Yahoo Fantasy.
plugin_asdk_app_69a8f78087e081919e52caca.longDescriptionZh: Flaim 将 ChatGPT 连接到用户的 ESPN、Yahoo 和 Sleeper Fantasy 联赛，以便 ChatGPT 可以使用用户的实际联赛背景来回答有关当前联赛、排名、名单、对决、选秀和选秀权所有权、可用球员、球员搜索、最近联赛转会、联赛信息和过去赛季的问题。它的 11 个工具中有 10 个是只读的。第十一个，refresh_leagues，是一个有界写入，通过用户的连接帐户重新发现联赛，并仅更新 Flaim 自己的连接联赛注册表。 Flaim 从不进行交易、添加或删除球员、编辑阵容或修改 ESPN、雅虎或 Sleeper 上的联盟数据。该应用程序使用雅虎幻想提供的幻想数据。
defaultPrompts: What fantasy leagues do I have?
defaultPromptsZh: 我有哪些梦幻联赛？

plugin_connector_690aabb71bf481918b8d5b6.longDescription:
The monday.com AI Connector brings core platform capabilities directly to agents and AI assistants. It supports searching boards, creating and updating items and columns, assigning owners, setting timelines, and posting updates — enabling a wide range of work management and CRM use cases across teams and departments.

Teams of people and agents use monday.com as a task tracker and project tracking hub: planning campaigns and events, tracking milestones, dependencies, and workload, managing approval workflows and request intake, and sharing status updates across projects and portfolios — as well as a CRM for managing leads, contacts, and deals.

Beyond day-to-day work management, the connector lets agents answer questions using monday.com's official knowledge base, plan and build automations and multi-step workflows, run and save reusable code actions, and configure other monday.com agents .
plugin_connector_690aabb71bf481918b8d5b6.longDescriptionZh:
monday.com AI Connector 直接为客服人员和 AI 助理带来核心平台功能。它支持搜索面板、创建和更新项目和栏、分配所有者、设置时间表和发布更新，从而实现跨团队和部门的广泛工作管理和 CRM 使用案例。

人员和代理团队使用 monday.com 作为任务跟踪器和项目跟踪中心：规划营销活动和事件，跟踪里程碑、依赖关系和工作量，管理审批工作流程和请求接收，以及跨项目和项目组合共享状态更新，以及用于管理潜在客户、联系人和交易的 CRM。

除了日常工作管理之外，该连接器还允许代理使用 monday.com 的官方知识库回答问题、规划和构建自动化以及多步骤工作流程、运行和保存可重用的代码操作以及配置其他 monday.com 代理。
plugin_connector_690aabb71bf481918b8d5b6.productIntro: monday.com 是用于项目、任务、流程和 CRM 的可配置工作管理平台；在 Codex 中适合查询项目进展、整理负责人和推动跨团队协作。
plugin_connector_690aabb71bf481918b8d5b6.productIntroEn: monday.com is a configurable work-management platform for projects, tasks, workflows, and CRM; in Codex it is useful for checking progress, organizing owners, and coordinating across teams.

plugin_asdk_app_697761cab6f48191b5ed3459.longDescription:
Granola MCP connects your meeting history to Codex so your assistant can pull real context from past conversations while you work.

Use MCP when you're already working on something bigger:

-   Writing PRDs or proposals: Pull customer feedback, stakeholder input, and decisions from relevant meetings directly into your draft
    
-   Building presentations or reports: Combine insights from multiple conversations with your other research and data
    
-   Coding with context: Give your AI the project background, requirements, and technical decisions discussed in planning meetings
    
-   Strategic analysis: Merge meeting insights with documents, data, and other sources for comprehensive analysis
    
How it works:

Your AI assistant can search your Granola meetings by topic, person, company, or timeframe - then cite specific conversations in its responses. No more switching tabs to find "what the customer said" or "when we decided that."

The difference:

Instead of copy-pasting meeting notes into prompts, your AI pulls exactly what it needs from your meeting history automatically. You stay focused on the work, not the research or context.
plugin_asdk_app_697761cab6f48191b5ed3459.longDescriptionZh:
Granola MCP 将您的会议历史记录连接到 Codex，以便您的助手可以在您工作时从过去的对话中提取真实的背景信息。

当您已经在做更大的事情时使用 MCP：

- 编写 PRD 或提案：将客户反馈、利益相关者的意见和相关会议的决定直接提取到草稿中
    
- 构建演示文稿或报告：将多次对话的见解与其他研究和数据相结合
    
- 结合上下文进行编码：为您的 AI 提供规划会议中讨论的项目背景、要求和技术决策
    
- 战略分析：将会议见解与文档、数据和其他来源合并以进行全面分析
    
工作原理：

您的人工智能助手可以按主题、人员、公司或时间范围搜索您的格兰诺拉麦片会议 - 然后在其响应中引用特定对话。不再需要切换标签来查找“客户所说的”或“我们何时决定的”。

区别：

您的人工智能无需将会议记录复制粘贴到提示中，而是自动从会议历史记录中准确提取所需内容。您专注于工作，而不是研究或背景。

plugin_asdk_app_6943b73823548191a9f9216c.longDescription:
Trusted by over 47 million people, Todoist simplifies tasks for individuals and teams. Instantly declutter your mind, boost productivity and use it as a habit tracker.

With a simple tap, add your tasks and remind yourself about them, enjoy multiple views like calendar, list and boards, filter tasks by work and/or personal life, collaborate on projects, and achieve peace of mind.

Why choose Todoist?
Todoist is a simple yet powerful planner tool that organizes both your life and work.

• Create a habit of adding tasks like “Plan next week’s work every Friday afternoon” or “Do homework every Wednesday at 6pm” using Todoist’s powerful language recognition and recurring dates.
• View any project as a list, as boards or as a calendar planner to give you ultimate flexibility when planning both your tasks and your time.
• Available on any device – with apps, extensions, and widgets – Todoist is everywhere you need it to be.
• Link Todoist with your calendar, voice assistant, and 100+ other tools such as Outlook, Gmail, and Slack.
• Collaborate on projects of all sizes by assigning tasks to others. Keep everything at hand by adding deadlines, notes, and files.
• Use one-tap templates to tackle everything from meeting agendas and accounting tasks, to packing lists and wedding planning.
• Instantly see what’s most important by setting visual task priority levels.
• Get to know your routine better with insights into your personalized productivity streaks.

Todoist on Apple iOS
• Todoist is beautifully designed, simple to get started, and intuitive to use.
• Stay organized from your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, while also syncing across desktop and all other devices.
• With natural language, write tasks like "tomorrow at 4pm" or “every other wednesday starting in two weeks” and Todoist will instantly parse it all out for you.
• Location-based reminders available on upgrade. Never forget an errand again.
• All the power from iOS: Siri, Today widget, share extension, handoff, and quick actions.

Questions? Feedback? Visit todoist.com/help

Recommended by: 
> The Verge: “Simple, straightforward, and super powerful”
> Wirecutter: “It’s simply a joy to use”
> PC Mag: “The best to-do list app on the market”
> TechRadar: “Nothing short of stellar”
plugin_asdk_app_6943b73823548191a9f9216c.longDescriptionZh:
Todoist 受到超过 4700 万人的信赖，它简化了个人和团队的任务。立即整理您的思绪，提高工作效率，并将其用作习惯追踪器。

只需轻轻一按，即可添加任务并提醒自己，享受日历、列表和看板等多种视图，按工作和/或个人生活筛选任务，协作开展项目，并让自己高枕无忧。

为什么选择Todoist？
Todoist 是一款简单但功能强大的规划工具，可以组织您的生活和工作。

• 养成使用Todoist强大的语言识别和重复日期添加任务的习惯，例如“每周五下午计划下周的工作”或“每周三下午6点做作业”。
• 以列表、看板或日历规划器的形式查看任何项目，让您在规划任务和时间时具有最大的灵活性。
• 可在任何设备上使用——通过应用程序、扩展程序和小部件——Todoist 无处不在。
• 将Todoist 与您的日历、语音助手和100 多种其他工具（例如Outlook、Gmail 和Slack）链接。
• 通过向其他人分配任务来协作处理各种规模的项目。通过添加截止日期、注释和文件，让一切触手可及。
• 使用一键式模板来处理从会议议程和会计任务到装箱单和婚礼策划的所有事务。
• 通过设置视觉任务优先级，立即查看最重要的事情。
• 通过深入了解您的个性化生产力趋势，更好地了解您的日常工作。

Apple iOS 上的 Todoist
• Todoist 设计精美、上手简单且使用直观。
• 通过 iPhone、iPad 和 Apple Watch 保持井井有条，同时还可以在桌面和所有其他设备之间同步。
• 使用自然语言编写任务，例如“明天下午 4 点”或“两周后每隔一个星期三”，Todoist 会立即为您解析所有内容。
• 升级时可提供基于位置的提醒。再也不会忘记差事了。
• 来自iOS 的所有功能：Siri、Today 小部件、共享扩展、切换和快速操作。

问题？反馈？访问 todoist.com/help

推荐人： 
> The Verge：“简单、直接、超级强大”
> Wirecutter：“使用起来真是一种乐趣”
> PC Mag：“市场上最好的待办事项列表应用程序”
> TechRadar：“堪称一流”

plugin_asdk_app_6a392799cb58819185f82dc0.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Miro 来总结现有的板、更新它们或从头开始构建新的板。将 ChatGPT 指向看板，它会读取您的团队已经决定、研究和绘制的内容，因此它的答案从您的上下文开始。要求它进行构建，它的答案会以原生 Miro 对象的形式出现在板上——幻灯片、表格、文档、图表、便签、框架和研讨会小部件——默认情况下是可视的、可立即编辑的和协作的。
plugin_asdk_app_6a392799cb58819185f82dc0.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to Miro to summarize existing boards, update them, or build new ones from scratch. Point ChatGPT at a board and it reads what your team has already decided, researched, and drawn, so its answers start from your context.
plugin_asdk_app_6a392799cb58819185f82dc0.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT to Miro to summarize existing boards, update them, or build new ones from scratch. Point ChatGPT at a board and it reads what your team has already decided, researched, and drawn, so its answers start from your context. Ask it to build, and its answers land on the board as native Miro objects – slides, tables, docs, diagrams, sticky notes, frames, and workshop widgets – visual, instantly editable, and collaborative by default.

Key Use Cases:
Product strategy review: ChatGPT generates a strategy presentation as Miro slides, alongside your team's priorities, so the team sees the full picture and comes together to review and collaborate on it. From there, ChatGPT reads the feedback and discussion – the call transcript plus Miro comments and stickies – and writes the update for the wider team.
System design review: Get ChatGPT to create an interactive architecture diagram and documentation for a team of engineers to review and discuss ahead of upcoming changes.
Documentation automation: Set up a scheduled task in ChatGPT to keep your Miro diagrams and documents up to date as things change.
Journey mapping: ChatGPT maps out an existing user journey in Miro for the team to review in a collaborative session. From there, any proposed changes can be picked up by ChatGPT and drafted into follow-up items.

Invoke Miro directly with @Miro, or just describe what you want in plain language. Try prompts like:
- @Miro, summarize the decisions on this board [board URL]
- @Miro, turn this strategy doc into slides alongside our priorities
- @Miro, diagram this service's architecture with the docs beside it
- @Miro, update the journey map on this board with the changes we agreed
- @Miro, turn the comments on this board into action items
- @Miro, build a retro board for my team with dot voting

What Miro can do in ChatGPT:
- Read, search, and summarize context from your Miro boards
- Create boards, and generate full boards for workshops, retros, and planning sessions
- Create slides, diagrams, docs, tables, timelines, sticky notes, and images on the canvas
- Update and edit content already on the canvas, and delete what it created
- Create and update tables, including kanban and timeline views
- Read, reply to, and resolve board comments
- Upload images to a board
- Create, update, and share Miro spaces
plugin_asdk_app_6a392799cb58819185f82dc0.longDescriptionZh:
将 ChatGPT 连接到 Miro 来总结现有的板、更新它们或从头开始构建新的板。将 ChatGPT 指向看板，它会读取您的团队已经决定、研究和绘制的内容，因此它的答案从您的上下文开始。要求它进行构建，它的答案会以原生 Miro 对象的形式出现在板上——幻灯片、表格、文档、图表、便签、框架和研讨会小部件——默认情况下是可视的、可立即编辑的和协作的。

关键用例：
产品策略审查：当 Miro 幻灯片播放时，ChatGPT 会生成策略演示文稿以及团队的优先事项，以便团队可以看到整体情况并聚集在一起进行审查和协作。从那里，ChatGPT 读取反馈和讨论——通话记录加上 Miro 评论和便签——并为更广泛的团队编写更新。
系统设计审查：使用 ChatGPT 创建交互式架构图和文档，供工程师团队在即将发生的更改之前进行审查和讨论。
文档自动化：在 ChatGPT 中设置计划任务，使您的 Miro 图表和文档随着情况的变化而保持最新。
旅程映射：ChatGPT 在 Miro 中绘制现有的用户旅程，供团队在协作会话中查看。从那里，任何提议的更改都可以由 ChatGPT 获取并起草到后续项目中。

直接使用 @Miro 调用 Miro，或者只是用简单的语言描述您想要的内容。尝试如下提示：
- @Miro，总结该委员会的决定 [委员会 URL]
- @Miro，将此战略文档与我们的优先事项一起转化为幻灯片
- @Miro，用旁边的文档绘制该服务的架构图
- @Miro，用我们同意的更改更新此板上的旅程地图
- @Miro，将这个板上的评论变成行动项目
- @Miro，为我的团队构建一个带有点投票的复古板

Miro 在 ChatGPT 中可以做什么：
- 阅读、搜索并总结 Miro 板上的上下文
- 创建看板，并为研讨会、回顾和规划会议生成完整的看板
- 在画布上创建幻灯片、图表、文档、表格、时间线、便签和图像
- 更新和编辑画布上已有的内容，并删除它创建的内容
- 创建和更新表格，包括看板和时间线视图
- 阅读、回复和解决董事会意见
- 将图像上传到板上
- 创建、更新和共享 Miro 空间

plugin_connector_691fa57b709c8191b61c48b.productIntro: Semrush MCP 提供结构化、定量的 SEO 和域名、关键词、反向链接和市场级受众洞察的流量数据。它返回事实数据集，包括域分析、关键字指标、反向链接配置文件、跨时间段和渠道的流量数据、地理和人口统计分布以及竞争或行业级别指标。每当用户请求需要权威数据而不是推理的网站指标、流量统计、关键字数据、竞争对手比较或市场/受众细分时，模型就应该调用此 MCP。当用户的问题需要对特定领域进行数据驱动的评估时，也应该使用它，即使查询被表述为建议或改进指导。
plugin_connector_691fa57b709c8191b61c48b.productIntroEn: The Semrush MCP provides structured, quantitative SEO and traffic data for domains, keywords, backlinks, and market-level audience insights. It returns factual datasets including domain analytics, keyword metrics, backlink profiles, traffic data across time periods and channels, geographic and demographic distributions, and competitive or industry-level indicators.
plugin_connector_691fa57b709c8191b61c48b.longDescription: The Semrush MCP provides structured, quantitative SEO and traffic data for domains, keywords, backlinks, and market-level audience insights. It returns factual datasets including domain analytics, keyword metrics, backlink profiles, traffic data across time periods and channels, geographic and demographic distributions, and competitive or industry-level indicators. The model should invoke this MCP whenever a user requests website metrics, traffic statistics, keyword data, competitor comparisons, or market/audience breakdowns that require authoritative data rather than inference. It should also be used when a user’s question requires data-driven evaluation of a specific domain, even if the query is phrased as advice or improvement guidance.

plugin_asdk_app_69a82336989c8191b4635a75.description: 将会议上下文添加到聊天中
plugin_asdk_app_69a82336989c8191b4635a75.productIntro: Krisp AI 会议助手 MCP 使您的 AI 助手可以安全地访问您的会议历史记录，包括记录、摘要、行动项目和即将召开的会议。它使您的人工智能能够与您的实际对话中的真实上下文一起工作。
plugin_asdk_app_69a82336989c8191b4635a75.productIntroEn: Krisp AI Meeting Assistant MCP gives your AI assistant secure access to your meeting history, including transcripts, summaries, action items, and upcoming meetings. It enables your AI to work with real context from your actual conversations.
plugin_asdk_app_69a82336989c8191b4635a75.longDescription:
Krisp AI Meeting Assistant MCP gives your AI assistant secure access to your meeting history, including transcripts, summaries, action items, and upcoming meetings. It enables your AI to work with real context from your actual conversations.

Put your meetings to work:
Draft documents and proposals using decisions, feedback, and stakeholder input from past meetings. Prepare for upcoming meetings with quick briefs on previous discussions, pending items, and attendees. Track follow ups by surfacing open action items across all meetings, filtered by assignee, status, or date. Search for specific moments by topic, attendee, keyword, or date range. Build presentations and reports by combining insights from multiple conversations in one place.
How it works:
Your AI assistant searches and retrieves information from your Krisp meetings in real time. Ask in plain language, such as “What did we decide about pricing last week?” or “Show my open action items,” and get answers grounded in what was actually discussed. Full transcripts are available whenever you need deeper context.
Why it’s different:
Krisp captures complete meeting transcripts with noise cancelled audio clarity, so your AI works from accurate and comprehensive records. Instead of static notes, your meetings become a structured, searchable knowledge base your AI assistant can use whenever you need it.
plugin_asdk_app_69a82336989c8191b4635a75.longDescriptionZh:
Krisp AI 会议助手 MCP 使您的 AI 助手可以安全地访问您的会议历史记录，包括记录、摘要、行动项目和即将召开的会议。它使您的人工智能能够与您的实际对话中的真实上下文一起工作。

让您的会议发挥作用：
使用过去会议的决策、反馈和利益相关者的意见起草文件和提案。通过有关先前讨论、待决项目和与会者的快速简介，为即将召开的会议做好准备。通过在所有会议中显示未完成的行动项目（按受托人、状态或日期进行筛选）来跟踪后续行动。按主题、与会者、关键字或日期范围搜索特定时刻。通过将多个对话的见解结合在一处来构建演示文稿和报告。
工作原理：
您的 AI 助手实时搜索并检索 Krisp 会议中的信息。用简单的语言提问，例如“上周我们对定价做了什么决定？”或“显示我未完成的行动项目”，并根据实际讨论的内容获得答案。当您需要更深入的背景信息时，可以获取完整的文字记录。
为什么不同：
Krisp 以消除噪音的音频清晰度捕获完整的会议记录，因此您的 AI 可以根据准确而全面的记录进行工作。您的会议不再是静态笔记，而是成为一个结构化、可搜索的知识库，您的人工智能助手可以在您需要时使用。

plugin_asdk_app_6944c9ea44b081919da6f28d.productIntro: AccurateScribe 是一款人工智能驱动的语音转文本和转录应用程序，专为现代工作流程而构建。它采用先进的 Whisper 技术，可提供快速、准确的 Whisper 转录，并将音频和视频安全地转换为可读、可编辑的文本。
plugin_asdk_app_6944c9ea44b081919da6f28d.productIntroEn: AccurateScribe is an AI-powered speech-to-text and transcription app built for modern workflows. Powered by advanced Whisper technology, it delivers fast, accurate Whisper transcription and securely converts audio and video into readable, editable text.
plugin_asdk_app_6944c9ea44b081919da6f28d.longDescription:
AccurateScribe is an AI-powered speech-to-text and transcription app built for modern workflows. Powered by advanced Whisper technology, it delivers fast, accurate Whisper transcription and securely converts audio and video into readable, editable text.

Transcribe meetings, podcasts, interviews, lectures, and other recordings—including recorded Zoom meetings—in minutes. Easily create meeting transcripts and automatic notes, repurpose podcast transcripts into new content, and generate subtitles and captions.

Key features:

Whisper-powered AI transcription for audio and video files

Fast speech-to-text processing

Up to 99.8% accuracy for clear audio

Meeting transcription and automatic notes

Podcast transcription and content repurposing

Subtitle and caption generation

Searchable and shareable transcripts

Easy editing, translation, and export

Support for more than 134 transcription languages

Automatic speaker identification and timestamps

Translate transcripts and subtitles into nearly 250 languages

Large-file and batch processing

Export to DOCX, PDF, TXT, SRT, and VTT

Secure, encrypted file handling

Ideal for remote teams, businesses, content creators, journalists, students, researchers, and professionals who need reliable Whisper transcription for meetings, documentation, collaboration, subtitle creation, and content repurposing.
plugin_asdk_app_6944c9ea44b081919da6f28d.longDescriptionZh:

plugin_asdk_app_69af36d580288191a1bfe1e3.productIntro: Read AI 是一款适用于 Zoom、Google Meet 和 Microsoft Teams 的人工智能会议记录员和会议助手。记录会议并获取 AI 会议记录、摘要、文字记录、行动项目、关键问题和决策。
plugin_asdk_app_69af36d580288191a1bfe1e3.productIntroEn: Read AI is an AI meeting notetaker and meeting assistant for Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. Record meetings and get AI meeting notes, summaries, transcripts, action items, key questions, and decisions.
plugin_asdk_app_69af36d580288191a1bfe1e3.longDescription:
Read AI is an AI meeting notetaker and meeting assistant for Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. Record meetings and get AI meeting notes, summaries, transcripts, action items, key questions, and decisions.

Search your meeting history in ChatGPT, catch up on meetings you missed, prepare for upcoming calls, find past conversations, and turn meeting insights into follow-ups and next steps.

With the Read AI app, you can:
• Search and list your recent meetings, filtered by date or topic
• Pull full meeting summaries, transcripts, key questions, and action items into any OpenAI conversation
• Send a Read AI meeting agent to join a live meeting on your behalf to take notes
• Share meeting reports with teammates by email
plugin_asdk_app_69af36d580288191a1bfe1e3.longDescriptionZh:
Read AI 是一款适用于 Zoom、Google Meet 和 Microsoft Teams 的人工智能会议记录员和会议助手。记录会议并获取 AI 会议记录、摘要、文字记录、行动项目、关键问题和决策。

在 ChatGPT 中搜索您的会议历史记录，补上您错过的会议，为即将到来的通话做好准备，查找过去的对话，并将会议见解转化为后续行动和后续步骤。

使用 Read AI 应用程序，您可以：
• 搜索并列出您最近的会议，按日期或主题过滤
• 将完整的会议摘要、记录、关键问题和行动项目提取到任何 OpenAI 对话中
• 派 Read AI 会议代理代表您加入实时会议并做笔记
• 通过电子邮件与团队成员共享会议报告

plugin_asdk_app_6a83901dde988191b3f3cefd.productIntro: Atlassian Rovo MCP 服务器将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到您的 Atlassian 工作区，因此您可以直接通过对话使用 Jira、Confluence、Bitbucket、Loom 等。 查找并总结 Jira 问题、创建和更新票证、转换状态以及添加评论，而无需切换选项卡。搜索、阅读、起草和编辑具有完整上下文的 Confluence 页面。 服务器支持读取和写入操作，让您可以实时检索信息并采取操作。
plugin_asdk_app_6a83901dde988191b3f3cefd.productIntroEn: The Atlassian Rovo MCP Server connects ChatGPT and Codex to your Atlassian workspace, so you can work with Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Loom, and more directly from your conversation. Find and summarize Jira issues, create and update tickets, transition statuses, and add comments without switching tabs. Search, read, draft, and edit Confluence pages with full context.
plugin_asdk_app_6a83901dde988191b3f3cefd.longDescription:
The Atlassian Rovo MCP Server connects ChatGPT and Codex to your Atlassian workspace, so you can work with Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Loom, and more directly from your conversation.
Find and summarize Jira issues, create and update tickets, transition statuses, and add comments without switching tabs. Search, read, draft, and edit Confluence pages with full context.
Supporting both read and write actions, the server lets you retrieve information and take action in real time. Dedicated UI components for Jira and Confluence bring issue details, page content, and updates right into ChatGPT, so you can review and act without leaving the conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a83901dde988191b3f3cefd.longDescriptionZh:

服务器支持读取和写入操作，让您可以实时检索信息并采取操作。 Jira 和 Confluence 的专用 UI​​ 组件将问题详细信息、页面内容和更新直接引入 ChatGPT，因此您无需离开对话即可查看并采取行动。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3265ca9104819181dd46e6.productIntro: Flourish 应用程序将 ChatGPT 变成真正 Flourish 项目的图表制作助手。为其提供数据并描述您想要强调的见解或您想要讲述的故事。它会选择合适的模板，准备数据，在您的 Flourish 帐户中创建可视化效果，并为您提供编辑链接。您可以掌控 Flourish 中的最终润色和发布。没有屏幕截图或一次性代码。只是交互式、可编辑的图表，其中包含您的计划包含的访问、协作、品牌和发布功能。

It chooses a suitable template, prepares the data, creates the visualization in your Flourish account, and gives you an edit link. You stay in control of the final polish and publishing in Flourish.

plugin_asdk_app_69b9670d4e9881919c1a3f1d.name: Enhancv
plugin_asdk_app_69b9670d4e9881919c1a3f1d.productIntro: Enhancv 将您的简历格式化为专业的 PDF — 无需离开 ChatGPT。
plugin_asdk_app_69b9670d4e9881919c1a3f1d.productIntroEn: Enhancv formats your resume into a professional PDF — without leaving ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_69b9670d4e9881919c1a3f1d.longDescription:
Enhancv formats your resume into a professional PDF — without leaving ChatGPT.

When updating your resume with ChatGPT for your target role or industry, you can use Enhancv to apply a layout built for ATS systems and recruiter readability. It adapts to your preferences: choose from modern, classic, or minimal styles; single or two-column layouts; color schemes from monochrome to bold — or let it infer what fits your experience level and field.

The result is a clean, downloadable PDF resume ready to send to employers.

Enhancv handles formatting only. It won't rewrite your content, critique your bullet points, or tailor your resume to a job description — just take what you have and make it look like it belongs in front of a hiring manager.
plugin_asdk_app_69b9670d4e9881919c1a3f1d.longDescriptionZh:
Enhancv 将您的简历格式化为专业的 PDF — 无需离开 ChatGPT。

使用 ChatGPT 针对您的目标职位或行业更新简历时，您可以使用 Enhancv 应用为 ATS 系统和招聘人员可读性构建的布局。它适应您的喜好：选择现代、经典或简约风格；单列或两列布局；从单色到粗体的配色方案 - 或者让它推断出适合您的经验水平和领域的配色方案。

结果是一份干净的、可下载的 PDF 简历，可以发送给雇主。

Enhancv 仅处理格式化。它不会重写你的内容，批评你的要点，或者根据职位描述定制你的简历——只是把你所拥有的东西让它看起来像是属于招聘经理面前的。
defaultPrompts: make my resume into an ATS-ready PDF!
can you update my old doc resume design?
defaultPromptsZh: 将我的简历制作成 ATS 就绪的 PDF！
你能更新我的旧文档简历设计吗？

plugin_asdk_app_6a718a8815ec8191bdf4853e.name: MindMap AI
plugin_asdk_app_6a718a8815ec8191bdf4853e.productIntro: MindMap AI 可让您在 ChatGPT 内创建、搜索、查看、编辑、设计样式和导出思维导图，并在工作时在聊天中查看它们的呈现。根据主题、头脑风暴或您共享的任何内容创建导图：PDF、文档、图像、粘贴的文本或 ChatGPT 可以读取的网页。然后通过聊天不断完善它：扩展分支，添加关系箭头来构建概念图，用摘要括号对想法进行分组，并重新组织结构。在思维导图、逻辑图和组织结构图布局之间切换、应用主题并在完成后导出。
plugin_asdk_app_6a718a8815ec8191bdf4853e.productIntroEn: MindMap AI lets you create, search, view, edit, style, and export mind maps right inside ChatGPT, and see them rendered in the chat as you work. Create a map from a topic, a brainstorm, or anything you share: PDFs, documents, images, pasted text, or web pages ChatGPT can read.
plugin_asdk_app_6a718a8815ec8191bdf4853e.longDescription: MindMap AI lets you create, search, view, edit, style, and export mind maps right inside ChatGPT, and see them rendered in the chat as you work. Create a map from a topic, a brainstorm, or anything you share: PDFs, documents, images, pasted text, or web pages ChatGPT can read. Then keep refining it through chat: expand branches, add relationship arrows to build concept maps, group ideas with summary brackets, and reorganize the structure. Switch between mind map, logic chart, and org chart layouts, apply themes, and export when you're done. Great for brainstorming, studying, planning, and visualizing ideas as a clear outline. Your maps are saved to your MindMap AI account, where you can keep mind mapping on the canvas with full styling control. Works with a free account, and manual editing is always free.
plugin_asdk_app_6a718a8815ec8191bdf4853e.longDescriptionZh: MindMap AI 可让您在 ChatGPT 内创建、搜索、查看、编辑、设计样式和导出思维导图，并在工作时在聊天中查看它们的呈现。根据主题、头脑风暴或您共享的任何内容创建导图：PDF、文档、图像、粘贴的文本或 ChatGPT 可以读取的网页。然后通过聊天不断完善它：扩展分支，添加关系箭头来构建概念图，用摘要括号对想法进行分组，并重新组织结构。在思维导图、逻辑图和组织结构图布局之间切换、应用主题并在完成后导出。非常适合集思广益、研究、规划和将想法可视化为清晰的轮廓。您的思维导图将保存到您的 MindMap AI 帐户，您可以在画布上保存思维导图，并具有完全的样式控制。使用免费帐户，手动编辑始终免费。

plugin_asdk_app_69e22b4f3c4c8191839afb9f.longDescription:
Resume.io helps you create standout, ATS-friendly resumes and professional cover letters in minutes. 

Improve an existing resume or build one from scratch, then create a matching cover letter tailored to your experience and career goals. Choose from a wide selection of modern professional templates, customize with ease, and download instantly in PDF or DOCX format.

The app provides a variety of expertly designed, recruiter-approved resume templates built to pass ATS scans. Whether you prefer a modern, minimalist layout or a classic professional style, you'll find a template that fits your industry and experience level.

Create polished cover letters that complement your resume and help you make a strong first impression. Customize content, formatting, and style to match your applications and stand out to employers.

From new graduates to experienced professionals, our app helps you create job application documents that look great, read clearly, and increase your chances of landing interviews.

Create. Customize. Download. Apply with confidence.

plugin_asdk_app_6a39286d7d5c8191b30bafc4.productIntro: SlideForge 将简单语言请求或结构化数据转换为可编辑的 PowerPoint 文件。询问 KPI 摘要、项目状态仪表板、路线图或比较 — SlideForge 会在大约一秒钟内呈现可下载的 .pptx，并提供内联预览，以便您可以在对话中检查结果。文件可在 PowerPoint、Google 幻灯片和 Keynote 中打开。
plugin_asdk_app_6a39286d7d5c8191b30bafc4.productIntroEn: SlideForge turns a plain-language request or structured data into an editable PowerPoint file. Ask for a KPI summary, a project status dashboard, a roadmap, or a comparison — SlideForge renders a downloadable .pptx in about a second, with an inline preview so you can check the result in the conversation. Files open in PowerPoint, Google Slides, and Keynote.
plugin_asdk_app_6a39286d7d5c8191b30bafc4.longDescription:
SlideForge turns a plain-language request or structured data into an editable PowerPoint file. Ask for a KPI summary, a project status dashboard, a roadmap, or a comparison — SlideForge renders a downloadable .pptx in about a second, with an inline preview so you can check the result in the conversation. Files open in PowerPoint, Google Slides, and Keynote.

Slides come from a catalog of 150+ patterns: KPI scoreboards, status dashboards, funnels, waterfalls, Gantt plans, org charts, roadmaps, and more. You can build multi-slide decks, convert PDFs and slide images into editable PowerPoint, translate decks into 32 languages, and apply your own brand themes and logo. There is also a code mode for custom python-pptx layouts outside the catalog.

Numbers and text appear exactly as you provide them — rendering is deterministic, and every response reports whether the slide rendered completely and where anything was adjusted. SlideForge connects to your own account via OAuth.
plugin_asdk_app_6a39286d7d5c8191b30bafc4.longDescriptionZh:
SlideForge 将简单语言请求或结构化数据转换为可编辑的 PowerPoint 文件。询问 KPI 摘要、项目状态仪表板、路线图或比较 — SlideForge 会在大约一秒钟内呈现可下载的 .pptx，并提供内联预览，以便您可以在对话中检查结果。文件可在 PowerPoint、Google 幻灯片和 Keynote 中打开。

幻灯片来自 150 多种模式的目录：KPI 记分板、状态仪表板、漏斗、瀑布、甘特计划、组织结构图、路线图等。您可以构建多幻灯片幻灯片、将 PDF 和幻灯片图像转换为可编辑的 PowerPoint、将幻灯片翻译成 32 种语言，以及应用您自己的品牌主题和徽标。目录外还有用于自定义 python-pptx 布局的代码模式。

数字和文本完全按照您提供的方式显示 - 渲染是确定性的，每个响应都会报告幻灯片是否完全渲染以及调整的位置。 SlideForge 通过 OAuth 连接到您自己的帐户。

plugin_asdk_app_69d57a067de88191a2dee16c.name: WPWriter
plugin_asdk_app_69d57a067de88191a2dee16c.productIntro: WPWriter 将 ChatGPT 连接到 WordPress，以便用户可以直接从聊天窗口管理他们的网站。
plugin_asdk_app_69d57a067de88191a2dee16c.productIntroEn: WPWriter connects ChatGPT to WordPress so users can manage their sites directly from a chat window.
plugin_asdk_app_69d57a067de88191a2dee16c.longDescription:
WPWriter connects ChatGPT to WordPress so users can manage their sites directly from a chat window.

Instead of jumping between WordPress admin screens, SEO plugins, media tools, and separate AI apps, users can ask ChatGPT to create, edit, schedule, publish, and optimize content in natural language.

With WPWriter, users can manage posts, pages, categories, tags, menus, SEO metadata, featured images, media, plugins, themes, and publishing status. They can also set up autoblogging workflows with topic queues and publishing schedules, so new posts can be generated and published automatically.

WPWriter is built for bloggers, creators, agencies, marketers, and WordPress site owners who want a faster way to run their WordPress sites while staying in control of every change.
plugin_asdk_app_69d57a067de88191a2dee16c.longDescriptionZh:
WPWriter 将 ChatGPT 连接到 WordPress，以便用户可以直接从聊天窗口管理他们的网站。

用户可以要求 ChatGPT 以自然语言创建、编辑、安排、发布和优化内容，而不是在 WordPress 管理屏幕、SEO 插件、媒体工具和单独的 AI 应用程序之间跳转。

使用 WPWriter，用户可以管理帖子、页面、类别、标签、菜单、SEO 元数据、特色图像、媒体、插件、主题和发布状态。他们还可以使用主题队列和发布计划设置自动博客工作流程，以便自动生成和发布新帖子。

WPWriter 专为博主、创作者、代理商、营销人员和 WordPress 网站所有者而构建，他们希望以更快的方式运行 WordPress 网站，同时保持对每项更改的控制。
defaultPrompts: Connect my WordPress site and walk me through the setup
Write a new blog post for my WordPress site and save it as a draft
Review the SEO on my latest posts and improve the weakest title and meta description
defaultPromptsZh: 连接我的 WordPress 网站并引导我完成设置
为我的 WordPress 网站撰写新博客文章并将其另存为草稿
检查我最新帖子的 SEO 并改进最薄弱的标题和元描述

plugin_asdk_app_69f3b47a700c8191b66f048b.longDescription:
Camtasia generates clear how-to videos from nothing more than a single screen capture. Transform one or more screenshots into a narrated instructional video in seconds. plugin_asdk_app_69b4620162f48191a05cc9fc.name: Reclaim.ai
plugin_asdk_app_69b4620162f48191a05cc9fc.productIntro: Reclaim.ai 将智能时间管理直接引入 ChatGPT，帮助您规划、保护和优化您的日程安排
plugin_asdk_app_69b4620162f48191a05cc9fc.productIntroEn: Reclaim.ai brings intelligent time management directly into ChatGPT, helping you plan, protect, and optimize your schedule
plugin_asdk_app_69b4620162f48191a05cc9fc.longDescription:
Reclaim.ai  brings intelligent time management directly into ChatGPT, helping you plan, protect, and optimize your schedule

Instead of switching between tools to coordinate meetings and tasks, you can simply ask ChatGPT to organize your time. Reclaim connects to Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, and many popular task platforms and lets you plan your day, schedule meetings, and get things done right from within ChatGPT.

With Reclaim and ChatGPT you can:

- Find the best times to meet based on availability
- Create, update, reschedule, or cancel events
- Quickly focus on your most important tasks
- Show your daily or weekly schedule
- Identify scheduling conflicts and recommend fixes
- Protect time for deep work and important tasks
- Analyze meeting load and focus time
- Help you understand how your time is spent

You stay in control with reviewable changes before updates are applied to your calendar.

Whether you're scheduling meetings, planning focus time, or trying to reduce meeting overload across your team, Reclaim turns ChatGPT into a powerful scheduling and productivity assistant.

Try asking:

“What does my day look like?”
“Find 30 minutes with Alex and Sarah this week.”
“Block two hours for deep work tomorrow morning.”
“What should I work on?”
“Plan my week for focus time.”

Reclaim works with Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, Atlassian Jira, Linear, ClickUp, Asana, Todoist, and more.
plugin_asdk_app_69b4620162f48191a05cc9fc.longDescriptionZh:
Reclaim.ai 将智能时间管理直接引入 ChatGPT，帮助您规划、保护和优化您的日程安排

您无需切换工具来协调会议和任务，只需让 ChatGPT 来安排您的时间即可。 Reclaim 连接到 Google 日历、Microsoft Outlook 和许多流行的任务平台，让您可以在 ChatGPT 中直接计划一天、安排会议并完成工作。

通过 Reclaim 和 ChatGPT，您可以：

- 根据空闲情况找到最佳会面时间
- 创建、更新、重新安排或取消活动
- 快速专注于最重要的任务
- 显示您每天或每周的日程安排
- 识别日程安排冲突并提出修复建议
- 保护深度工作和重要任务的时间
- 分析会议负荷和焦点时间
- 帮助您了解您的时间是如何度过的

在将更新应用到您的日历之前，您可以掌控可审阅的更改。

无论您是安排会议、规划专注时间，还是尝试减少整个团队的会议超负荷，Reclaim 都能将 ChatGPT 变成强大的日程安排和生产力助手。

尝试询问：

“我的一天是什么样的？”
“本周抽出 30 分钟时间与 Alex 和 Sarah 相处。”
“明天早上留出两个小时进行深度工作。”
“我应该做什么工作？”
“计划我一周的专注时间。”

Reclaim 可与 Google Calendar、Microsoft Outlook、Atlassian Jira、Linear、ClickUp、Asana、Todoist 等配合使用。

plugin_asdk_app_694e289261b08191b244259e.productIntroEn: Manus is an autonomous AI agent that you can delegate complex tasks to directly within ChatGPT. Instead of just generating content, Manus manages entire projects from a single instruction to a finished product. You can use it to create professional presentations by asking for 'slides' on a specific topic.
plugin_asdk_app_694e289261b08191b244259e.longDescription: Manus is an autonomous AI agent that you can delegate complex tasks to directly within ChatGPT. Instead of just generating content, Manus manages entire projects from a single instruction to a finished product. You can use it to create professional presentations by asking for 'slides' on a specific topic. Tell it to 'build a website' for your project, and it will deliver a functional, live site. Ask it to 'produce a video' for your marketing campaign, and you'll get a polished final cut. Or, have it 'conduct wide research' on any subject to receive a comprehensive report with synthesized findings and sources. Just tell Manus your goal, and it handles the rest.

plugin_asdk_app_6a2a608b8e308191b0b0725e.name: Agentic Search by Liner
plugin_asdk_app_6a2a608b8e308191b0b0725e.productIntro: Liner 是一种代理人工智能搜索，可利用实时网络数据和引用来源查找、验证和总结答案。提出问题，Liner 会搜索实时网络，抓取和抓取当前页面，并返回一个有根据的答案，您可以根据原始来源进行事实检查 - 最新的新闻和最新信息，而不是过时的训练数据。
plugin_asdk_app_6a2a608b8e308191b0b0725e.productIntroEn: Liner is an agentic AI search that finds, verifies, and summarizes answers with real-time web data and cited sources. Ask a question and Liner searches the live web, scrapes and crawls current pages, and returns a grounded answer you can fact-check against the original source — the latest news and up-to-date information, not stale training data.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2a608b8e308191b0b0725e.longDescription:
Liner is an agentic AI search that finds, verifies, and summarizes answers with real-time web data and cited sources. Ask a question and Liner searches the live web, scrapes and crawls current pages, and returns a grounded answer you can fact-check against the original source — the latest news and up-to-date information, not stale training data.

Use Liner to:

- Search the real-time web and get verified, cited answers
- Summarize PDFs, research papers, and long documents
- Fact-check and verify claims against primary sources
- Find and read academic papers and scholarly research
- Get the latest news and up-to-date information on any topic
- Create market, company, or product briefs
- Compare viewpoints across multiple sources
- Turn a broad question into a structured, cited report

Built for agents and builders: 

Liner works as a grounded search and retrieval layer for AI agents, MCP workflows, and anyone building with real-time information. A reliable alternative to Exa, Tavily, Elicit, SciSpace, and Scite for search, retrieval, and academic discovery.

Liner covers web search, academic search, fact-checking, summarization, PDF reading, paper discovery, real-time news, scraping, and crawling — all with verifiable citations.

Need a fast cited answer or a full report? Liner does both — quick research for speed, deep research when you need more context before a decision. Also available as an API, so teams building AI products can tap the same search and research capabilities directly.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2a608b8e308191b0b0725e.longDescriptionZh:
Liner 是一种代理人工智能搜索，可利用实时网络数据和引用来源查找、验证和总结答案。提出问题，Liner 会搜索实时网络，抓取和抓取当前页面，并返回一个有根据的答案，您可以根据原始来源进行事实检查 - 最新的新闻和最新信息，而不是过时的训练数据。

使用衬垫可以：

- 搜索实时网络并获得经过验证、引用的答案
- 总结 PDF、研究论文和长文档
- 根据主要来源进行事实检查和验证声明
- 查找并阅读学术论文和学术研究
- 获取有关任何主题的最新新闻和最新信息
- 创建市场、公司或产品简介
- 比较多个来源的观点
- 将广泛的问题转化为结构化的、引用的报告

专为代理商和建筑商打造： 

Liner 充当 AI 代理、MCP 工作流程以及使用实时信息进行构建的任何人的基础搜索和检索层。 Exa、Tavily、Elicit、SciSpace 和 Scite 的可靠替代品，用于搜索、检索和学术发现。

Liner 涵盖网络搜索、学术搜索、事实检查、摘要、PDF 阅读、论文发现、实时新闻、抓取和爬行 - 所有这些都带有可验证的引用。

需要快速引用的答案或完整的报告？ Liner 两者兼而有之——快速研究以提高速度，而深入研究则需要更多背景信息才能做出决定。还可以作为 API 提供，因此构建人工智能产品的团队可以直接利用相同的搜索和研究功能。

plugin_asdk_app_694a8009f86481918b118a4a.name: HappyScribe
plugin_asdk_app_694a8009f86481918b118a4a.productIntroEn: Connect HappyScribe to give ChatGPT on-demand access to your organization's conversational memory: every transcript, meeting recording, interview, and quote, speaker-attributed, verbatim, in 150+ languages.
plugin_asdk_app_694a8009f86481918b118a4a.longDescription:
Connect HappyScribe to give ChatGPT on-demand access to your organization's conversational memory: every transcript, meeting recording, interview, and quote, speaker-attributed, verbatim, in 150+ languages.

HappyScribe is an AI notetaker and transcription platform that captures every conversation: online meetings, in-person recordings, interviews, fieldwork, uploaded media. It turns them into searchable, citable, structured knowledge with verbatim accuracy: what was actually said, by whom, in what language.

What ChatGPT can do with HappyScribe connected:
- Search your library by keyword, speaker, date, or topic
- Pull exact quotes with verified timestamps and deep links to the editor
- Transcribe new media from a URL (YouTube, Vimeo, direct links)
- Manage folders, rename speakers, and edit transcript text
- Diagnose why a meeting wasn't recorded
- Explore the people and companies graph across your recordings

Best-in-class multilingual accuracy across 150+ languages. European and GDPR-native.
plugin_asdk_app_694a8009f86481918b118a4a.longDescriptionZh:
Connect HappyScribe to give ChatGPT on-demand access to your organization's conversational memory: every transcript, meeting recording, interview, and quote, speaker-attributed, verbatim, in 150+ languages.

HappyScribe is an AI notetaker and transcription platform that captures every conversation: online meetings, in-person recordings, interviews, fieldwork, uploaded media.它将它们变成可搜索、可引用、逐字准确的结构化知识：实际上说了什么、由谁、用什么语言说的。

ChatGPT 连接 HappyScribe 可以做什么：
- 按关键字、演讲者、日期或主题搜索您的图书馆
- 提取带有经过验证的时间戳和编辑器深层链接的精确报价
- 从 URL 转录新媒体（YouTube、Vimeo、直接链接）
- 管理文件夹、重命名演讲者和编辑脚本文本
- 诊断会议未记录的原因
- 探索录音中的人员和公司图表

跨 150 多种语言的一流多语言准确性。欧洲和 GDPR 原生。

plugin_asdk_app_69c3058914bc81919b807c17.name: Hjarni Notes
plugin_asdk_app_69c3058914bc81919b807c17.description: 你的笔记，你的人工智能的记忆。
plugin_asdk_app_69c3058914bc81919b807c17.productIntro: Hjarni 是您的人工智能可以实际使用的知识库。
plugin_asdk_app_69c3058914bc81919b807c17.productIntroEn: Hjarni is a knowledge base your AI can actually use.
plugin_asdk_app_69c3058914bc81919b807c17.longDescription:
Hjarni is a knowledge base your AI can actually use.

Write notes in Markdown. Organize them in folders and tags. ChatGPT reads them directly through a built-in MCP server. No plugins. No pasting the same context into every conversation.

ChatGPT starts every conversation from zero. Connect Hjarni once and it stops asking. Ask questions across all your notes. Have ChatGPT write new notes, update old ones, and tag them the way you want.

Set instructions per folder to control how ChatGPT writes, formats, and tags. Share a folder with your team so everyone's AI works from the same knowledge base. Search across everything in one call.

Built on the same open MCP standard as Claude, so your knowledge base is not locked to one assistant.

Use it as your second brain, your project memory, your research library, or your team's shared context. Notes, folders, tags. That is the product. Simple on purpose.

Free to start. No credit card required.
plugin_asdk_app_69c3058914bc81919b807c17.longDescriptionZh:
Hjarni 是您的人工智能可以实际使用的知识库。

用 Markdown 写笔记。将它们组织在文件夹和标签中。 ChatGPT 通过内置的 MCP 服务器直接读取它们。没有插件。不要将相同的上下文粘贴到每个对话中。

ChatGPT 每一次对话都从零开始。连接 Hjarni 一次，它就会停止询问。在所有笔记中提出问题。让 ChatGPT 编写新笔记、更新旧笔记并按照您想要的方式标记它们。

设置每个文件夹的指令以控制 ChatGPT 的写入方式、格式和标签。与您的团队共享一个文件夹，以便每个人的人工智能都在同一个知识库中工作。通过一次调用即可搜索所有内容。

plugin_asdk_app_6a47b1df9be0819181a971e7.description: 使用 AI 撰写博客并运行 WordPress
plugin_asdk_app_6a47b1df9be0819181a971e7.productIntro: WordPress 的 AI 博客和内容完全由 ChatGPT 管理 — 连接您的网站一次，ChatGPT 就可以编写、编辑、发布、安排、SEO 优化和端到端维护。 WP Agent 是无密钥的：您无需携带 AI API 密钥。
plugin_asdk_app_6a47b1df9be0819181a971e7.productIntroEn: AI blogging and content for WordPress, managed entirely from ChatGPT — connect your site once and ChatGPT can write, edit, publish, schedule, SEO-optimize, and maintain it end to end. WP Agent is keyless: you don't bring an AI API key.
plugin_asdk_app_6a47b1df9be0819181a971e7.longDescription:
AI blogging and content for WordPress, managed entirely from ChatGPT — connect your site once and ChatGPT can write, edit, publish, schedule, SEO-optimize, and maintain it end to end. WP Agent is keyless: you don't bring an AI API key.

ChatGPT authors the content, image prompts, and SEO; WP Agent executes them on your WordPress site through purpose-built tools.

Create, edit, schedule, and publish posts and pages, update existing content, and manage revisions.

Handle the full media library: upload images, generate AI hero images or pull free stock photos, and set featured images sized for WordPress.

Run complete SEO workflows — titles, meta descriptions, focus keywords, and per-post SEO analysis.

Manage categories, tags, menus, comments, authors, site settings, custom CSS, and plugins — all from ChatGPT. Safe by design: destructive actions are confirm-gated, publishing is explicit, and every tool call is audited.

Works with any self-hosted WordPress site: connect with a one-time approval link in wp-admin, using a standard, revocable application password.

The optional WP Agent Connector plugin adds SEO meta support (Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO) and compatibility with restrictive hosts.
plugin_asdk_app_6a47b1df9be0819181a971e7.longDescriptionZh:
WordPress 的 AI 博客和内容完全由 ChatGPT 管理 — 连接您的网站一次，ChatGPT 就可以编写、编辑、发布、安排、SEO 优化和端到端维护。 WP Agent 是无密钥的：您无需携带 AI API 密钥。

ChatGPT 创作内容、图像提示和 SEO； WP Agent 通过专用工具在您的 WordPress 网站上执行它们。

创建、编辑、安排和发布帖子和页面，更新现有内容以及管理修订。

处理完整的媒体库：上传图像、生成 AI 英雄图像或提取免费库存照片，以及设置适合 WordPress 的特色图像大小。

运行完整的 SEO 工作流程 - 标题、元描述、焦点关键词和每篇文章的 SEO 分析。

管理类别、标签、菜单、评论、作者、站点设置、自定义 CSS 和插件 — 全部来自 ChatGPT。设计安全：破坏性行为经过确认，发布是明确的，并且每个工具调用都经过审核。

适用于任何自托管 WordPress 网站：使用标准、可撤销的应用程序密码连接 wp-admin 中的一次性批准链接。

可选的 WP Agent Connector 插件添加了 SEO 元支持（Yoast、Rank Math、AIOSEO）以及与限制性主机的兼容性。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3be8ce7d0c81918cb8bcc8.name: Shippo
plugin_asdk_app_6a3be8ce7d0c81918cb8bcc8.longDescription:
Shipping, without the busywork.

Shippo connects you to USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL, and 40+ carriers, so you can handle a shipment end to end right inside ChatGPT. Compare live rates and pick the cheapest or best option, buy and print labels (domestic and international, with customs declarations), validate and standardize addresses, and track packages across carriers.

Just ask in plain language: rate-shop a parcel, buy the right label, check a delivery status, or confirm an address before you ship. Whether you run a store or just need to send a package, Shippo turns a pile of carrier accounts into one simple conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3be8ce7d0c81918cb8bcc8.longDescriptionZh:
运输，无需繁琐的工作。

Shippo 将您连接到 USPS、UPS、FedEx、DHL 和 40 多家承运商，因此您可以在 ChatGPT 内处理端到端的货件。比较实时费率并选择最便宜或最好的选项，购买和打印标签（国内和国际，带有海关申报单），验证和标准化地址，以及跟踪承运商之间的包裹。

只需用简单的语言询问即可：对包裹进行评分、购买正确的标签、检查递送状态或在发货前确认地址。无论您经营一家商店还是只需要寄送包裹，Shippo 都能将一堆承运人帐户变成一次简单的对话。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4ea51b44c48191b49f0b14.description: AI 代理的电子邮件收件箱
plugin_asdk_app_6a4ea51b44c48191b49f0b14.productIntro: AgentMail 为人工智能代理提供了自己的电子邮件收件箱。通过此连接器，代理（或者您，在 ChatGPT 中）可以即时启动专用收件箱，然后完全通过工具调用发送、接收、回复和转发电子邮件，其中包含完整的线程上下文、草稿和附件。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4ea51b44c48191b49f0b14.productIntroEn: AgentMail gives AI agents their own email inboxes. Through this connector, an agent (or you, in ChatGPT) can spin up a dedicated inbox on the fly, then send, receive, reply to, and forward email, with full thread context, drafts, and attachments, entirely through tool calls.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4ea51b44c48191b49f0b14.longDescription:
AgentMail gives AI agents their own email inboxes. Through this connector, an agent (or you, in ChatGPT) can spin up a dedicated inbox on the fly, then send, receive, reply to, and forward email, with full thread context, drafts, and attachments, entirely through tool calls.

Unlike traditional email APIs built for one-way notifications, AgentMail is built for two-way conversations: an agent can read an incoming thread, understand it, and respond in context, just like a person would. This makes email a first-class communication and identity channel for agents, letting them sign up for services, coordinate with people, and talk to other agents.

Key capabilities exposed over MCP:
• Inboxes: create, list, get, update, and delete agent inboxes
• Messages: send, reply, forward, list, and update
• Threads: list, read, label, and delete full conversation threads
• Search: full-text search across threads and messages
• Drafts: create, list, read, update, send (with scheduling), and delete
• Attachments: retrieve attachments by ID, with text extraction for PDF/DOCX

Connect in seconds via OAuth using your AgentMail console identity. No API key required in ChatGPT. Sign up free at console.agentmail.to.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4ea51b44c48191b49f0b14.longDescriptionZh:
AgentMail 为人工智能代理提供了自己的电子邮件收件箱。通过此连接器，代理（或者您，在 ChatGPT 中）可以即时启动专用收件箱，然后完全通过工具调用发送、接收、回复和转发电子邮件，其中包含完整的线程上下文、草稿和附件。

与为单向通知构建的传统电子邮件 API 不同，AgentMail 是为双向对话构建的：代理可以读取传入线程、理解它并在上下文中进行响应，就像人一样。这使得电子邮件成为客服人员一流的沟通和身份渠道，使他们能够注册服务、与人员协调以及与其他客服人员交谈。

通过 MCP 公开的关键功能：
• 收件箱：创建、列出、获取、更新和删除代理收件箱
• 消息：发送、回复、转发、列出和更新
• 话题：列出、阅读、标记和删除完整对话话题
• 搜索：跨话题和消息的全文搜索
• 草稿：创建、列出、阅读、更新、发送（按计划）和删除
• 附件：按 ID 检索附件，并提取 PDF/DOCX 文本

使用您的 AgentMail 控制台身份通过 OAuth 在几秒钟内建立连接。 ChatGPT 中不需要 API 密钥。在 console.agentmail.to 免费注册。

plugin_asdk_app_6a846ee396988191a2818981.productIntro: 表单很容易需要，但构建起来却很烦人。每个问题类型、每个分节符、每个设置都是另一次点击 - 当回复到达时，阅读它们本身就是一件苦差事。这个插件将所有内容都转移到对话中。
plugin_asdk_app_6a846ee396988191a2818981.productIntroEn: Forms are easy to need and annoying to build. Every question type, every section break, every setting is another click - and by the time responses arrive, reading them is its own chore. This plugin moves all of it into the conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a846ee396988191a2818981.longDescription:
Forms are easy to need and annoying to build. Every question type, every section break, every setting is another click - and by the time responses arrive, reading them is its own chore. This plugin moves all of it into the conversation.

Build a form by describing it. Say what you're collecting — a customer satisfaction survey, an event signup, a job application screener, a 20-point quiz for your class — and it's created in your account, with sensible question types chosen for you: multiple choice where the answers are known, scales for ratings, short text where they aren't, required fields where they matter.

Keep editing in plain language. Add a question in the middle. Reword the confusing one. Move it to page two. Make question 4 worth double. Drop the one nobody answers. Every change lands on the live form — no rebuilding from scratch, no digging through the editor to find the right toggle.

Set it up properly, without hunting for settings. Turn a form into a graded quiz, collect email addresses, limit it to one response per person, open or close it to responses - all by asking.

Then actually read the results. Find any of your forms by name, pull the responses, and ask real questions of them: What's the overall sentiment? What are the three most common complaints in the open-text box? How did answers differ between the two groups? Free-text feedback - the part that usually goes unread because summarizing 200 answers by hand isn't happening - gets read and summarized for you.

Works with the forms you already own, not just new ones.
plugin_asdk_app_6a846ee396988191a2818981.longDescriptionZh:
表单很容易需要，但构建起来却很烦人。每个问题类型、每个分节符、每个设置都是另一次点击 - 当回复到达时，阅读它们本身就是一件苦差事。这个插件将所有内容都转移到对话中。

通过描述来构建表单。说出您正在收集的内容 - 客户满意度调查、活动报名、工作申请筛选器、班级 20 分测验 - 它会在您的帐户中创建，并为您选择合理的问题类型：已知答案的多项选择、评级等级、未知答案的短文本、重要的必填字段。

继续用简单的语言进行编辑。中间加一个问题。重新表述一下令人困惑的部分。把它移到第二页。让问题 4 的价值加倍。放弃那个没人回答的。每一次更改都会发生在实时表单上——无需从头开始重建，无需深入编辑器来找到正确的切换。

正确设置，无需寻找设置。将表格转变为评分测验、收集电子邮件地址、限制每人一次回复、打开或关闭回复 - 所有这些都通过询问来实现。

然后实际读取结果。按名称找到您的任何表格，提取回复，并向他们提出真正的问题：总体情绪是什么？打开文本框中最常见的三个投诉是什么？两组的答案有何不同？自由文本反馈 - 通常不会阅读的部分，因为无法手动总结 200 个答案 - 会为您阅读和总结。

适用于您已有的表单，而不仅仅是新表单。

Summarize the responses to my "Team Offsite Signup" form and show which days are most popular

plugin_asdk_app_6a11e118ab748191a479f91c.name: Unabyss
plugin_asdk_app_6a11e118ab748191a479f91c.description: 您的 AI 上下文层
plugin_asdk_app_6a11e118ab748191a479f91c.productIntro: Unabyss 是您的个人人工智能上下文层。连接您已使用的应用程序（LinkedIn、您的网站、Notion、Gmail、Slack、GitHub），Unabyss 会自动提取、构建并保持您的上下文最新。然后，您使用的任何人工智能工具（包括 ChatGPT）都可以在您需要时提取正确的上下文。 不再需要在每次谈话开始时重新解释你的角色、你的项目、你的语气或你的公司。您的上下文存在于一个地方，随着来源的变化而保持最新，并伴随您在您使用的每个人工智能工具中移动。
plugin_asdk_app_6a11e118ab748191a479f91c.productIntroEn: Unabyss is your personal context layer for AI. Connect the apps you already use — LinkedIn, your website, Notion, Gmail, Slack, GitHub — and Unabyss extracts, structures, and keeps your context up to date automatically. Then any AI tool you use, including ChatGPT, can pull exactly the right context when you need it.
plugin_asdk_app_6a11e118ab748191a479f91c.longDescription:
Unabyss is your personal context layer for AI. Connect the apps you already use — LinkedIn, your website, Notion, Gmail, Slack, GitHub — and Unabyss extracts, structures, and keeps your context up to date automatically. Then any AI tool you use, including ChatGPT, can pull exactly the right context when you need it.
No more re-explaining your role, your projects, your tone, or your company at the start of every conversation. Your context lives in one place, stays current as your sources change, and travels with you across every AI tool you use.
What you get:

Auto-extraction from your existing tools in under 90 seconds
Structured context files you fully own — persona, voice, company, and more
Granular permissions: share your writing voice without exposing professional details
One-click exports for investor updates, meeting prep, bios, and ICPs
Always up to date as your connected sources sync

Built for founders, operators, and builders who live across multiple AI tools and are tired of starting from zero every time. If you've ever thought "ChatGPT should already know this" — that's what Unabyss fixes.
plugin_asdk_app_6a11e118ab748191a479f91c.longDescriptionZh:
Unabyss 是您的个人人工智能上下文层。连接您已使用的应用程序（LinkedIn、您的网站、Notion、Gmail、Slack、GitHub），Unabyss 会自动提取、构建并保持您的上下文最新。然后，您使用的任何人工智能工具（包括 ChatGPT）都可以在您需要时提取正确的上下文。
不再需要在每次谈话开始时重新解释你的角色、你的项目、你的语气或你的公司。您的上下文存在于一个地方，随着来源的变化而保持最新，并伴随您在您使用的每个人工智能工具中移动。
你得到什么：

在 90 秒内从现有工具中自动提取
您完全拥有的结构化上下文文件 - 角色、声音、公司等
细化权限：分享您的写作声音而不暴露专业细节
一键导出投资者更新、会议准备、简历和 ICP
当您连接的源同步时始终保持最新状态

专为使用多种人工智能工具并厌倦了每次从零开始的创始人、运营商和构建者而设计。如果您曾经认为“ChatGPT 应该已经知道这一点”——这就是 Unabyss 所解决的问题。

plugin_asdk_app_699f3c9f85788191874d8a0a.productIntro: 通过连接您的 Mem 知识库，为 ChatGPT 提供您第二大脑的完整背景。在您的 AI 笔记本中搜索上下文、捕捉和回忆想法、将聊天内容保存到新笔记中、编辑和更新生活文档以及组织您的 AI 工作区 — 只需询问 ChatGPT。用于：从会议记录、深入研究、个人知识管理 (PKM)、知识库构建、任务管理、优先级划分和内容开发中综合和提取行动项目。示例提示：“在我的笔记中搜索定价策略，并通过研究验证我们的想法。

plugin_asdk_app_699f3c9f85788191874d8a0a.longDescription: Give ChatGPT the full context of your second brain by connecting your Mem knowledge base. plugin_asdk_app_6a70acb6aae4819199d90bb1.longDescription: Werify gives users their own WhatsApp archive inside ChatGPT — conversations they imported from a chat export or captured from a number they connected. With the user's approval it can also act: send a text message into a conversation under active capture (one message, confirmed with the user first), connect a WhatsApp number to Werify by pairing code, which only the user can complete on their phone, start or stop capturing a chat from a connected number (new messages only), and import a chat's earlier history from the phone at a price the user is shown and agrees to first.

plugin_asdk_app_6a49590bf6348191a16c0b87.name: Basic Memory Cloud
plugin_asdk_app_6a49590bf6348191a16c0b87.description: 为您的 AI 工具提供一个内存
plugin_asdk_app_6a49590bf6348191a16c0b87.originalDescription: One memory for your AI tools
plugin_asdk_app_6a49590bf6348191a16c0b87.productIntro: 基本记忆为您提供持久的知识库：您的笔记、决策、研究和项目背景，存储为您拥有的纯 Markdown 文件。您的人工智能保存到基本内存中的任何内容，您都可以打开和编辑。您编写的任何内容，您的人工智能都可以找到并进行构建。
plugin_asdk_app_6a49590bf6348191a16c0b87.productIntroEn: Basic Memory gives you a persistent knowledge base: your notes, decisions, research, and project context, stored as plain Markdown files you own. Anything your AI saves to Basic Memory, you can open and edit. Anything you write, your AI can find and build on.
plugin_asdk_app_6a49590bf6348191a16c0b87.longDescription:
Basic Memory gives you a persistent knowledge base: your notes, decisions, research, and project context, stored as plain Markdown files you own. Anything your AI saves to Basic Memory, you can open and edit. Anything you write, your AI can find and build on.

Save what matters. "Save our pricing decision and link it to the roadmap." Notes you save in one conversation are available everywhere.

Retrieve context from anywhere. "What did we decide about pricing? Check my notes first." Never re-explain a project.

Search by meaning. Semantic and hybrid search across everything you and your AI have saved.

Structured search. Filter by status, type, tags, or priority. "Show my open tasks, sorted by priority."

Follow connections. Linked notes let your AI traverse related context and surface relationships in a living knowledge graph.

Share a workspace with your team. Teammates and their AI tools read and write to one shared source of truth.

Notes are stored as ordinary Markdown that you own. Any AI tool can use and build on it, so your shared context follows you across the assistants and agents you use.

Subscription Required:

This connector requires a Basic Memory Cloud account (7-day free trial, then from $15/seat/month at https://basicmemory.com.

Use the Basic Memory Cloud app to view and edit your notes at: https://app.basicmemory.com
plugin_asdk_app_6a49590bf6348191a16c0b87.longDescriptionZh:
基本记忆为您提供持久的知识库：您的笔记、决策、研究和项目背景，存储为您拥有的纯 Markdown 文件。您的人工智能保存到基本内存中的任何内容，您都可以打开和编辑。您编写的任何内容，您的人工智能都可以找到并进行构建。

保存重要的东西。 “保存我们的定价决定并将其链接到路线图。”您在一次对话中保存的笔记随处可见。

从任何地方检索上下文。 “我们对定价做了什么决定？先检查一下我的笔记。”永远不要重新解释一个项目。

按含义搜索。对您和您的人工智能保存的所有内容进行语义和混合搜索。

结构化搜索。按状态、类型、标签或优先级过滤。 “显示我的未完成任务，按优先级排序。”

遵循连接。链接笔记可让您的 AI 遍历动态知识图中的相关上下文和表面关系。

与您的团队共享工作空间。队友和他们的人工智能工具读取和写入一个共享的事实来源。

笔记存储为您拥有的普通 Markdown。任何人工智能工具都可以使用它并在其基础上进行构建，因此您的共享上下文会跟随您使用的助手和代理。

需要订阅：

此连接器需要 Basic Memory Cloud 帐户（7 天免费试用，然后从 https://basicmemory.com 上每个席位/月 15 美元起。

使用 Basic Memory Cloud 应用程序查看和编辑您的笔记：https://app.basicmemory.com

- Add forms, interactive workflows, and business automation

- Accept payments and automate business processes
- Publish and share apps in minutes

- Employee portals and onboarding apps

plugin_asdk_app_6a21bbefe8bc81919d395e1b.description: 查找工作、远程岗位、简历与薪资信息。
plugin_asdk_app_6a21bbefe8bc81919d395e1b.productIntro: FoundRole 是一款人工智能职位搜索和职位申请跟踪器。按职位、地点、工资、发布日期和工作类型（远程、在家工作或现场工作）搜索实时工作委员会。 Save the roles you want to your tracker. 每份工作都有真实的数据来判断：薪资洞察与市场价格、带有信任等级的幽灵工作信号、H-1B 担保人状态和电子验证状态。
plugin_asdk_app_6a21bbefe8bc81919d395e1b.productIntroEn: FoundRole is an AI job search and job application tracker. Search a live job board by title, location, salary, date posted, and work type: remote, work-from-home, or on-site. Save the roles you want to your tracker. Every job comes with real data to judge it by: salary insights versus market rates, ghost-job signals with a trust grade, H-1B sponsor status, and E-Verify status.
plugin_asdk_app_6a21bbefe8bc81919d395e1b.longDescription:
FoundRole is an AI job search and job application tracker. Search a live job board by title, location, salary, date posted, and work type: remote, work-from-home, or on-site. Save the roles you want to your tracker.
Every job comes with real data to judge it by: salary insights versus market rates, ghost-job signals with a trust grade, H-1B sponsor status, and E-Verify status. 

Add a resume or complete your FoundRole profile, and each job also shows a match score with the skills you're missing. Found a role on LinkedIn or a company careers page? Paste the link to analyze it the same way, then compare up to four jobs side by side.

Move applications through Saved → Applied → Interviewing → Offered stages, keep notes, contacts, and offer details on each one, and set follow-up reminders with calendar invites. 

Subscribe to daily, weekly, or monthly job alerts and get job recommendations matched to your profile. 
When you need guidance, FoundRole answers from its library of career guides on resumes, interviews, and salary.

Free to use. Everything stays in sync with FoundRole on the web.
plugin_asdk_app_6a21bbefe8bc81919d395e1b.longDescriptionZh:
FoundRole 是一款人工智能职位搜索和职位申请跟踪器。按职位、地点、工资、发布日期和工作类型（远程、在家工作或现场工作）搜索实时工作委员会。 Save the roles you want to your tracker.
每份工作都有真实的数据来判断：薪资洞察与市场价格、带有信任等级的幽灵工作信号、H-1B 担保人状态和电子验证状态。 

添加简历或填写您的 FoundRole 个人资料，每个职位还会显示您所缺少的技能的匹配分数。在 LinkedIn 或公司招聘页面上找到了职位？粘贴链接以同样的方式进行分析，然后并排比较最多四个职位。

通过“已保存”→“已应用”→“面试”→“已提供”阶段移动申请，保留每一份申请的备注、联系人和报价详细信息，并使用日历邀请设置后续提醒。 

订阅每日、每周或每月的职位提醒并获取与您的个人资料相匹配的职位推荐。 
当您需要指导时，FoundRole 可以从其关于简历、面试和薪资的职业指南库中找到答案。

免费使用。一切都与网络上的 FoundRole 保持同步。

plugin_asdk_app_69619c97f3288191ad90f579.description: 检查简历 ATS 分数
plugin_asdk_app_69619c97f3288191ad90f579.productIntro: Upplai 的 ATS 简历检查器会分析您的简历与职位描述的匹配程度，并提供 ATS 风格的兼容性评分以及详细的关键字见解。
plugin_asdk_app_69619c97f3288191ad90f579.productIntroEn: Upplai’s ATS resume checker analyzes how well your resume matches a job description and provides an ATS-style compatibility score along with detailed keyword insights.
plugin_asdk_app_69619c97f3288191ad90f579.longDescription:
Upplai’s ATS resume checker analyzes how well your resume matches a job description and provides an ATS-style compatibility score along with detailed keyword insights.

Get an overall score (0–100), plus a detailed keyword analysis showing the job-specific keywords important for ATS optimization, which keywords are present or missing, their relative importance, and how well your resume scores for each one. Understand where your resume falls short and what to improve.

Try asking: “What’s my ATS score for [this job]?” or “Score my resume for ATS for [this role].”

Useful for job seekers evaluating their resume’s ATS compatibility, especially those applying to companies that use automated resume screening.
plugin_asdk_app_69619c97f3288191ad90f579.longDescriptionZh:
Upplai 的 ATS 简历检查器会分析您的简历与职位描述的匹配程度，并提供 ATS 风格的兼容性评分以及详细的关键字见解。

获得总体得分 (0–100)，以及详细的关键字分析，显示对 ATS 优化重要的特定于职位的关键字、存在或缺失的关键字、它们的相对重要性以及您的简历中每个关键字的得分情况。了解你的简历的不足之处以及需要改进的地方。

Try asking: “What’s my ATS score for [this job]?”或“为我的 ATS 简历打分[这个职位]。”

对于评估简历 ATS 兼容性的求职者非常有用，尤其是那些申请使用自动简历筛选的公司的求职者。

plugin_asdk_app_6a1f0e8961a8819193e05033.name: Spkr - Chat to Podcast Episode
plugin_asdk_app_6a1f0e8961a8819193e05033.description: AI 聊天 -> 播客剧集
plugin_asdk_app_6a1f0e8961a8819193e05033.productIntro: ChatGPT Spkr 应用程序允许订阅者将任何 ChatGPT 答案转换为播客剧集以供以后收听。
plugin_asdk_app_6a1f0e8961a8819193e05033.productIntroEn: The ChatGPT Spkr app allows subscribers to convert any ChatGPT answer to a podcast episode for later listening.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1f0e8961a8819193e05033.longDescription:
The ChatGPT Spkr app allows subscribers to convert any ChatGPT answer to a podcast episode for later listening. 

The podcast episodes can be listened to in the Spkr mobile app or any podcast player.

Examples:
“Create a 10-minute podcast episode explaining what the world might look like in 2035.”
“Create a podcast episode explaining how to build better habits using behavioral science.”
“Explain black holes like I’m an intelligent non-scientist.”
“Tell the story of how the internet was invented and the key people behind it.”

Spkr is an app that allows users to convert articles, documents, emails, and ChatGPT responses to personalize podcasts for later listening.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1f0e8961a8819193e05033.longDescriptionZh:
ChatGPT Spkr 应用程序允许订阅者将任何 ChatGPT 答案转换为播客剧集以供以后收听。 

可以在 Spkr 移动应用程序或任何播客播放器中收听播客剧集。

示例：
“制作一个 10 分钟的播客节目，解释 2035 年的世界可能会是什么样子。”
“创建一个播客节目，解释如何利用行为科学养成更好的习惯。”
“像我是一个聪明的非科学家一样解释黑洞。”
“讲述互联网是如何发明的以及其背后的关键人物的故事。”

Spkr 是一款应用程序，允许用户将文章、文档、电子邮件和 ChatGPT 响应转换为个性化播客以供以后收听。

plugin_asdk_app_69eba611751c819182a7476b.name: Slides AI
plugin_asdk_app_69eba611751c819182a7476b.productIntro: Slides AI 可帮助您根据几乎任何输入快速创建清晰、结构化的演示文稿。在几秒钟内将简单的想法、文本、PDF 或链接转变为随时可用的幻灯片。
plugin_asdk_app_69eba611751c819182a7476b.productIntroEn: Slides AI helps you quickly create clear, structured presentations from almost any input. Turn a simple idea, text, PDF, or link into a ready-to-use slide deck in seconds.
plugin_asdk_app_69eba611751c819182a7476b.longDescription:
Slides AI helps you quickly create clear, structured presentations from almost any input. Turn a simple idea, text, PDF, or link into a ready-to-use slide deck in seconds.

The app automatically organizes content into slides, builds layouts, and generates visuals to match your topic. After creation, you can easily refine the presentation using the built-in editor: rewrite text, adjust structure, or customize slides to fit your needs.

Presentations can be exported as fully editable PPTX files or shared as PDFs, making them ready for work, study, or presentations right away.

Key Features

• Flexible input: generate slides from topics, text, PDFs, or URLs
• Automatic slide structuring and layout generation
• 100+ ready-made templates for different presentation styles
• Built-in editor for quick adjustments and full control
• Export to PPTX and PDF formats
• Clean, presentation-ready results in seconds
plugin_asdk_app_69eba611751c819182a7476b.longDescriptionZh:
Slides AI 可帮助您根据几乎任何输入快速创建清晰、结构化的演示文稿。在几秒钟内将简单的想法、文本、PDF 或链接转变为随时可用的幻灯片。

该应用程序会自动将内容组织到幻灯片中、构建布局并生成与您的主题相匹配的视觉效果。创建后，您可以使用内置编辑器轻松完善演示文稿：重写文本、调整结构或自定义幻灯片以满足您的需求。

演示文稿可以导出为完全可编辑的 PPTX 文件或共享为 PDF，以便立即用于工作、学习或演示。

主要特点

• 灵活的输入：从主题、文本、PDF 或 URL 生成幻灯片
• 自动幻灯片结构和布局生成
• 100 多个适合不同演示风格的现成模板
• 内置编辑器可快速调整和完全控制
• 导出为 PPTX 和 PDF 格式
• 几秒钟内即可获得清晰、可用于演示的结果

plugin_asdk_app_6a26e0a517488191b80afa0e.name: Autocalls AI
plugin_asdk_app_6a26e0a517488191b80afa0e.description: 构建并运行人工智能电话代理
plugin_asdk_app_6a26e0a517488191b80afa0e.productIntro: Autocalls 可让您构建和运行 AI 电话代理 - 现在您可以直接从 ChatGPT 执行此操作，无需切换到仪表板。 Describe what you want, and your assistant takes it from there.
plugin_asdk_app_6a26e0a517488191b80afa0e.productIntroEn: Autocalls lets you build and run AI phone agents — and now you can do it straight from ChatGPT, without switching to a dashboard. Describe what you want, and your assistant takes it from there.
plugin_asdk_app_6a26e0a517488191b80afa0e.longDescription:
Autocalls lets you build and run AI phone agents — and now you can do it straight from ChatGPT, without switching to a dashboard. Describe what you want, and your assistant takes it from there.

Build and refine assistants by chat: set the prompt, voice, language, model and call behaviour for both inbound agents (answer calls, take bookings, qualify leads) and outbound agents (follow-ups, reminders, lead qualification). Give them real abilities by attaching mid-call tools that call your APIs live during a conversation, and knowledgebases that ground their answers in your own documents.

Run outbound work at scale: create a campaign, add your leads, and start, pause or resume it whenever you like. Then close the loop — list your calls, open any one to read its full transcript and post-call evaluation, and update the assistant or its tools to fix what went wrong, all in the same conversation.

Manage the rest of your account too: knowledgebases and documents, phone numbers and SIP trunks, WhatsApp senders and templates, conversations, folders, labels and API keys.

You stay in control. Every tool works only on your own account, reading and writing are separate actions, anything that spends balance or deletes data is clearly marked, and your stored secrets are masked. You connect once with a secure sign-in — no API keys pasted into the chat.
plugin_asdk_app_6a26e0a517488191b80afa0e.longDescriptionZh:
Autocalls 可让您构建和运行 AI 电话代理 - 现在您可以直接从 ChatGPT 执行此操作，无需切换到仪表板。 Describe what you want, and your assistant takes it from there.

通过聊天构建和完善助理：为入站座席（接听电话、接受预订、资格潜在客户）和出站座席（跟进、提醒、潜在客户资格）设置提示、语音、语言、模型和呼叫行为。通过附加在对话期间实时调用 API 的通话中工具以及将他们的答案建立在您自己的文档中的知识库，为他们提供真正的能力。

大规模开展外拨工作：创建营销活动、添加潜在客户，然后随时开始、暂停或恢复。然后关闭循环 - 列出您的通话，打开任何通话以阅读其完整记录和通话后评估，并更新助手或其工具以修复出现的问题，所有这些都在同一对话中进行。

还可以管理帐户的其余部分：知识库和文档、电话号码和 SIP 中继、WhatsApp 发件人和模板、对话、文件夹、标签和 API 密钥。

您保持掌控。每个工具仅适用于您自己的帐户，读取和写入是单独的操作，任何花费余额或删除数据的行为都会被清楚标记，并且您存储的秘密都会被屏蔽。您可以通过安全登录进行连接，无需将 API 密钥粘贴到聊天中。

Create an assistant for our reception line that books appointments and speaks both English and Romanian.
Set up an automation that saves every qualified lead from my calls into a Google Sheet.

plugin_asdk_app_6a789d2ee20c8191a7abd7c3.productIntroEn: Kalender Sync connects your calendars — Google, Microsoft Outlook, Apple iCloud, GMX, WEB.DE and any CalDAV or iCal source — so ChatGPT can answer questions about your availability, find open slots, look up appointments and create events for you.
plugin_asdk_app_6a789d2ee20c8191a7abd7c3.longDescription:
Kalender Sync connects your calendars — Google, Microsoft Outlook, Apple iCloud, GMX, WEB.DE and any CalDAV or iCal source — so ChatGPT can answer questions about your availability, find open slots, look up appointments and create events for you.
  
You decide per calendar how much ChatGPT may see: free/busy only, title and time, or full details. Calendars you do not share stay invisible, and the limits are enforced on our servers, not by the model.

Ask things like "When am I free next week for two hours?", "Do I have anything Thursday afternoon?" or "Book a call with Anna on Tuesday at 10." Runs on servers in Germany under GDPR, with a data processing agreement available.
plugin_asdk_app_6a789d2ee20c8191a7abd7c3.longDescriptionZh:
Kalender Sync 连接您的日历 - Google、Microsoft Outlook、Apple iCloud、GMX、WEB.DE 和任何 CalDAV 或 iCal 源 - 因此 ChatGPT 可以回答有关您的空闲时间的问题、查找空闲时间、查找约会并为您创建活动。
  
您可以根据日历决定 ChatGPT 可以查看的内容：仅忙/闲、标题和时间或完整详细信息。您不共享的日历保持不可见，并且这些限制是在我们的服务器上强制执行的，而不是由模型强制执行的。

问诸如“下周我什么时候有两个小时的空闲时间？”、“星期四下午有什么事情吗？”之类的问题。或“预订周二 10 点与 Anna 通话。”根据 GDPR 在德国的服务器上运行，并提供数据处理协议。

plugin_asdk_app_69ca45719b948191999f401a.longDescription:
Dropbox Dash brings knowledge from your favorite workplace apps into one secure place. With the Dash app for ChatGPT, you can use that knowledge directly in your conversations.

Ask a question, and Dash pulls in relevant context from across your connected tools to help ChatGPT give more personalized, accurate answers. This means you get useful, actionable responses without leaving your chat.

Dash respects your existing permissions, so only content you have access to is used—keeping your information secure while making it easier to find and use.
plugin_asdk_app_69ca45719b948191999f401a.longDescriptionZh:
Dropbox Dash 将您最喜爱的工作场所应用程序中的知识转移到一个安全的地方。借助适用于 ChatGPT 的 Dash 应用程序，您可以直接在对话中使用这些知识。

提出问题，Dash 会从连接的工具中提取相关上下文，帮助 ChatGPT 提供更加个性化、准确的答案。这意味着您无需离开聊天即可获得有用的、可操作的回复。

Dash 尊重您现有的权限，因此仅使用您有权访问的内容，从而确保您的信息安全，同时使其更易于查找和使用。

plugin_asdk_app_6944fb902e588191a8d2c78c.description: 带视频和旁白的幻灯片
plugin_asdk_app_6944fb902e588191a8d2c78c.productIntro: 一站式人工智能幻灯片应用程序：创建、编辑幻灯片并将其导出为带有画外音的视频，一切都在一个地方完成。 快速将任何主题、文本、PDF 或 URL 转换为专业设计的 PowerPoint 演示文稿。借助人工智能驱动的内容生成，您可以通过对话编辑每个细节，并将您的作品导出为可编辑的 PPTX 或带画外音的视频。
plugin_asdk_app_6944fb902e588191a8d2c78c.productIntroEn: One-stop AI slide app: create, edit, and export slides as videos with voice-overs, all in one place. Quickly turn any topic, text, PDF, or URL into a professionally designed PowerPoint presentation. With AI-powered content generation, you can edit every detail through conversation and export your work as an editable PPTX or a video with voiceover.
plugin_asdk_app_6944fb902e588191a8d2c78c.longDescription:
One-stop AI slide app: create, edit, and export slides as videos with voice-overs, all in one place.
Quickly turn any topic, text, PDF, or URL into a professionally designed PowerPoint presentation. With AI-powered content generation, you can edit every detail through conversation and export your work as an editable PPTX or a video with voiceover. 

Key Features
- Multi-source input: Create presentations from a simple topic, pasted text, an uploaded PDF, or a web URL.
- Automated slide design: The AI builds layouts, selects relevant images, and creates diagrams automatically.
- Conversational editing: Refine slides using natural commands to change the tone, shorten text, or add new sections.
- Precision control: Edit any text manually or ask the AI to revise it. Use your own images or generate new AI visuals.
- Export and share: Download a fully editable .pptx file or export your presentation as a video with embedded narration.

How to Use
1. Connect the Awesome Slides app
2. Type "@" and choose the AI Slides app, or type "AI Slides", then enter your prompt

Examples:
- Awesome Slides create a presentation about the history of AI
- Awesome Slides turn this PDF into a 10-slide deck
- Awesome Slides help me make a presentation for my Q3 marketing strategy
plugin_asdk_app_6944fb902e588191a8d2c78c.longDescriptionZh:
一站式人工智能幻灯片应用程序：创建、编辑幻灯片并将其导出为带有画外音的视频，一切都在一个地方完成。
快速将任何主题、文本、PDF 或 URL 转换为专业设计的 PowerPoint 演示文稿。借助人工智能驱动的内容生成，您可以通过对话编辑每个细节，并将您的作品导出为可编辑的 PPTX 或带画外音的视频。 

主要特点
- 多源输入：从简单的主题、粘贴的文本、上传的 PDF 或 Web URL 创建演示文稿。
- 自动幻灯片设计：人工智能构建布局、选择相关图像并自动创建图表。
- 对话式编辑：使用自然命令更改基调、缩短文本或添加新部分来优化幻灯片。
- 精确控制：手动编辑任何文本或要求人工智能修改。使用您自己的图像或生成新的 AI 视觉效果。
- 导出和共享：下载完全可编辑的 .pptx 文件或将演示文稿导出为嵌入旁白的视频。

如何使用
1. 连接 Awesome Slides 应用程序
2. 输入“@”并选择 AI Slides 应用程序，或输入“AI Slides”，然后输入提示

示例：
- 很棒的幻灯片创建有关人工智能历史的演示
- Awesome Slides 可将此 PDF 变成 10 张幻灯片
- 很棒的幻灯片帮助我演示我的第三季度营销策略
defaultPrompts: Create a 7-day itinerary for Iceland
Change the cover to a night icy sea with aurora.
Create slides from my uploaded document

plugin_asdk_app_6948b1ccbef8819197446148.name: AI Wisebase
plugin_asdk_app_6948b1ccbef8819197446148.productIntro: 一种与您自己的信息聊天的简单方法。
plugin_asdk_app_6948b1ccbef8819197446148.productIntroEn: A Simple Way to Chat with Your Own Information.
plugin_asdk_app_6948b1ccbef8819197446148.longDescription:
A Simple Way to Chat with Your Own Information.

AI Wisebase is your personal knowledge base. It allows you to use your saved files and chat history directly within ChatGPT to generate responses grounded in your own data.

1. Organize Your Files and Chats
Save Chat History: Save important ChatGPT chats as editable documents for future reference.

Upload Files: Add your personal files to your knowledge base to build your private library.

Easy Access: View and access your uploaded files and saved chats in one simple list.

2. Chat with Your Knowledge Base
Grounded Answers: Ask questions and get responses based on your saved data, complete with references to the source content. This helps ChatGPT write reports or summarize topics that matter to you.

3. Specialized Tools for Learning
Video Explanations: Transform concepts into easy-to-follow animations or video summaries.

Knowledge Graphs: Generate interactive knowledge graphs to visualize and explore your saved files and chats.

Study Aids: Turn your saved chats and files into flashcards or quizzes for review.

Document Translation: Translate PDF files and view original and translated text side-by-side.

How to Use:
Connect: Link AI Wisebase to your ChatGPT account.

Add Data: Upload your files or save chat history directly.

Trigger: Type @AI Wisebase followed by your request.

Sample Prompts:
Save History: "@AI Wisebase Save this discussion as a document."

Knowledge Base: "@AI Wisebase Draft a report using my knowledge base."

Knowledge Graph: "@AI Wisebase Generate an interactive knowledge graph for my files."

Video Learning: "@AI Wisebase Create a video explaining this concept."

Quiz/Flashcards: "@AI Wisebase Create flashcards from my saved chats."

Translate: "@AI Wisebase Translate this PDF into English."
plugin_asdk_app_6948b1ccbef8819197446148.longDescriptionZh:
一种与您自己的信息聊天的简单方法。

AI Wisebase 是您的个人知识库。它允许您直接在 ChatGPT 中使用保存的文件和聊天历史记录，以生成基于您自己的数据的响应。

1. 整理您的文件和聊天记录
保存聊天历史记录：将重要的 ChatGPT 聊天记录保存为可编辑文档以供将来参考。

上传文件：将您的个人文件添加到您的知识库中，构建您的私人图书馆。

轻松访问：在一个简单的列表中查看和访问您上传的文件和保存的聊天记录。

2. 与您的知识库聊天
接地答案：根据您保存的数据提出问题并获得答复，并附上对源内容的引用。这有助于 ChatGPT 撰写报告或总结对您重要的主题。

3. 专门的学习工具
视频说明：将概念转化为易于理解的动画或视频摘要。

知识图：生成交互式知识图来可视化和探索您保存的文件和聊天。

学习辅助工具：将您保存的聊天记录和文件变成抽认卡或测验以供复习。

文档翻译：翻译 PDF 文件并并排查看原始文本和翻译文本。

使用方法：
连接：将 AI Wisebase 链接到您的 ChatGPT 帐户。

添加数据：上传文件或直接保存聊天记录。

触发器：输入@AI Wisebase，然后输入您的请求。

提示示例：
保存历史记录：“@AI Wisebase 将此讨论保存为文档。”

知识库：“@AI Wisebase 使用我的知识库起草一份报告。”

知识图：“@AI Wisebase 为我的文件生成交互式知识图。”

视频学习：“@AI Wisebase 创建一个视频来解释这个概念。”

测验/抽认卡：“@AI Wisebase 从我保存的聊天记录中创建抽认卡。”

翻译：“@AI Wisebase 将此 PDF 翻译成英文。”
defaultPrompts: Draft a report on AI Trends using my knowledge base.
Save our discussion about Global Warming.
Show all files in my knowledge base.
defaultPromptsZh: 使用我的知识库起草一份关于人工智能趋势的报告。
保存我们关于全球变暖的讨论。
显示我的知识库中的所有文件。

plugin_asdk_app_69849384749c819188af29a1.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 内无缝管理和转换您的文档。这款一体化 PDF 实用程序可让您以专业的精度立即压缩、转换、合并和编辑文件。 非常适合学生、专业人士以及任何想要快速、可靠的 PDF 解决方案而无需打开其他应用程序的人。
plugin_asdk_app_69849384749c819188af29a1.productIntroEn: Manage and transform your documents seamlessly right inside ChatGPT. This all-in-one PDF utility allows you to compress, convert, merge, and edit your files instantly with professional precision. Ideal for students, professionals, and anyone who wants fast, reliable PDF solutions without opening another app.
plugin_asdk_app_69849384749c819188af29a1.longDescription:
Manage and transform your documents seamlessly right inside ChatGPT. This all-in-one PDF utility allows you to compress, convert, merge, and edit your files instantly with professional precision.
Ideal for students, professionals, and anyone who wants fast, reliable PDF solutions without opening another app.

How to Use
1. Choose your file and tell us what you want to do. (e.g., "@AnyPDF - Your PDF Converter Compress this file") 
2. Allow the upload: ChatGPT will ask for your permission to upload. Press "Upload Document".

Thats all!

Now your file is ready to download

Key features:
- Smart Compression: Choose from three levels—Low, Recommended, or Extreme—to shrink file sizes while maintaining document clarity.
- Universal Converter: Instantly turn Images (JPEG, PNG), Word (DOCX), Excel (XLSX), PowerPoint (PPTX) into PDFs or turn your PDFs into JPG.
- Merge Multiple PDFs: Combine two or more PDF documents into a single, organized file in seconds.
- Extract Specific Pages: Extract the pages you need from any PDF to create a new document.
- Rotate & Align: Fix orientation issues by rotating your PDF pages 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
plugin_asdk_app_69849384749c819188af29a1.longDescriptionZh:
直接在 ChatGPT 内无缝管理和转换您的文档。这款一体化 PDF 实用程序可让您以专业的精度立即压缩、转换、合并和编辑文件。
非常适合学生、专业人士以及任何想要快速、可靠的 PDF 解决方案而无需打开其他应用程序的人。

如何使用
1. 选择您的文件并告诉我们您想要做什么。 （例如，“@AnyPDF - 您的 PDF 转换器压缩此文件”） 
2. 允许上传：ChatGPT 将请求您允许上传。按“上传文档”。

就这样！

现在您的文件已准备好下载

主要特点：
- 智能压缩：从三个级别（低、推荐或极端）中进行选择，以缩小文件大小，同时保持文档清晰度。
- 通用转换器：立即将图像（JPEG、PNG）、Word (DOCX)、Excel (XLSX)、PowerPoint (PPTX) 转换为 PDF 或将 PDF 转换为 JPG。
- 合并多个 PDF：在几秒钟内将两个或多个 PDF 文档合并为一个有组织的文件。
- 提取特定页面：从任何 PDF 中提取您需要的页面以创建新文档。
- 旋转和对齐：通过将 PDF 页面旋转 90、180 或 270 度来解决方向问题。

Create, send, and sign documents directly inside ChatGPT with Jotform Sign. Simply describe what you need, and Jotform generates a signature-ready document you can customize through conversation.

Create contracts, agreements, consent forms, and approval documents in minutes. Add recipients, configure signing order, customize fields, and send documents for e-signature—all without switching between tools. Track document status, manage signature requests, and keep every signing workflow moving from one place.

Perfect for contracts, onboarding, approvals, waivers, and other documents that require signatures.

Key Features:
- Create signature-ready documents from natural language prompts
- Generate contracts, agreements, consent forms, and approval documents
- Customize signature fields, dates, initials, and other fillable fields
- Configure recipients, signing order, and signing workflows
- Send documents for e-signature in just a few clicks
- Track signing status and manage signature requests


Create documents for every signing workflow, including:
- Employment contracts and onboarding documents
- Client agreements and service contracts
- NDAs and confidentiality agreements
- Consent forms and liability waivers
- Sales proposals and approval requests
- Vendor and partnership agreements
- Rental and lease agreements
- Internal policies, acknowledgments, and approvals
plugin_asdk_app_6a3d24829b348191a5008f05.longDescriptionZh:

非常适合合同、入职、批准、豁免和其他需要签名的文件。

主要特点：
- 根据自然语言提示创建可供签名的文档
- 生成合同、协议、同意书和批准文件
- 自定义签名字段、日期、姓名缩写和其他可填写字段
- 配置收件人、签名顺序和签名工作流程
- 只需点击几下即可发送电子签名文档
- 跟踪签名状态并管理签名请求

- 雇佣合同和入职文件

- NDA 和保密协议
- 同意书和责任豁免
- 销售建议和批准请求
- 供应商和合作伙伴协议
- 租赁和租赁协议
- 内部政策、致谢和批准

plugin_asdk_app_6962cc9b20348191b23009f8.productIntro: Dunzo 是一款会话任务助手，可帮助您通过自然对话捕获和组织任务。
plugin_asdk_app_6962cc9b20348191b23009f8.productIntroEn: Dunzo is a conversational task assistant that helps you capture and organize tasks through natural conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6962cc9b20348191b23009f8.longDescription:
Dunzo is a conversational task assistant that helps you capture and organize tasks through natural conversation.

What you can do:
• Capture quick tasks: "remind me to call mom" or "buy milk"
• Manage ongoing lists: groceries, packing lists, movies to watch
• Plan projects: break down bigger goals into steps

Just tell ChatGPT what you need to do, and Dunzo tracks it for you. No forms, no apps to switch between – just chat.

Dunzo is an independent product and is not affiliated with any other companies or services.
plugin_asdk_app_6962cc9b20348191b23009f8.longDescriptionZh:
Dunzo 是一款会话任务助手，可帮助您通过自然对话捕获和组织任务。

你可以做什么：
• 捕捉快速任务：“提醒我给妈妈打电话”或“买牛奶”
• 管理正在进行的清单：杂货、装箱单、要观看的电影
• 规划项目：将更大的目标分解为步骤

只需告诉 ChatGPT 您需要做什么，Dunzo 就会为您跟踪。没有表格，没有可以切换的应用程序——只是聊天。

Dunzo 是一个独立的产品，不隶属于任何其他公司或服务。

plugin_asdk_app_6a112deb1d4881919bde555b.longDescription: XMemo gives ChatGPT a private, persistent workspace that carries useful context across conversations. OAuth and server-enforced scopes restrict every operation to the signed-in user's authorized data, while recoverable deletion, restoration, and explicit confirmation for permanent deletion keep users in control.
