plugin_asdk_app_6a07517af0d48191bde4ae52.name: Lawve
plugin_asdk_app_6a07517af0d48191bde4ae52.productIntro: 使用从业者直接在 ChatGPT 中分享的法律方法和指南。
plugin_asdk_app_6a07517af0d48191bde4ae52.productIntroEn: Use legal methods and guidance shared by practitioners directly in ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a07517af0d48191bde4ae52.longDescription:
Use legal methods and guidance shared by practitioners directly in ChatGPT.

Lawve brings together legal AI skills written by practicing lawyers, in-house counsel, academics, and legal technologists from around the world, covering a wide range of practice areas and jurisdictions. Each skill gives ChatGPT step-by-step instructions for a specific legal task.

 Describe your legal task, and ChatGPT can find a relevant skill on Lawve and apply its author’s methodology directly to your documents or questions.

You can use the Lawve connector to:
    - Challenge an argument: “Find a skill on Lawve to review this legal argument from opposing counsel’s perspective, then identify weaknesses I should address.”
    - Assess an AI system: “Find and apply a skill on Lawve to help classify our recruitment AI tool under the EU AI Act and identify the obligations that follow.”
    - Improve legal writing: “Use a relevant skill on Lawve to make this legal letter clearer and more persuasive, while preserving the facts and my position.”
    - Review against your standards: “Find a skill on Lawve to review this supplier agreement against our negotiation playbook, then flag deviations and suggest changes.”
plugin_asdk_app_6a07517af0d48191bde4ae52.longDescriptionZh:
使用从业者直接在 ChatGPT 中分享的法律方法和指南。

Lawve 汇集了来自世界各地的执业律师、内部法律顾问、学者和法律技术专家撰写的法律人工智能技能，涵盖广泛的执业领域和司法管辖区。每项技能都为 ChatGPT 提供了针对特定法律任务的分步说明。

 描述您的法律任务，ChatGPT 可以在 Lawve 上找到相关技能，并将其作者的方法直接应用于您的文档或问题。

您可以使用 Lawve 连接器来：
    - 质疑一个论点：“在 Lawve 上找到一项技能，从对方律师的角度审查这个法律论点，然后找出我应该解决的弱点。”
    - 评估人工智能系统：“在 Lawve 上查找并应用一项技能，以帮助根据欧盟人工智能法案对我们的招聘人工智能工具进行分类，并确定随之而来的义务。”
    - 改进法律写作：“使用 Lawve 的相关技能使这封法律信件更清晰、更有说服力，同时保留事实和我的立场。”
    - 根据您的标准进行审核：“在 Lawve 上查找一项技能，根据我们的谈判手册审核此供应商协议，然后标记偏差并提出更改建议。”

TasksBoard is a simple, board-style to-do app that keeps all your daily tasks in one place. Create multiple lists side by side - like Work, Personal, Groceries, or any project you're juggling - and see everything at a glance on a clean, distraction-free board.

Add tasks in seconds, break them down with subtasks, set due dates, and add notes for the details you don't want to forget. Drag and drop to reorder or move tasks between lists as your priorities shift. Check things off and enjoy watching your board clear.

Your tasks stay in sync across all your devices, so your list is always up to date whether you're at your desk or on the go. You can also share lists with family, roommates, or teammates to plan and get things done together in real time.

Whether you're organizing your workday, planning a trip, or managing a household, TasksBoard gives you a focused, visual way to stay on top of everything that matters.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5ee36eff388191a1be7e37.longDescriptionZh:

您的任务在所有设备上保持同步，因此无论您是在办公桌前还是在旅途中，您的列表始终是最新的。您还可以与家人、室友或队友共享列表，以便实时计划和共同完成工作。

无论您是在组织工作日、计划旅行还是管理家庭，TasksBoard 都能为您提供一种集中、直观的方式来掌控所有重要的事情。

plugin_asdk_app_69a462cfa7c0819183ea5703.name: Wordy- Highlight+Annotate Text
plugin_asdk_app_69a462cfa7c0819183ea5703.productIntro: 阅读和书写任何带有人工智能突出显示的内容，可以随时解释困难的单词、想法、论点和写作技巧。
plugin_asdk_app_69a462cfa7c0819183ea5703.productIntroEn: Read and write anything with AI highlighting that explains difficult words, ideas, arguments, and writing techniques as you go.
plugin_asdk_app_69a462cfa7c0819183ea5703.longDescription:
Read and write anything with AI highlighting that explains difficult words, ideas, arguments, and writing techniques as you go.

Paste any passage into the chat and get a clean, readable version with highlights that open simple explanations beside the text. Instead of jumping between search results, dictionaries, and websites, you stay focused on what you are reading. Tap a highlighted phrase to see why it matters, what it means, or how it fits into the bigger picture.

The app is built for curiosity. Read literature, history, science, news, speeches, legal writing, essays, research papers, blog posts, and your own drafts. Each annotation is created for the specific passage, so the explanations match the surrounding context instead of giving a one-size-fits-all definition.

Highlights can explain:
• Vocabulary and unfamiliar phrases
• Literary devices and writing techniques
• Themes, symbols, and motifs
• Historical and cultural references
• Character development and motivation
• Arguments, evidence, and reasoning
• Tone, mood, and style
• Grammar and sentence structure
• Rhetorical strategies
• Important facts and key ideas

The reading experience stays simple. The original text remains front and center while annotations appear only where they are useful. Open one note at a time to avoid clutter, or move through every annotation in order. Whether you want a quick answer or a deeper explanation, the information is always close to the text that inspired it.

Students can use the app to prepare for class, review assigned readings, or understand challenging passages before discussions and exams. Teachers can use it to explore different ways of explaining the same text. Lifelong learners can finally tackle books and articles that once felt too difficult.

Writers and editors can also benefit. Paste your own work into the app to see explanations of structure, language, and rhetorical choices. Use the annotations to spot places where readers may need more context or where a sentence could be clearer.

Every passage is different. A line from Shakespeare needs different notes than a scientific article or a court opinion. The app adapts its explanations to the text instead of forcing every document into the same template.

Designed with a clean interface, the app keeps reading comfortable on phones and tablets. Text is easy to scan, annotations are easy to open, and the layout keeps your place while you explore each note.

Whether you are studying for school, preparing for work, learning a new subject, or reading for fun, the app helps you spend less time searching for explanations and more time understanding what you read. Paste a passage, explore the highlights, and discover more in every paragraph.

You decide how much detail you want. Read straight through without interruptions, or pause on any highlight when something catches your attention. Short notes give fast answers. Longer notes connect ideas across the passage and explain why a sentence, quote, or example matters. This makes it easier to build understanding one step at a time instead of feeling overwhelmed.

The app works well for homework, book clubs, workplace training, language practice, and personal reading goals. If you enjoy asking questions while you read, this app brings those answers directly into the page. It can help you recognize patterns, follow complex arguments, remember important details, and appreciate strong writing.

Features include:
• Paste almost any text
• AI-generated contextual annotations
• Clear highlighted passages
• Simple side-by-side explanations
• Easy navigation between notes

该应用程序是为了满足好奇心而构建的。阅读文学、历史、科学、新闻、演讲、法律写作、论文、研究论文、博客文章和您自己的草稿。每个注释都是针对特定段落创建的，因此解释与周围的上下文相匹配，而不是给出一刀切的定义。

亮点可以解释：
• 词汇和不熟悉的短语

阅读体验保持简单。原始文本保留在前面和中间，而注释仅出现在有用的地方。一次打开一个注释以避免混乱，或按顺序浏览每个注释。无论您想要快速答案还是更深入的解释，信息总是接近激发它的文本。

学生可以使用该应用程序准备课堂、复习指定的阅读材料或在讨论和考试前理解具有挑战性的段落。教师可以用它来探索解释同一文本的不同方式。终身学习者终于可以解决曾经觉得太困难的书籍和文章了。

作家和编辑也可以受益。将您自己的作品粘贴到应用程序中以查看结构、语言和修辞选择的解释。使用注释来找出读者可能需要更多上下文或句子可以更清晰的地方。

每一段都是不同的。莎士比亚的一句话需要与科学文章或法庭意见不同的注释。该应用程序会根据文本调整其解释，而不是强制每个文档都使用相同的模板。
该应用程序采用简洁的界面设计，可在手机和平板电脑上保持舒适的阅读体验。文本易于浏览，注释易于打开，并且布局可在您探索每个笔记时保持您的位置。

plugin_asdk_app_6a2ab6b4009c8191b74cb3b2.name: Fibery
plugin_asdk_app_6a2ab6b4009c8191b74cb3b2.productIntro: 一旦 Fibery MCP 连接到您的工作空间，OpenAI 几乎可以做您自己在 Fibery 中可以做的任何事情 - 读取和写入数据，或重塑您的工作空间结构。
plugin_asdk_app_6a2ab6b4009c8191b74cb3b2.productIntroEn: Once Fibery MCP is connected to your workspace, OpenAI can do almost anything you can do in Fibery yourself — read and write data, or reshape your workspace structure.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2ab6b4009c8191b74cb3b2.longDescription:
Once Fibery MCP is connected to your workspace, OpenAI can do almost anything you can do in Fibery yourself — read and write data, or reshape your workspace structure.

1. Read & query
Explore your workspace structure (spaces, databases, fields), query any database with filtering, sorting, and sub-queries, run full-text search across entities, documents, and comments, inspect activity history (who changed what, and when), and pull data from saved views with their filters applied.

2. Create & update
Create, update, and delete entities, move them through workflow states, assign people and link related records, write documents, add comments, and attach files.

3. Modify structure
Create spaces and databases, add fields of any type available in Fibery (including formulas), and build views — boards, timelines, calendars, gantt charts, forms, and more.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2ab6b4009c8191b74cb3b2.longDescriptionZh:
一旦 Fibery MCP 连接到您的工作空间，OpenAI 几乎可以做您自己在 Fibery 中可以做的任何事情 - 读取和写入数据，或重塑您的工作空间结构。

1.读取&查询
探索您的工作区结构（空间、数据库、字段），通过过滤、排序和子查询查询任何数据库，跨实体、文档和注释运行全文搜索，检查活动历史记录（谁更改了什么以及何时更改），并从应用了过滤器的已保存视图中提取数据。

2. 创建和更新
创建、更新和删除实体，在工作流状态中移动它们，分配人员并链接相关记录，编写文档，添加注释和附加文件。

3.修改结构
创建空间和数据库，添加 Fibery 中可用的任何类型的字段（包括公式），并构建视图 - 看板、时间线、日历、甘特图、表单等。

plugin_asdk_app_69b144385fe481919993cbb4.description: 自动化电子签名工作流程
plugin_asdk_app_69b144385fe481919993cbb4.productIntro: 无需切换工具即可更快地签署文档。 SignNow MCP 服务器将 Codex 直接连接到您的 SignNow 帐户，让您可以通过对话管理整个电子签名工作流程。发送签名请求、从模板创建文档并预填充它们、跟踪邀请状态以及检索签名文​​件 - 所有这些都通过用简单的语言描述您的需求来实现。无论您是在处理合同、协议还是审批，Codex 都会处理 SignNow 操作，以便您可以专注于工作而不是追逐签名。
plugin_asdk_app_69b144385fe481919993cbb4.productIntroEn: Get documents signed faster without switching between tools. The SignNow MCP server connects Codex directly to your SignNow account, letting you manage the entire eSignature workflow through conversation. Send signature requests, create documents from templates and pre-fill them, track invite statuses, and retrieve signed files — all by describing what you need in plain language.
plugin_asdk_app_69b144385fe481919993cbb4.longDescription:
Get documents signed faster without switching between tools. The SignNow MCP server connects Codex directly to your SignNow account, letting you manage the entire eSignature workflow through conversation. Send signature requests, create documents from templates and pre-fill them, track invite statuses, and retrieve signed files — all by describing what you need in plain language. Whether you're handling contracts, agreements, or approvals, Codex handles the SignNow actions so you can focus on your work instead of chasing signatures.

You can use SignNow to:

Create and Send Documents:
"Create a document from the Employee NDA template and send it to client@example.com for signature"

Track Signing Status:
"Check the signing status of the Sales Agreement and show me any pending signatures"

Manage Templates:
"List all available templates and create a new contract from the Service Agreement template"

Download Signed Documents:
"Get the download link for the completed Employment Contract"

您可以使用 SignNow 来：

创建和发送文档：
“从员工 NDA 模板创建文档并将其发送至 client@example.com 进行签名”

“检查销售协议的签署状态并向我显示任何待处理的签名”

plugin_asdk_app_6a17fa4d3fb88191b6883b3e.name: ConvertAPI
plugin_asdk_app_6a17fa4d3fb88191b6883b3e.description: 文件转换和 PDF 工具
plugin_asdk_app_6a17fa4d3fb88191b6883b3e.productIntro: ConvertAPI 直接在 ChatGPT 对话中转换、处理和提取 500 多种格式的文件中的数据。上传文件，描述您想要的内容，然后获取结果以供下载。
plugin_asdk_app_6a17fa4d3fb88191b6883b3e.productIntroEn: ConvertAPI converts, processes, and extracts data from files in over 500 formats - directly in your ChatGPT conversation. Upload a file, describe what you want, and get the result back ready to download.
plugin_asdk_app_6a17fa4d3fb88191b6883b3e.longDescription:
ConvertAPI converts, processes, and extracts data from files in over 500 formats - directly in your ChatGPT conversation. Upload a file, describe what you want, and get the result back ready to download.

Convert between PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images, HTML, eBooks, and email formats. Turn a PDF into an editable Word doc, a PowerPoint into images, a webpage into PDF, or scanned pages into searchable text.

Edit and combine PDFs: merge multiple files, split by page or bookmark, rotate, delete pages, add watermarks, or repair corrupted documents.

Secure and optimize: compress PDFs by up to 90%, add password protection, redact sensitive information with AI, or convert to PDF/A for archiving.

Extract text, tables, images, form data, and email attachments from your documents.

Generate new DOCX or PDF files from templates and data, compare documents, or bundle files into password-protected ZIP archives.
Powered by the ConvertAPI platform - trusted by thousands of developers and businesses for document automation since 2013.
plugin_asdk_app_6a17fa4d3fb88191b6883b3e.longDescriptionZh:
ConvertAPI 直接在 ChatGPT 对话中转换、处理和提取 500 多种格式的文件中的数据。上传文件，描述您想要的内容，然后获取结果以供下载。

在 PDF、Word、Excel、PowerPoint、图像、HTML、电子书和电子邮件格式之间进行转换。将 PDF 转换为可编辑的 Word 文档，将 PowerPoint 转换为图像，将网页转换为 PDF，或将扫描的页面转换为可搜索文本。

编辑和合并 PDF：合并多个文件、按页面或书签分割、旋转、删除页面、添加水印或修复损坏的文档。

安全和优化：将 PDF 压缩高达 90%、添加密码保护、使用 AI 编辑敏感信息或转换为 PDF/A 进行存档。

从文档中提取文本、表格、图像、表单数据和电子邮件附件。

从模板和数据生成新的 DOCX 或 PDF 文件、比较文档或将文件捆绑到受密码保护的 ZIP 存档中。
由 ConvertAPI 平台提供支持 - 自 2013 年以来在文档自动化方面受到数千名开发人员和企业的信赖。

plugin_asdk_app_69497cc4f0e481919268b8b2.productIntro: 直接在聊天中跟踪任何网站上的更改。 要求 Visualping 监视页面并在发生变化时收到通知。
plugin_asdk_app_69497cc4f0e481919268b8b2.productIntroEn: Track changes on any website directly in chat. Ask Visualping to monitor a page and get notified when something changes.
plugin_asdk_app_69497cc4f0e481919268b8b2.longDescription:
Track changes on any website directly in chat.  Ask Visualping to monitor a page and get notified when something changes.

Visualping highlights exactly what changed with before-and-after comparisons, so you can review updates quickly without rechecking pages manually. Use it to track competitor sites, price drops, job listings, product launches, policy pages, and more.

Try a conversation like this to get started:
- Monitor this page for changes
- Check this product page daily and alert me if the price changes
- Notify me when this job posting is updated
- Alert me if anything changes on this competitor page

For more control, open Visualping to customize monitoring settings, notification channels, and alert frequency.
plugin_asdk_app_69497cc4f0e481919268b8b2.longDescriptionZh:
直接在聊天中跟踪任何网站上的更改。  要求 Visualping 监视页面并在发生变化时收到通知。

可视化可准确突出显示前后比较的变化，因此您可以快速查看更新，而无需手动重新检查页面。用它来跟踪竞争对手的网站、降价、职位列表、产品发布、政策页面等。

尝试这样的对话来开始：
- 监视此页面的更改
- 每天检查此产品页面，如果价格发生变化提醒我
- 当此职位发布更新时通知我
- 如果此竞争对手页面有任何变化，请通知我

如需更多控制，请打开 Visualping 以自定义监控设置、通知渠道和警报频率。

Pause all github monitors

plugin_asdk_app_6a50b512751081918251e323.description: 小説執筆支援と設定資料の管理
plugin_asdk_app_6a50b512751081918251e323.originalDescription: 小説執筆支援と設定資料の管理
plugin_asdk_app_6a50b512751081918251e323.productIntro: NoveLand：小説執筆支援と設定資料の管理。
plugin_asdk_app_6a50b512751081918251e323.productIntroEn: NoveLandは、物語を書くためのエディタと、書いた小説を公開して読める投稿サイトを兼ねたサービスです。本アプリを繋ぐと、NoveLandに置いてある作品のデータをChatGPTの会話から直接読み書きできます。
plugin_asdk_app_6a50b512751081918251e323.longDescription:
NoveLandは、物語を書くためのエディタと、書いた小説を公開して読める投稿サイトを兼ねたサービスです。本アプリを繋ぐと、NoveLandに置いてある作品のデータをChatGPTの会話から直接読み書きできます。

扱えるのは、作品・章・エピソード・キャラクター・用語・ドキュメント・相関図・伏線です。ユーザーは自分の非公開ワークスペースにて、キャラクターや用語の設定を整理しながら物語構造を作品内で一貫して管理できます。

登録済みのキャラクター・用語・エピソードから、その場で図を組み立てることもできます。関係性のグラフ、時間軸の図、棒グラフ・折れ線グラフ、家系図の4種類です。描いた図は会話の中で見るためのもので、作品には保存されません。
plugin_asdk_app_6a50b512751081918251e323.longDescriptionZh:
（翻译待补，以下为官方英文原文。）

NoveLandは、物語を書くためのエディタと、書いた小説を公開して読める投稿サイトを兼ねたサービスです。本アプリを繋ぐと、NoveLandに置いてある作品のデータをChatGPTの会話から直接読み書きできます。

扱えるのは、作品・章・エピソード・キャラクター・用語・ドキュメント・相関図・伏線です。ユーザーは自分の非公開ワークスペースにて、キャラクターや用語の設定を整理しながら物語構造を作品内で一貫して管理できます。

登録済みのキャラクター・用語・エピソードから、その場で図を組み立てることもできます。関係性のグラフ、時間軸の図、棒グラフ・折れ線グラフ、家系図の4種類です。描いた図は会話の中で見るためのもので、作品には保存されません。
defaultPrompts: 登録してある作品の最初の10話に絞って、主要な登場人物5人の在籍と関係の変化を、話数を横軸にした時間軸図にしてください。
登録してある作品に出てくる一族の血縁と婚姻を家系図にしてください。養子や、名前が伏せられた人物も線で描き分けてください。
登録してある作品の最新話の本文を、発言者のアイコン付きで読める状態で開いてください。

plugin_asdk_app_69ef9cc43ab08191b57469d9.productIntro: 无需离开 ChatGPT 即可创建表单并管理您的数据。描述您需要的表单并立即构建它，然后查询提交的内容，提取文件和文档，并在收到回复时进行条目更改。无论您是要设置新的受理表单、检查待处理的申请还是检索已签名的文档，您的表单数据都在您需要时就在那里。
plugin_asdk_app_69ef9cc43ab08191b57469d9.productIntroEn: Create forms and manage your data without leaving ChatGPT. Describe the form you need and build it instantly, then query submissions, pull files and documents, and make entry changes as responses come in. Whether you're setting up a new intake form, checking on pending applications, or retrieving a signed document, your form data is right there when you need it.
plugin_asdk_app_69ef9cc43ab08191b57469d9.longDescription:
Create forms and manage your data without leaving ChatGPT. Describe the form you need and build it instantly, then query submissions, pull files and documents, and make entry changes as responses come in. Whether you're setting up a new intake form, checking on pending applications, or retrieving a signed document, your form data is right there when you need it.

Available on Pro, Team, and Enterprise plans. Setting up the connector requires Administrator access in your Cognito Forms organization.


Example prompts:
* Build - "Create a new client intake form with fields for contact information, case type, and a file upload for supporting documents."
* Write — "Create a new entry on the Employee Onboarding form for Sarah Chen. She starts Monday in the Columbia office."
* File retrieval — "Download the signed agreement from entry 6 on the Contractor Onboarding form."
* Form management — "Close the Fall Enrollment form and set the message to 'Enrollment is now closed for this term.'"
* Analysis — "How many invoices are still outstanding in the Client Billing form?"
plugin_asdk_app_69ef9cc43ab08191b57469d9.longDescriptionZh:
无需离开 ChatGPT 即可创建表单并管理您的数据。描述您需要的表单并立即构建它，然后查询提交的内容，提取文件和文档，并在收到回复时进行条目更改。无论您是要设置新的受理表单、检查待处理的申请还是检索已签名的文档，您的表单数据都在您需要时就在那里。

适用于专业版、团队版和企业版计划。设置连接器需要 Cognito Forms 组织中的管理员访问权限。


提示示例：
* 构建 - “创建一个新的客户接收表格，其中包含联系信息、案例类型和支持文档的文件上传字段。”
* 写入 — “在 Sarah Chen 的员工入职表格上创建一个新条目。她周一在哥伦比亚办公室上班。”
* 文件检索 — “下载承包商入职表格第 6 项中已签署的协议。”
* 表单管理 —“关闭秋季注册表单并将消息设置为‘本学期的注册现已关闭。’”
* 分析 — “客户账单表格中有多少张发票尚未结清？”

plugin_asdk_app_6a270c13971481919912d877.name: TwinMind
plugin_asdk_app_6a270c13971481919912d877.productIntro: TwinMind 捕捉您在会议、讲座和面对面对话中所说和听到的一切。它自动转录、总结、主动提供建议和任务，并持续为您的人工智能第二大脑构建上下文。 TwinMind 是一款利用人工智能作为您的第二大脑的生产力工具。它捕捉了听到、看到和说过的一切——随着您与 TwinMind 的互动和参与越多，它就会与您一起成长，从而构建您数字生活的全面背景。
plugin_asdk_app_6a270c13971481919912d877.productIntroEn: TwinMind captures everything you say and hear in your meetings, lectures, and in-person conversations. It automatically transcribes, summarizes, proactively offers suggestions and tasks, and continuously builds context for your AI Second Brain. TwinMind is a productivity tool leveraging AI to function as your second brain.
plugin_asdk_app_6a270c13971481919912d877.longDescription:
TwinMind captures everything you say and hear in your meetings, lectures, and in-person conversations. It automatically transcribes, summarizes, proactively offers suggestions and tasks, and continuously builds context for your AI Second Brain.
TwinMind is a productivity tool leveraging AI to function as your second brain. It captures everything heard, seen, and said—growing with you the more you interact and engage with TwinMind to build a comprehensive context of your digital life. This captured context enables several key features:
Personalized and Proactive Assistance: TwinMind provides tailored suggestions and ideas based on your captured memories, anticipating needs and offering relevant insights.
Streamlined Productivity: It enhances your notetaking by having your AI assistant automate tasks such as generating summaries and action items from meetings and conversations. You can search their entire memory bank, ask questions, generate emails and study guides, investor memos, project plans, and more.
Privacy Focus: TwinMind prioritizes user privacy through on-device transcription, options to save transcripts locally or on the cloud. We're committed to zero third-party data sharing. Audio is processed on-the-fly and never stored.
Key Features and Functionality:

Capture and Context Building: Captures your activity (audio, visual, text) on mobile and desktop if partnered with the TwinMind chrome extension.
Personalized Suggestions: Your AI sidekick will offer tailored insights based on captured memories.
Automated Summaries and Action Items: Extracts key information from meetings, conversations, and class lectures.
Searchable Memory Bank: Allows you to search your captured history and notes.
Ask TwinMind Anything: Enables you to ask questions and receive answers with context of your memories or active meetings.
Content Generation: Facilitates the creation of follow up emails, study guides, and other documents to help increase your productivity.
Privacy Protection: Employs on-device transcription, choice to switch to private mode to store transcriptions locally, and no third-party data sharing.

TwinMind aims to boost your productivity by providing a centralized, AI-powered platform that captures, organizes, and leverages your captured memories to offer personalized assistance and automate tasks, all while safeguarding your privacy.
plugin_asdk_app_6a270c13971481919912d877.longDescriptionZh:
TwinMind 捕捉您在会议、讲座和面对面对话中所说和听到的一切。它自动转录、总结、主动提供建议和任务，并持续为您的人工智能第二大脑构建上下文。
TwinMind 是一款利用人工智能作为您的第二大脑的生产力工具。它捕捉了听到、看到和说过的一切——随着您与 TwinMind 的互动和参与越多，它就会与您一起成长，从而构建您数字生活的全面背景。捕获的上下文可实现以下几个关键功能：
个性化和主动的帮助：TwinMind 根据您捕获的记忆、预测需求并提供相关见解提供量身定制的建议和想法。
简化生产力：它通过让人工智能助手自动执行任务（例如从会议和对话中生成摘要和行动项目）来增强您的笔记记录。您可以搜索他们的整个记忆库、提出问题、生成电子邮件和学习指南、投资者备忘录、项目计划等。
隐私关注：TwinMind 通过设备上转录以及在本地或云端保存转录的选项来优先考虑用户隐私。我们致力于零第三方数据共享。音频是即时处理的并且从不存储。
主要特性和功能：

捕获和上下文构建：如果与 TwinMind chrome 扩展程序配合使用，则可以在移动设备和桌面上捕获您的活动（音频、视觉、文本）。
个性化建议：您的人工智能助手将根据捕获的记忆提供量身定制的见解。
自动摘要和行动项目：从会议、对话和课堂讲座中提取关键信息。
可搜索记忆库：允许您搜索捕获的历史记录和笔记。
询问 TwinMind 任何问题：使您能够根据您的记忆或正在进行的会议提出问题并获得答案。
内容生成：帮助创建后续电子邮件、学习指南和其他文档，以帮助提高您的工作效率。
隐私保护：采用设备上转录，选择切换到隐私模式以在本地存储转录，并且不共享第三方数据。

TwinMind 旨在通过提供一个集中式、人工智能驱动的平台来提高您的工作效率，该平台捕获、组织和利用您捕获的记忆来提供个性化帮助和自动化任务，同时保护您的隐私。

plugin_asdk_app_6a513c881f9881919ee9565b.name: Kamai
plugin_asdk_app_6a513c881f9881919ee9565b.productIntro: Kamai 是一个为承包商、分包商、估算员和施工团队构建的人工智能蓝图分析和施工起飞平台。
plugin_asdk_app_6a513c881f9881919ee9565b.productIntroEn: Kamai is an AI blueprint analysis and construction takeoff platform built for contractors, subcontractors, estimators, and construction teams.
plugin_asdk_app_6a513c881f9881919ee9565b.longDescription:
Kamai is an AI blueprint analysis and construction takeoff platform built for contractors, subcontractors, estimators, and construction teams.

Kamai helps users extract quantities, measurements, materials, rooms, fixtures, and scope information directly from construction drawings and project documents. Contractors can use Kamai to estimate jobs faster, prepare bids, calculate material requirements, answer questions about blueprints, and reduce hours of manual takeoff work.

Kamai supports interior construction and finish trades such as:

* Painting and coatings
* Drywall and sheetrock
* Insulation
* Metal and wood framing
* Flooring
* Ceilings
* Doors, windows, and room measurements

Kamai also supports additional construction trades and building systems, including:

* Electrical
* Plumbing
* Fixtures and equipment
* General construction quantities

Users can upload blueprints and ask questions such as:

* How many square feet of flooring are required?
* How much wall area needs to be painted?
* How many sheets of drywall are needed?
* How much insulation and framing material is required?
* How many doors, sinks, toilets, outlets, or fixtures are shown?
* What materials should be ordered for this project?
* What is included in the project scope?
* Can you generate a takeoff from these drawings?

Kamai converts static construction documents into structured, AI-readable project data that can support estimating, bidding, purchasing, RFIs, cost planning, and project execution.

For contractors who need to review drawings, estimate construction work, order materials, or complete more bids in less time, Kamai provides an AI-powered way to understand project documents and turn blueprint data into actionable quantities.
plugin_asdk_app_6a513c881f9881919ee9565b.longDescriptionZh:
Kamai 是一个为承包商、分包商、估算员和施工团队构建的人工智能蓝图分析和施工起飞平台。

Kamai 帮助用户直接从施工图和项目文档中提取数量、测量值、材料、房间、固定装置和范围信息。承包商可以使用 Kamai 更快地估算工作、准备标书、计算材料需求、回答有关蓝图的问题，并减少手动起飞工作的时间。

Kamai 支持室内建筑和装修行业，例如：

* 油漆和涂料
* 干墙和石膏板
* 绝缘
* 金属和木框架
* 地板
* 天花板
* 门、窗和房间的尺寸

Kamai 还支持其他建筑行业和建筑系统，包括：

* 电气
* 管道
* 固定装置和设备
* 一般工程量

用户可以上传蓝图并提出以下问题：

* 需要多少平方英尺的地板？
* 需要粉刷多少墙壁面积？
* 需要多少块干墙？
* 需要多少绝缘材料和框架材料？
* 显示了多少个门、水槽、厕所、插座或固定装置？
* 该项目应订购哪些材料？
* 项目范围包括哪些内容？
* 你能从这些图纸中生成一个起飞图吗？

Kamai 将静态施工文档转换为结构化、人工智能可读的项目数据，可支持估算、投标、采购、RFI、成本规划和项目执行。

对于需要审查图纸、估算施工工作、订购材料或在更短的时间内完成更多投标的承包商，Kamai 提供了一种人工智能驱动的方式来理解项目文档并将蓝图数据转化为可操作的数量。

defaultPromptsZh: 打开卡迈

plugin_asdk_app_6a0c1f321c648191b559d12c.name: Carryo
plugin_asdk_app_6a0c1f321c648191b559d12c.productIntro: Carryo 将您在 ChatGPT 中构建的内容转变为真实的实时网页。在聊天中创建演示文稿、幻灯片、提案、报告、登陆页面、仪表板、邀请函、作品集或单页网站，然后说“发布此内容” - Carryo 托管 HTML 并在几秒钟内返回可共享链接。
plugin_asdk_app_6a0c1f321c648191b559d12c.productIntroEn: Carryo turns what you build in ChatGPT into real, live web pages. Create a presentation, slide deck, proposal, report, landing page, dashboard, invitation, portfolio, or one-page website in chat, then say 'publish this' - Carryo hosts the HTML and hands back a shareable link in seconds.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0c1f321c648191b559d12c.longDescription:
Carryo turns what you build in ChatGPT into real, live web pages. Create a presentation, slide deck, proposal, report, landing page, dashboard, invitation, portfolio, or one-page website in chat, then say 'publish this' - Carryo hosts the HTML and hands back a shareable link in seconds. 

No hosting setup, domain, or deployment pipeline needed. Update a published page while keeping the same URL, host images alongside it, browse version history and restore earlier versions, list everything you've published, and take a link offline the moment you want it gone. Want to review before going live? Create a private draft and publish it from Carryo when you're ready.

Carryo is the easiest way to turn your AI creation into a shareable link.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0c1f321c648191b559d12c.longDescriptionZh:
Carryo 将您在 ChatGPT 中构建的内容转变为真实的实时网页。在聊天中创建演示文稿、幻灯片、提案、报告、登陆页面、仪表板、邀请函、作品集或单页网站，然后说“发布此内容” - Carryo 托管 HTML 并在几秒钟内返回可共享链接。 

无需托管设置、域或部署管道。更新已发布的页面，同时保持相同的 URL，在其旁边托管图像，浏览版本历史记录并恢复早期版本，列出您已发布的所有内容，并在您希望链接消失时将其脱机。想要在上线前进行审核吗？创建私人草稿并在准备好后从 Carryo 发布。

Carryo 是将您的 AI 创作转变为可共享链接的最简单方法。

plugin_asdk_app_6a2778c220848191856aa589.name: Post Metadata Extractor
plugin_asdk_app_6a2778c220848191856aa589.productIntro: 帖子元数据提取器从社交媒体发布请求中提取结构化元数据字段。
plugin_asdk_app_6a2778c220848191856aa589.productIntroEn: Post Metadata Extractor extracts structured metadata fields from social media posting requests.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2778c220848191856aa589.longDescription:
Post Metadata Extractor extracts structured metadata fields from social media posting requests.

It receives submitted social post request text and returns platform, post time, topic, asset requirements, missing fields, source text, and errors.

The app is read-only and stateless. It does not write social posts, publish posts, schedule posts, recommend platforms, create assets, contact external services, or perform operational actions. It only processes the submitted text for the current request.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2778c220848191856aa589.longDescriptionZh:
帖子元数据提取器从社交媒体发布请求中提取结构化元数据字段。

它接收提交的社交帖子请求文本并返回平台、发布时间、主题、资产要求、缺失字段、源文本和错误。

该应用程序是只读且无状态的。它不撰写社交帖子、发布帖子、安排帖子、推荐平台、创建资产、联系外部服务或执行操作操作。它仅处理当前请求的提交文本。

plugin_asdk_app_6a2e3ae94af4819190469f35.name: smarts.bio: AI for biology
plugin_asdk_app_6a2e3ae94af4819190469f35.productIntro: smarts.bio 将真正的生物信息学平台引入 ChatGPT。用简单的英语描述您的分析，并根据您自己的数据运行实际的工具和管道 - 无需编写脚本或设置。
plugin_asdk_app_6a2e3ae94af4819190469f35.productIntroEn: smarts.bio brings a real bioinformatics platform into ChatGPT. Describe your analysis in plain English and run actual tools and pipelines on your own data — no scripting or setup required.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2e3ae94af4819190469f35.longDescription:
smarts.bio brings a real bioinformatics platform into ChatGPT. Describe your analysis in plain English and run actual tools and pipelines on your own data — no scripting or setup required.

What you can do:
* Run sequence searches and analyses — BLAST, GC content, ORFs, domains, and more across DNA, RNA, and protein
* Call and annotate variants, align reads (WES, RNA-seq), and run quality-control and other multi-step pipelines
* Upload and manage workspace files, then open results — FASTA, BAM, VCF, PDB, CSV — in interactive viewers
* Search genes, literature, and patents alongside your analysis

Who it's for: biologists, bioinformaticians, computational biologists, and researchers who'd rather describe an analysis than wire up the tooling.

Connect your smarts.bio account to get started. Long-running jobs keep working in the background, and your files stay in your own workspace.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2e3ae94af4819190469f35.longDescriptionZh:
smarts.bio 将真正的生物信息学平台引入 ChatGPT。用简单的英语描述您的分析，并根据您自己的数据运行实际的工具和管道 - 无需编写脚本或设置。

你可以做什么：
* 运行序列搜索和分析 - BLAST、GC 含量、ORF、结构域等，涵盖 DNA、RNA 和蛋白质
* 调用和注释变体、比对读数（WES、RNA-seq）并运行质量控制和其他多步骤流程
* 上传和管理工作区文件，然后在交互式查看器中打开结果 - FASTA、BAM、VCF、PDB、CSV
* 在分析的同时搜索基因、文献和专利

适用对象：生物学家、生物信息学家、计算生物学家以及宁愿描述分析而不是连接工具的研究人员。

连接您的 smarts.bio 帐户即可开始。长时间运行的作业继续在后台运行，并且您的文件保留在您自己的工作区中。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3bb7f0f6208191883a03a9.name: Mygentic
plugin_asdk_app_6a3bb7f0f6208191883a03a9.description: 与您的工作应用程序聊天
plugin_asdk_app_6a3bb7f0f6208191883a03a9.productIntro: MyGentic 连接您的工作应用程序，帮助您从一个地方搜索、理解您的个人工作知识并采取行动。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3bb7f0f6208191883a03a9.productIntroEn: MyGentic connects your work apps and helps you search, understand, and act on your personal work knowledge from one place.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3bb7f0f6208191883a03a9.longDescription:
MyGentic connects your work apps and helps you search, understand, and act on your personal work knowledge from one place.

Users can connect tools like Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar, Slack, Notion, Zoom, and LinkedIn, then ask natural-language questions across their synced information. MyGentic helps users find emails, documents, meetings, notes, contacts, tasks, and important context without switching between multiple apps.

It is useful for summarizing recent work activity, finding important files or conversations, preparing for meetings, recalling past decisions, and getting answers from connected workplace data.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3bb7f0f6208191883a03a9.longDescriptionZh:
MyGentic 连接您的工作应用程序，帮助您从一个地方搜索、理解您的个人工作知识并采取行动。

用户可以连接 Gmail、Google Drive、日历、Slack、Notion、Zoom 和 LinkedIn 等工具，然后通过同步信息提出自然语言问题。 MyGentic 可帮助用户查找电子邮件、文档、会议、笔记、联系人、任务和重要上下文，而无需在多个应用程序之间切换。

它对于总结最近的工作活动、查找重要文件或对话、准备会议、回忆过去的决定以及从互联的工作场所数据中获取答案非常有用。

plugin_asdk_app_6a62cbc0ff488191890ba637.productIntro: UseMyContext 为 ChatGPT 提供了用户自己的上下文：他们是谁的编译配置文件、工作和个人生活的单独配置文件、它可以阅读的上传文档以及引用的答案和精确的表查询，以及其他人故意与他们共享的上下文。除了一个工具之外，每个工具都是可读的： suggest_update 会在 UseMyContext.ai 上提交用户亲自审阅的未决建议，而 ChatGPT 中的任何内容都无法修改他们的个人资料或文件。
plugin_asdk_app_6a62cbc0ff488191890ba637.productIntroEn: UseMyContext gives ChatGPT the user's own context: a compiled profile of who they are, separate profiles for work and personal life, uploaded documents it can read with cited answers and exact table queries, and contexts other people have deliberately shared with them. Every tool is a read except one: suggest_update files a pending suggestion the user reviews personally on UseMyContext.
plugin_asdk_app_6a62cbc0ff488191890ba637.longDescription: UseMyContext gives ChatGPT the user's own context: a compiled profile of who they are, separate profiles for work and personal life, uploaded documents it can read with cited answers and exact table queries, and contexts other people have deliberately shared with them. plugin_asdk_app_6944288d82108191a97261e0.productIntro: 网络解决方案域搜索助手可以快速、简单且对话式地查找可用域。用户无需一次搜索一个名称，而是可以用简单的语言描述他们的想法，并立即检查相关扩展中的域可用性。该助理可帮助完善名称、提出替代方案并快速识别准备注册的选项。
plugin_asdk_app_6944288d82108191a97261e0.productIntroEn: The Network Solutions Domain Search Assistant makes finding an available domain fast, simple, and conversational. Instead of searching one name at a time, users can describe their idea in plain language and instantly check domain availability across relevant extensions. The assistant helps refine names, suggest alternatives, and quickly identify options that are ready to register.
plugin_asdk_app_6944288d82108191a97261e0.longDescription:
The Network Solutions Domain Search Assistant makes finding an available domain fast, simple, and conversational. Instead of searching one name at a time, users can describe their idea in plain language and instantly check domain availability across relevant extensions. The assistant helps refine names, suggest alternatives, and quickly identify options that are ready to register.

Built to remove friction and frustration from domain discovery, this chat-powered experience keeps users moving forward when names are taken and surfaces smarter, brand-ready options in real time. Whether you’re launching a business, starting a personal project, or exploring new ideas, Network Solutions helps you go from concept to available domain with confidence.

plugin_asdk_app_6a39991eaf2c8191b1409835.name: KaiCalls
plugin_asdk_app_6a39991eaf2c8191b1409835.description: 人工智能接听您的业务电话
plugin_asdk_app_6a39991eaf2c8191b1409835.productIntro: KaiCalls 将您的人工智能连接到您的商务电话系统。要求它读取您最近的通话和文字记录，检查线索、语音邮件、文本、活动和通话分析，并通过您自己的 KaiCalls 代理拨打外线电话。一切都仅限于您自己的帐户，因此助手可以处理您真实的手机活动，而不是封闭的仪表板。阅读工具可以回答诸如今天谁打电话、他们想要什么以及哪些线索是热门等问题；当您要求时，单一操作工具可以让您自己的客服人员回拨电话。
plugin_asdk_app_6a39991eaf2c8191b1409835.productIntroEn: KaiCalls connects your AI to your business phone system. Ask it to read your recent calls and transcripts, check leads, voicemails, texts, campaigns, and call analytics, and place outbound calls through your own KaiCalls agent. Everything is scoped to your own account, so the assistant works with your real phone activity instead of a closed dashboard.
plugin_asdk_app_6a39991eaf2c8191b1409835.longDescription: KaiCalls connects your AI to your business phone system. Ask it to read your recent calls and transcripts, check leads, voicemails, texts, campaigns, and call analytics, and place outbound calls through your own KaiCalls agent. Everything is scoped to your own account, so the assistant works with your real phone activity instead of a closed dashboard. The read tools answer questions like who called today, what did they want, and which leads are hot; the single action tool can have your own agent call a lead back when you ask it to.

plugin_asdk_app_6a734e45d6ec8191bd6425b6.productIntro: Fieldy 允许用户检索和查看他们在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中记录的真实对话。用户可以浏览最近的对话或特定日期范围，打开对话及其记录，并检查确切的记录行。所有可用的工具都是只读的。
plugin_asdk_app_6a734e45d6ec8191bd6425b6.productIntroEn: Fieldy lets users retrieve and review their recorded real-world conversations in ChatGPT and Codex. plugin_asdk_app_6a571a2e0e7c819184208e1c.name: DeeplyClear
plugin_asdk_app_6a571a2e0e7c819184208e1c.description: 创建可共享的思维导图
plugin_asdk_app_6a571a2e0e7c819184208e1c.productIntro: DeeplyClear 是一款交互式思维导图和视觉思维工具，可将复杂的想法、对话、研究、笔记、计划、文档和代码库转换为可编辑、可共享的思维导图和视觉知识图。
plugin_asdk_app_6a571a2e0e7c819184208e1c.productIntroEn: DeeplyClear is an interactive mind map and visual thinking tool that turns complex ideas, conversations, research, notes, plans, documents, and codebases into editable, shareable mindmaps and visual knowledge maps.
plugin_asdk_app_6a571a2e0e7c819184208e1c.longDescription:
DeeplyClear is an interactive mind map and visual thinking tool that turns complex ideas, conversations, research, notes, plans, documents, and codebases into editable, shareable mindmaps and visual knowledge maps.

Use DeeplyClear to organize ideas, create concept maps, explore systems and relationships, clarify arguments, map research, understand codebases, and transform complicated information into clear visual structures.
plugin_asdk_app_6a571a2e0e7c819184208e1c.longDescriptionZh:
DeeplyClear 是一款交互式思维导图和视觉思维工具，可将复杂的想法、对话、研究、笔记、计划、文档和代码库转换为可编辑、可共享的思维导图和视觉知识图。

使用 DeeplyClear 来组织想法、创建概念图、探索系统和关系、阐明论点、绘制研究图、理解代码库以及将复杂的信息转换为清晰的视觉结构。
defaultPrompts: Turn these thread into a clear mind map with the key ideas, hierarchy, and relationships.
Inspect this repository and create a visual architecture map of its main systems and data flows.
Map this codebase's main code paths, dependencies, data flows, and external services.
defaultPromptsZh: 将这些线索转化为包含关键思想、层次结构和关系的清晰思维导图。
检查此存储库并创建其主要系统和数据流的可视化架构图。
映射此代码库的主要代码路径、依赖项、数据流和外部服务。

plugin_asdk_app_6a243e484d088191bdcf9544.productIntro: 在申请之前了解您的简历实际证明了什么。粘贴职位发布和您的简历，或附上一份 PDF/DOCX 简历。 ApplyArc 将每项规定的要求映射到准确的简历证据，在交互式适合报告中显示诚实的差距，仅根据经过验证的事实起草求职信，并在有证据支持的指导下将同一工作转变为面试问题。它从不发明经验或预测招聘结果。无需帐户。
plugin_asdk_app_6a243e484d088191bdcf9544.productIntroEn: Know what your CV or resume actually proves before you apply. Paste a job post and your CV, or attach one PDF/DOCX resume. ApplyArc maps each stated requirement to exact CV evidence, shows honest gaps in an interactive Fit Report, drafts a cover letter only from verified facts, and turns the same job into interview questions with evidence-backed guidance.
plugin_asdk_app_6a243e484d088191bdcf9544.longDescription: Know what your CV or resume actually proves before you apply. Paste a job post and your CV, or attach one PDF/DOCX resume. It never invents experience or predicts hiring outcomes. No account required.

plugin_asdk_app_6a6b175c1a08819193cf7d84.name: PomoDial
plugin_asdk_app_6a6b175c1a08819193cf7d84.description: 番茄工作法专注计时器
plugin_asdk_app_6a6b175c1a08819193cf7d84.productIntro: PomoDial 是一款番茄钟专注计时器，它会在时钟开始之前询问您正在做什么。告诉 ChatGPT 您的意图，开始定时会话，PomoDial 会跟踪您的焦点历史记录、连续记录和进度。会话与您在 pomodial.com 上的帐户同步，您可以在其中查看您的意图日记、解锁表盘并在排行榜上竞争。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6b175c1a08819193cf7d84.productIntroEn: PomoDial is a Pomodoro focus timer that asks what you're working on before the clock starts. Tell ChatGPT your intention, start a timed session, and PomoDial tracks your focus history, streaks, and progress. Sessions sync with your account at pomodial.com where you can view your intention journal, unlock dial faces, and compete on the leaderboard.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6b175c1a08819193cf7d84.longDescription: PomoDial is a Pomodoro focus timer that asks what you're working on before the clock starts. Tell ChatGPT your intention, start a timed session, and PomoDial tracks your focus history, streaks, and progress. Sessions sync with your account at pomodial.com where you can view your intention journal, unlock dial faces, and compete on the leaderboard.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6b175c1a08819193cf7d84.longDescriptionZh: PomoDial 是一款番茄钟专注计时器，它会在时钟开始之前询问您正在做什么。告诉 ChatGPT 您的意图，开始定时会话，PomoDial 会跟踪您的焦点历史记录、连续记录和进度。会话与您在 pomodial.com 上的帐户同步，您可以在其中查看您的意图日记、解锁表盘并在排行榜上竞争。
defaultPrompts: "Start a 25 minute focus session"
"Show me my productivity summary and focus streak"
"I just finished my focus session, mark it complete"

Create branded short links, track clicks, and optimize marketing campaigns directly from ChatGPT. This app lets marketers generate custom tracking URLs, apply smart redirects based on device or location, and create dynamic QR codes that can be updated anytime.

Perfect for marketers, growth teams, and agencies who want fast link creation, real-time analytics, and campaign-ready URLs without leaving ChatGPT.

plugin_asdk_app_6949dd4e2608819189e651a8.productIntro: Adzviser 将您的营销数据导入 ChatGPT。
plugin_asdk_app_6949dd4e2608819189e651a8.productIntroEn: Adzviser brings your marketing data into ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6949dd4e2608819189e651a8.longDescription:
Adzviser brings your marketing data into ChatGPT.

Connect platforms like Google Ads, Meta Ads, Shopify, and more, then ask questions in plain language to retrieve live campaign data. Instead of exporting reports or switching between dashboards, you can explore performance, compare time periods, and analyze metrics directly in chat.

Popular data sources customers connect include: Google Ads, Meta (Facebook) Ads, Instagram, GA4, Google Search Console, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, YouTube Analytics, Google Business Profile, HubSpot, Salesforce, Snapchat Ads, Klaviyo, Amazon Ads, Microsoft Ads (Bing), Google Merchant Center, Apple Ads, DV360, Reddit Ads, WooCommerce, X (Twitter) Ads and more.
plugin_asdk_app_6949dd4e2608819189e651a8.longDescriptionZh:
Adzviser 将您的营销数据导入 ChatGPT。

连接 Google Ads、Meta Ads、Shopify 等平台，然后用简单的语言提出问题以检索实时营销活动数据。您无需导出报告或在仪表板之间切换，而是可以直接在聊天中探索性能、比较时间段并分析指标。

客户连接的热门数据源包括：Google Ads、Meta (Facebook) 广告、Instagram、GA4、Google Search Console、LinkedIn 广告、TikTok 广告、Pinterest 广告、YouTube Analytics、Google Business Profile、HubSpot、Salesforce、Snapchat 广告、Klaviyo、Amazon 广告、Microsoft 广告 (Bing)、Google Merchant Center、Apple 广告、DV360、Reddit 广告、WooCommerce、X (Twitter) 广告等。

How much did we spend on Google Ads last week?
What was our Shopify revenue last week vs the same previous period?
defaultPromptsZh: 上个月我们的 Facebook 广告活动表现如何？

plugin_asdk_app_69f8aba82de0819193c016bb.longDescription:
The Productive app connects OpenAI to your Productive organization, giving you conversational access to your operations platform.

Productive is built for professional services teams - agencies, consultancies, and software companies, to manage projects, track time, plan resources, and oversee finances. With this connector, you can query and act on that data directly from ChatGPT, without switching tools.

Ask about team availability, budget utilization, overdue tasks, or pipeline status, and get instant answers grounded in your live Productive data.
plugin_asdk_app_69f8aba82de0819193c016bb.longDescriptionZh:
Productive 应用程序将 OpenAI 连接到您的 Productive 组织，让您能够通过对话方式访问您的运营平台。

Productive 专为专业服务团队（机构、咨询公司和软件公司）而构建，用于管理项目、跟踪时间、规划资源和监督财务。借助此连接器，您可以直接从 ChatGPT 查询数据并对其进行操作，而无需切换工具。

询问团队可用性、预算利用率、逾期任务或管道状态，并根据实时生产数据获得即时答案。

plugin_asdk_app_696c1b3261d88191b98fc701.productIntroEn: Open Context lets you store, organize, and reuse context across your AI workflows. You can save profiles, documents, instructions, and other structured information in one place, then load exactly what you need into a conversation or tool when you need it.
plugin_asdk_app_696c1b3261d88191b98fc701.longDescription:
Open Context lets you store, organize, and reuse context across your AI workflows. You can save profiles, documents, instructions, and other structured information in one place, then load exactly what you need into a conversation or tool when you need it.

Instead of re-explaining background or copying the same prompts, you work from a shared, persistent source of truth. This helps keep conversations consistent, makes personalization easy, and enables workflows that rely on long-lived knowledge and memory.
plugin_asdk_app_696c1b3261d88191b98fc701.longDescriptionZh:
开放上下文可让您在整个 AI 工作流程中存储、组织和重用上下文。您可以将配置文件、文档、说明和其他结构化信息保存在一个位置，然后在需要时将所需内容准确加载到对话或工具中。

您无需重新解释背景或复制相同的提示，而是从共享的、持久的事实来源开始工作。这有助于保持对话的一致性，使个性化变得容易，并支持依赖长期知识和记忆的工作流程。

plugin_asdk_app_6944b58290148191ae970160.name: Outliner
plugin_asdk_app_6944b58290148191ae970160.productIntro: 在 ChatGPT 中将想法或上传的文件转化为清晰的轮廓。 要求 Outliner 构建融资方案、规划产品发布或撰写论文；它会立即构建一个逻辑层次结构，您可以提升、修剪或删除——让您在格式化时进行思考。
plugin_asdk_app_6944b58290148191ae970160.productIntroEn: Turn an idea or an uploaded file into a clean outline right inside ChatGPT. Ask Outliner to structure a pitch deck, map a product launch, or shape an essay; it instantly builds a logical hierarchy you can promote, trim, or delete — letting you think while it formats.
plugin_asdk_app_6944b58290148191ae970160.longDescription:
Turn an idea or an uploaded file into a clean outline right inside ChatGPT.
Ask Outliner to structure a pitch deck, map a product launch, or shape an essay; it instantly builds a logical hierarchy you can promote, trim, or delete — letting you think while it formats.

How to Use Outliner in ChatGPT

1. Connect: Connect the Outliner app to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Activate the app using one of these methods:
Type Commands: Simply type “@” then choose the Outliner app, or type “Outliner” (followed by a space) in the chat box.
Action List: Select it directly from the Action List (Requires the Sider extension).
3. Create: You are ready to go! Try asking specifically:
· “Outline my climate-change research paper.”
· “Break this product concept into a step-by-step workflow.”
· “Summarize this file, then build a project-plan outline.”

When you’re ready, copy the outline and keep refining it with your team.
plugin_asdk_app_6944b58290148191ae970160.longDescriptionZh:
在 ChatGPT 中将想法或上传的文件转化为清晰的轮廓。
要求 Outliner 构建融资方案、规划产品发布或撰写论文；它会立即构建一个逻辑层次结构，您可以提升、修剪或删除——让您在格式化时进行思考。

如何在 ChatGPT 中使用 Outliner

1. 连接：将 Outliner 应用程序连接到 ChatGPT。
2. 触发器：使用以下方法之一激活应用程序：
键入命令：只需键入“@”，然后选择 Outliner 应用程序，或在聊天框中键入“Outliner”（后跟空格）。
操作列表：直接从操作列表中选择（需要 Sider 扩展）。
3. 创建：您已准备就绪！尝试具体询问：
·“概述我的气候变化研究论文。”
· “将这个产品概念分解为逐步的工作流程。”
· “总结此文件，然后构建项目计划大纲。”

准备好后，复制大纲并与您的团队一起不断完善。
defaultPrompts: Deeply refine the outline content
Generate a research-oriented outline for “AI Video”
Rewrite node titles to sound more like a research outline
defaultPromptsZh: 深度细化大纲内容
为“AI 视频”生成研究型大纲
重写节点标题，使其听起来更像研究大纲

plugin_asdk_app_6943a31d7bb08191816ba15d.name: Context Link
plugin_asdk_app_6943a31d7bb08191816ba15d.productIntro: 您的企业遍布一千个地方。为 ChatGPT 提供一种与所有内容对话的方式。
plugin_asdk_app_6943a31d7bb08191816ba15d.productIntroEn: Your business lives in a thousand places. Give ChatGPT a single way to talk to all of it.
plugin_asdk_app_6943a31d7bb08191816ba15d.longDescription:
Your business lives in a thousand places. Give ChatGPT a single way to talk to all of it.

Connect your docs, websites, inboxes, files, and workspaces so ChatGPT can understand what is true right now. Context Link turns scattered business knowledge into source-backed answers, reusable context, and living AI memories your team can keep up to date.

Ask questions, pull source material, observe what has changed, and use ChatGPT with the latest business context instead of re-explaining everything from scratch.
plugin_asdk_app_6943a31d7bb08191816ba15d.longDescriptionZh:
您的企业遍布一千个地方。为 ChatGPT 提供一种与所有内容对话的方式。

连接您的文档、网站、收件箱、文件和工作区，以便 ChatGPT 可以了解当前的真实情况。 Context Link 将分散的业务知识转化为有源支持的答案、可重用的上下文以及您的团队可以保持最新的人工智能记忆。

提出问题、提取源材料、观察发生的变化，并将 ChatGPT 与最新的业务环境结合使用，而不是从头开始重新解释所有内容。
defaultPrompts: Get context on our pricing and retainer plans for startups, draft reply to the below:

plugin_asdk_app_6a6399c9bc848191a2f28f30.productIntro: OctoEverywhere 帮助用户监控连接的 3D 打印机、检查实时打印状态和 AI 故障检测、查看网络摄像头快照和文件列表、调试和修复常见的 3D 打印问题，以及通过 ChatGPT 使用权限控制的打印机命令。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6399c9bc848191a2f28f30.productIntroEn: OctoEverywhere helps users monitor their connected 3D printers, check live print status and AI failure detection, view webcam snapshots and file listings, debug and fix common 3D printing issues, and use permission-controlled printer commands through ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6399c9bc848191a2f28f30.longDescription:
OctoEverywhere helps users monitor their connected 3D printers, check live print status and AI failure detection, view webcam snapshots and file listings, debug and fix common 3D printing issues, and use permission-controlled printer commands through ChatGPT.

OctoEverywhere works with any kind of 3D printer, including those made by Bambu Lab, Prusa, Creality, Elegoo, Anycubic, QIDI, Snapmaker, Sovol, Flashforge, and more. OctoEverywhere works with OctoPrint, Klipper, Moonraker, Fluidd, Mainsail, PrusaLink, and more.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6399c9bc848191a2f28f30.longDescriptionZh:
OctoEverywhere 帮助用户监控连接的 3D 打印机、检查实时打印状态和 AI 故障检测、查看网络摄像头快照和文件列表、调试和修复常见的 3D 打印问题，以及通过 ChatGPT 使用权限控制的打印机命令。

OctoEverywhere 适用于任何类型的 3D 打印机，包括 Bambu Lab、Prusa、Creality、Elegoo、Anycubic、QIDI、Snapmaker、Sovol、Flashforge 等制造的打印机。 OctoEverywhere 可与 OctoPrint、Klipper、Moonraker、Fluidd、Mainsail、PrusaLink 等配合使用。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3baa683dc4819189b77175.name: DotSpark
plugin_asdk_app_6a3baa683dc4819189b77175.description: 让你的人工智能理性像你一样
plugin_asdk_app_6a3baa683dc4819189b77175.originalDescription: Make your AI reason like you
plugin_asdk_app_6a3baa683dc4819189b77175.productIntro: 现在每个人都用同样的人工智能思考，它悄悄地将原创性变成了自信的平均水平。 DotSpark 是一面镜子，让您保持自己的判断力。连接一次，您的助手会在每次对话开始时读取您的思维盾，并在整个会话中遵循它：在同意之前提出质疑，首先让您推理，保留您的想法并表达您的想法。当您工作时，它会捕获您的思维残余 - 见解（“点”）、它们之间的联系（“火花”）以及定期读取您的想法 - 将其记录到您的个人 DotSpark 图表中。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3baa683dc4819189b77175.productIntroEn: Everyone now thinks with the same AI, which quietly flattens originality into a confident average. DotSpark is the mirror that keeps your judgment yours. Connect it once and your assistant reads your Thinking Shield at the start of every conversation and follows it for the whole session: challenge before agreeing, make you reason first, keep your ideas and voice yours.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3baa683dc4819189b77175.longDescription: Everyone now thinks with the same AI, which quietly flattens originality into a confident average. DotSpark is the mirror that keeps your judgment yours. Connect it once and your assistant reads your Thinking Shield at the start of every conversation and follows it for the whole session: challenge before agreeing, make you reason first, keep your ideas and voice yours. As you work, it captures the residue of your thinking — insights ("dots"), connections across them ("sparks"), and a periodic read of how you think — into your personal DotSpark graph. Nothing is sent back to make the AI smarter about you; every signal points at your own self-knowledge.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3baa683dc4819189b77175.longDescriptionZh: 现在每个人都用同样的人工智能思考，它悄悄地将原创性变成了自信的平均水平。 DotSpark 是一面镜子，让您保持自己的判断力。连接一次，您的助手会在每次对话开始时读取您的思维盾，并在整个会话中遵循它：在同意之前提出质疑，首先让您推理，保留您的想法并表达您的想法。当您工作时，它会捕获您的思维残余 - 见解（“点”）、它们之间的联系（“火花”）以及定期读取您的想法 - 将其记录到您的个人 DotSpark 图表中。不会发送任何信息来让人工智能对你更加智能；每个信号都指向你自己的自知之明。

plugin_asdk_app_6a58bb03727c8191a4607c78.productIntro: Moknah 将文本和文档转换为听起来自然的语音和完整的有声读物，特别是对阿拉伯语以及许多其他语言的大力支持。粘贴文本或上传 PDF、Word 或 EPUB，选择语音，并生成可预览和下载的音频。对于阿拉伯语，它会自动添加变音符号 (tashkeel) 并对文本进行规范化，以便单词发音正确，并具有可选的情感和诗歌模式。将较长的作品分成章节，为每个部分设置不同的声音，并在导出之前检查质量。生成音频需要 Moknah 帐户。
plugin_asdk_app_6a58bb03727c8191a4607c78.productIntroEn: Moknah turns text and documents into natural-sounding speech and complete audiobooks, with especially strong support for Arabic alongside many other languages. plugin_asdk_app_6a58bb03727c8191a4607c78.longDescription: Moknah turns text and documents into natural-sounding speech and complete audiobooks, with especially strong support for Arabic alongside many other languages. Paste text or upload a PDF, Word, or EPUB, choose a voice, and generate audio you can preview and download. For Arabic, it automatically adds diacritics (tashkeel) and normalizes the text so words are pronounced correctly, with optional emotion and poetry modes. Break longer works into chapters, set a different voice per section, and review quality before you export. A Moknah account is required to generate audio.

plugin_asdk_app_698429b2c5fc8191bb997f52.name: MarcoPolo
plugin_asdk_app_698429b2c5fc8191bb997f52.description: 安全的人工智能数据工作空间
plugin_asdk_app_698429b2c5fc8191bb997f52.productIntro: MarcoPolo 启动了一个安全容器，ChatGPT 可以在其中处理您的实际数据。使用从未暴露给模型的范围凭证连接到您的数据库、API、S3、lakehouse、CRM、Jira、日志等。
plugin_asdk_app_698429b2c5fc8191bb997f52.productIntroEn: MarcoPolo spins up a secure container where ChatGPT can work with your actual data. Connect to your databases, APIs, S3, lakehouses, CRMs, Jira, logs and much more—using scoped credentials that are never exposed to the model.
plugin_asdk_app_698429b2c5fc8191bb997f52.longDescription:
MarcoPolo spins up a secure container where ChatGPT can work with your actual data. Connect to your databases, APIs, S3, lakehouses, CRMs, Jira, logs and much more—using scoped credentials that are never exposed to the model.

ChatGPT gets DuckDB, Python, a shell, and a set of tools to explore, query, transform, and analyze data across systems. The workspace persists over time, so that you can build on your work.

Prep a report, understand your data, debug an issue, or review the latest metrics right here in the conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_698429b2c5fc8191bb997f52.longDescriptionZh:
MarcoPolo 启动了一个安全容器，ChatGPT 可以在其中处理您的实际数据。使用从未暴露给模型的范围凭证连接到您的数据库、API、S3、lakehouse、CRM、Jira、日志等。

ChatGPT 获取 DuckDB、Python、一个 shell 和一组工具来跨系统探索、查询、转换和分析数据。工作空间会随着时间的推移而持续存在，以便您可以继续工作。

在对话中准备报告、了解数据、调试问题或查看最新指标。
defaultPrompts: perform exploratory analytics on the PRODUCT_METRICS table in Snowflake
defaultPromptsZh: 对 Snowflake 中的 PRODUCT_METRICS 表执行探索性分析

plugin_asdk_app_6a75e1cf7d3081918e406f96.productIntroEn: Atlas is a searchable directory of ChatGPT and Claude apps. Ask for apps by category, use case, or keyword and Atlas returns a clean table of matching results so you can compare options at a glance. It is useful for developers scouting the landscape, users looking for the right tool for a task, and anyone curious about what AI-native apps exist today.

plugin_asdk_app_6a053194fe5c81918e1a3b98.name: LibreJustice
plugin_asdk_app_6a053194fe5c81918e1a3b98.productIntro: LibreJustice 帮助用户研究法国和欧洲判例法，并检索在特定日期阅读的法律文本。它搜索法国行政、司法、宪法、庇护和数据保护机构以及欧洲法院的决定，并过滤法院、结果、日期和引用的条款。用户可以打开决定的全文，搜索法国立法和精选条约或外国法规，检索文章的版本历史记录，并查看自己保存的活动。
plugin_asdk_app_6a053194fe5c81918e1a3b98.productIntroEn: LibreJustice helps users research French and European case law and retrieve legal texts as they read on a specific date. It searches decisions from French administrative, judicial, constitutional, asylum and data-protection bodies as well as European courts, with filters for court, outcome, date and cited provisions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a053194fe5c81918e1a3b98.longDescription: LibreJustice helps users research French and European case law and retrieve legal texts as they read on a specific date. It searches decisions from French administrative, judicial, constitutional, asylum and data-protection bodies as well as European courts, with filters for court, outcome, date and cited provisions. Users can open the full text of a decision, search French legislation and curated treaties or foreign codes, retrieve an article's version history, and review their own saved activity.
plugin_asdk_app_6a053194fe5c81918e1a3b98.longDescriptionZh: LibreJustice 帮助用户研究法国和欧洲判例法，并检索在特定日期阅读的法律文本。它搜索法国行政、司法、宪法、庇护和数据保护机构以及欧洲法院的决定，并过滤法院、结果、日期和引用的条款。用户可以打开决定的全文，搜索法国立法和精选条约或外国法规，检索文章的版本历史记录，并查看自己保存的活动。

plugin_asdk_app_6a356315517081919bedfdd5.name: Dijin Memory
plugin_asdk_app_6a356315517081919bedfdd5.description: 通过 AI 调用记忆
plugin_asdk_app_6a356315517081919bedfdd5.productIntro: Dijin 是您的数字生活和人工智能代理的**内存层** - 一个开放的、所有者签名的、引用或拒绝的存储，用于存储您的决策、行动项目、实体和证据引用。
plugin_asdk_app_6a356315517081919bedfdd5.productIntroEn: Dijin is the **Memory Layer** for your digital life and AI agents — an open, owner-signed, cite-or-refuse store of your decisions, action items, entities, and evidence citations.
plugin_asdk_app_6a356315517081919bedfdd5.longDescription:
Dijin is the **Memory Layer** for your digital life and AI agents — an open, owner-signed, cite-or-refuse store of your decisions, action items, entities, and evidence citations.

Connect this MCP server to ChatGPT and ask it to recall what you've decided on a project, who moved a discussion forward, what your last release shipped, or any other signal Dijin has already captured (from GitHub, Slack, Teams, your own typed Add Memory entries, and more). ChatGPT calls `search` to discover records, then `fetch` for the signed `EvidencePack` — every answer comes back as Ed25519-signed proof with sources and a `/api/verify` link. Never a guess.

Dijin is read-only on the OpenAI side. The MCP server does not expose `memory.write` to ChatGPT; all writes happen on Dijin's own surfaces, behind the user's own login.
plugin_asdk_app_6a356315517081919bedfdd5.longDescriptionZh:
Dijin 是您的数字生活和人工智能代理的**内存层** - 一个开放的、所有者签名的、引用或拒绝的存储，用于存储您的决策、行动项目、实体和证据引用。

将此 MCP 服务器连接到 ChatGPT，并要求它回忆您对项目的决定、谁推动了讨论、您的上一个版本发布了什么，或者 Dijin 已经捕获的任何其他信号（来自 GitHub、Slack、Teams、您自己输入的添加内存条目等）。 ChatGPT 调用“search”来发现记录，然后调用“fetch”来获取签名的“EvidencePack”——每个答案都会以 Ed25519 签名的证明形式返回，其中包含来源和“/api/verify”链接。从来没有猜测过。

Dijin 在 OpenAI 端是只读的。 MCP 服务器不会向 ChatGPT 公开“memory.write”；所有写入都发生在 Dijin 自己的表面上，在用户自己的登录后面。

plugin_asdk_app_6a60c62613808191b41e39b4.description: 扫描、修复并验证您的 DNS
plugin_asdk_app_6a60c62613808191b41e39b4.productIntro: DNS Doctor 扫描、修复和验证域的 DNS，并返回确定性结论以及由验证引擎生成的复制粘贴修复记录（RFC 语法加上 SPF 10 查找计数器）——绝不是法学硕士的猜测。它诊断电子邮件身份验证（SPF、DMARC、DKIM）、MX、DNS 运行状况、黑名单列表和域/SSL 过期；审核谁可以通过其 SPF 包含作为域传递发送；从六个有利位置验证 DNS 更改是否已在全球范围内传播；构建对齐门控 DMARC 强制升级（p=仅当服务器派生的对齐门通过时拒绝…
plugin_asdk_app_6a60c62613808191b41e39b4.productIntroEn: DNS Doctor scans, fixes and verifies a domain's DNS and returns deterministic verdicts plus copy-paste fix records generated by a validating engine (RFC grammar plus the SPF 10-lookup counter) — never an LLM guess.
plugin_asdk_app_6a60c62613808191b41e39b4.longDescription: DNS Doctor scans, fixes and verifies a domain's DNS and returns deterministic verdicts plus copy-paste fix records generated by a validating engine (RFC grammar plus the SPF 10-lookup counter) — never an LLM guess. It diagnoses email authentication (SPF, DMARC, DKIM), MX, DNS health, blacklist listings, and domain/SSL expiry; audits who can transitively send as a domain through its SPF includes; verifies from six vantage points whether a DNS change has propagated globally; builds alignment-gated DMARC enforcement upgrades (p=reject only when the server-derived alignment gate passes); and hands the human a sign-up link to start free DMARC monitoring — nothing is created until they sign in there themselves. A human approves every DNS change.
plugin_asdk_app_6a60c62613808191b41e39b4.longDescriptionZh: DNS Doctor 扫描、修复和验证域的 DNS，并返回确定性结论以及由验证引擎生成的复制粘贴修复记录（RFC 语法加上 SPF 10 查找计数器）——绝不是法学硕士的猜测。它诊断电子邮件身份验证（SPF、DMARC、DKIM）、MX、DNS 运行状况、黑名单列表和域/SSL 过期；审核谁可以通过其 SPF 包含作为域传递发送；从六个有利位置验证 DNS 更改是否已在全球范围内传播；构建对齐门控 DMARC 强制升级（p=仅当服务器派生的对齐门通过时拒绝）；并向人们提供一个注册链接以启动免费的 DMARC 监控 - 在他们自己登录之前不会创建任何内容。每次 DNS 更改均由人工批准。
defaultPrompts: I just changed a DNS record — check from several locations whether it has propagated everywhere yet.
Mail from my domain keeps landing in spam — diagnose it and give me the exact DNS records to fix.
Is it safe to move my domain's DMARC policy to enforcement? If yes, give me the record to publish.
defaultPromptsZh: 我刚刚更改了一条 DNS 记录 - 从多个位置检查它是否已传播到各处。
来自我的域的邮件不断落在垃圾邮件中 - 诊断它并为我提供要修复的确切 DNS 记录。
将我的域的 DMARC 策略改为强制执行是否安全？如果是的话，请给我要发布的记录。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3bfcb949948191a2016f5c.productIntro: IQLand 将美国街道地址转变为开发商级房产报告。解决地块问题，阅读其分区和可建造的信封，估算建筑成本，根据建筑计划库运行 SmartBuild 可行性，拉动可比销售，并生成完整的评估 IQ（成本方法 + 调整后的比较 + 调节后的价值）。专为评估美国房地产的投资者、开发商、代理商和评估师而打造。所有工具都是只读的：它们从 IQLand 的分区、成本和建筑规划服务以及公共地块/列表数据中查找和获取数据，并且从不创建、修改或删除记录。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3bfcb949948191a2016f5c.productIntroEn: IQLand turns a U.S. street address into a developer-grade property report. Resolve a parcel, read its zoning and buildable envelope, estimate construction cost, run SmartBuild feasibility against a library of architectural plans, pull comparable sales, and generate a full Appraisal IQ (cost approach + adjusted comps + reconciled value).
plugin_asdk_app_6a3bfcb949948191a2016f5c.longDescription: IQLand turns a U.S. street address into a developer-grade property report. Built for investors, developers, agents, and appraisers evaluating U.S. real estate. All tools are read-only: they look up and derive data from IQLand's zoning, cost, and architectural-plans services and public parcel/listing data, and never create, modify, or delete records.

plugin_asdk_app_6a607cd96ecc8191a496fcd9.description: 使用 WeTransfer 发送文件
plugin_asdk_app_6a607cd96ecc8191a496fcd9.productIntro: 直接通过 WeTransfer 对话发送文件。
plugin_asdk_app_6a607cd96ecc8191a496fcd9.productIntroEn: Send files straight from your conversation with WeTransfer.
plugin_asdk_app_6a607cd96ecc8191a496fcd9.longDescription:
Send files straight from your conversation with WeTransfer.

Connect your WeTransfer account and share any file from your chat — documents, images, exports, generated assets — without leaving the conversation. Just ask, and the connector uploads the files to WeTransfer and returns a clean, shareable download link. Prefer to send it directly? Add recipients and WeTransfer will email the transfer for you, sent from your own account.

What you can do
- Share one or many files at once and get a ready-to-share download link
- Email a transfer to one or more recipients, with an optional title and message
- Send large files without bloating the conversation

How it works
Every transfer is created in your own WeTransfer account, so it appears in your transfer history and follows your plan's limits and expiry. You sign in securely with your WeTransfer account — the assistant only ever gets permission to send files on your behalf, and never sees your WeTransfer password. You can disconnect at any time to revoke access.
plugin_asdk_app_6a607cd96ecc8191a496fcd9.longDescriptionZh:
直接通过 WeTransfer 对话发送文件。

连接您的 WeTransfer 帐户并共享聊天中的任何文件 - 文档、图像、导出、生成的资产 - 无需离开对话。只需询问，连接器就会将文件上传到 WeTransfer 并返回干净、可共享的下载链接。想要直接发送吗？添加收件人，WeTransfer 将通过您自己的帐户通过电子邮件为您发送转账信息。

你能做什么
- 一次共享一个或多个文件并获取可立即共享的下载链接
- 通过电子邮件将转账发送给一个或多个收件人，并带有可选的标题和消息
- 发送大文件而不会使对话变得臃肿

它是如何运作的
每次转账都是在您自己的 WeTransfer 帐户中创建的，因此它会显示在您的转账历史记录中，并遵循您的计划的限制和到期时间。您使用 WeTransfer 帐户安全登录 - 助手仅获得代表您发送文件的权限，而永远不会看到您的 WeTransfer 密码。您可以随时断开连接以撤销访问权限。

plugin_asdk_app_6a6f4df5ecf48191b639df6a.name: ScalperIntel AI
plugin_asdk_app_6a6f4df5ecf48191b639df6a.productIntro: ScalperIntel AI 回答有关 ScalperIntel 指标的问题，并让经过验证的客户无需离开聊天即可管理自己的许可证。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6f4df5ecf48191b639df6a.productIntroEn: ScalperIntel AI answers questions about ScalperIntel's indicators and lets verified customers manage their own licenses without leaving the chat.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6f4df5ecf48191b639df6a.longDescription:
ScalperIntel AI answers questions about ScalperIntel's indicators and lets verified customers manage their own licenses without leaving the chat.

Connecting takes one step: enter an email and the 6-digit code sent to it. With any email it answers from ScalperIntel's official product knowledge base — what an indicator detects and plots, what each setting does when you change it, installation and setup on NinjaTrader 8, chart and bar-type compatibility, pricing and license types, and which indicator suits a given style of trading. Answers are grounded in that knowledge base and cited rather than improvised.

Sign in with the email used to purchase and it also acts on that account: list licenses and their status, diagnose a license problem against the real license state rather than a guess, submit a new machine ID, switch between Named User and Machine ID activation, and log an issue for the support team with a reference number.

Scope is enforced in code, not by instruction. It gives no trading advice and makes no performance or profit claims; it answers about the software only. The signed-in email is read from the verified session and never from text typed into a prompt, so the license tools can only ever act on the account that signed in.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6f4df5ecf48191b639df6a.longDescriptionZh:
ScalperIntel AI 回答有关 ScalperIntel 指标的问题，并让经过验证的客户无需离开聊天即可管理自己的许可证。

连接只需一步：输入电子邮件和发送给该电子邮件的 6 位数代码。对于任何电子邮件，它都会从 ScalperIntel 的官方产品知识库中进行回复 — 指标检测和绘制的内容、更改后每个设置的作用、NinjaTrader 8 上的安装和设置、图表和条形图类型兼容性、定价和许可证类型，以及哪个指标适合给定的交易风格。答案基于该知识库并被引用，而不是即兴创作。

使用用于购买的电子邮件登录，它也会作用于该帐户：列出许可证及其状态，根据真实许可证状态而不是猜测来诊断许可证问题，提交新的计算机 ID，在指定用户和计算机 ID 激活之间切换，并使用参考号为支持团队记录问题。

范围是在代码中强制执行的，而不是通过指令强制执行的。它不提供交易建议，也不做出业绩或利润声明；它仅回答有关软件的问题。登录的电子邮件是从经过验证的会话中读取的，而不是从提示中输入的文本中读取的，因此许可证工具只能对登录的帐户进行操作。

- Which indicators suit intraday scalping?
- Fair Value Gap crossing in Strategy Builder
defaultPromptsZh: - 激活我的新许可证
- 哪些指标适合日内倒卖？

plugin_asdk_app_6a2abc00cdcc81919fc869fb.name: Matchbox
plugin_asdk_app_6a2abc00cdcc81919fc869fb.description: 寻找解决任何问题的工具
plugin_asdk_app_6a2abc00cdcc81919fc869fb.productIntro: Matchbox 可帮助您找到解决实际问题的正确产品或工具。用简单的语言描述您遇到的困难 - “我总是忘记吃药”，“我需要跟踪三种货币的费用” - Matchbox 会返回与您的情况相匹配的特定产品，并根据它们的适合程度而不是它们的受欢迎程度进行排名。它显示了鲜为人知和较新的工具以及已建立的工具，因此您可以发现一般搜索和列表文章错过的选项。
plugin_asdk_app_6a2abc00cdcc81919fc869fb.productIntroEn: Matchbox helps you find the right product or tool for a real problem. Describe what you're struggling with in plain language — "I keep forgetting to take my medication," "I need to track expenses across three currencies" — and Matchbox returns specific products matched to your situation, ranked by how well they fit rather than how popular they are.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2abc00cdcc81919fc869fb.longDescription: Matchbox helps you find the right product or tool for a real problem. Describe what you're struggling with in plain language — "I keep forgetting to take my medication," "I need to track expenses across three currencies" — and Matchbox returns specific products matched to your situation, ranked by how well they fit rather than how popular they are. It surfaces lesser-known and newer tools alongside established ones, so you discover options that generic searches and listicles miss.

plugin_asdk_app_6a54e4fb251081919c813b53.name: TaskNotify
plugin_asdk_app_6a54e4fb251081919c813b53.productIntro: 大多数重复任务每次运行时都会通知您，即使没有发生任何变化。 TaskNotify 为 ChatGPT 提供了一条与您的私人 Telegram 聊天的直接线路，因此只有当结果、警报或更新确实值得您关注时它才能联系到您。
plugin_asdk_app_6a54e4fb251081919c813b53.productIntroEn: Most recurring tasks notify you every time they run—even when nothing changed. TaskNotify gives ChatGPT a direct line to your private Telegram chat, so it can reach you only when a result, alert, or update is actually worth your attention.
plugin_asdk_app_6a54e4fb251081919c813b53.longDescription:
Most recurring tasks notify you every time they run—even when nothing changed. TaskNotify gives ChatGPT a direct line to your private Telegram chat, so it can reach you only when a result, alert, or update is actually worth your attention.

Connect Telegram in one tap, then let ChatGPT deliver important task outcomes beyond the conversation. Messages arrive in real time with rich formatting, while TaskNotify relays message content without storing it.

Use TaskNotify to:
- Receive meaningful results from recurring tasks on Telegram
- Skip empty or no-op notifications that only create noise
- Get urgent alerts and important updates on your phone
- Pair or reconnect a private Telegram chat without copying tokens
- Send readable notifications with bold text, links, code, and quotes
plugin_asdk_app_6a54e4fb251081919c813b53.longDescriptionZh:
大多数重复任务每次运行时都会通知您，即使没有发生任何变化。 TaskNotify 为 ChatGPT 提供了一条与您的私人 Telegram 聊天的直接线路，因此只有当结果、警报或更新确实值得您关注时它才能联系到您。

一键连接 Telegram，然后让 ChatGPT 交付对话之外的重要任务结果。消息以丰富的格式实时到达，而 TaskNotify 则转发消息内容而不存储它。

使用 TaskNotify 可以：
- 从 Telegram 上的重复任务中获得有意义的结果
- 跳过只会产生噪音的空通知或无操作通知
- 在手机上获取紧急警报和重要更新
- 配对或重新连接私人 Telegram 聊天，无需复制令牌
- 发送带有粗体文本、链接、代码和引号的可读通知
defaultPrompts: Set up Telegram notifications for me.
Send a formatted Telegram alert that my weekly report is ready, with bold, italic, code, link, quote, and spoiler.
Check Apple news daily and alert me only when the next iPhone launch date or a major new rumor appears.
defaultPromptsZh: 为我设置 Telegram 通知。
发送格式化的 Telegram 提醒，告知我的每周报告已准备就绪，其中包含粗体、斜体、代码、链接、引用和剧透。
每天查看 Apple 新闻，仅在下一个 iPhone 发布日期或重大新谣言出现时提醒我。

plugin_asdk_app_699f1bb1c5ac819182dfee0b.productIntro: 在对话中就任何 ChatGPT 回复获得独立的第二意见。 Qu Review 使用独立 AI 审核员小组从多个角度批判性地检查 ChatGPT 告诉您的内容，然后将他们的发现合并成一份清晰、可操作的报告。
plugin_asdk_app_699f1bb1c5ac819182dfee0b.productIntroEn: Get an independent second opinion on any ChatGPT response, right in the conversation. Qu Review uses a panel of independent AI reviewers to critically examine what ChatGPT told you from multiple angles, then combines their findings into one clear, actionable report.
plugin_asdk_app_699f1bb1c5ac819182dfee0b.longDescription:
Get an independent second opinion on any ChatGPT response, right in the conversation. Qu Review uses a panel of independent AI reviewers to critically examine what ChatGPT told you from multiple angles, then combines their findings into one clear, actionable report.

Each review tells you what's accurate, what might be wrong, what's missing, and what's worth exploring further, along with an easy-to-read scorecard so you can see at a glance how much to trust the answer.

Great for anything where getting it right matters: health questions, financial decisions, school work, professional research, or any time something just doesn't sound right.
plugin_asdk_app_699f1bb1c5ac819182dfee0b.longDescriptionZh:
在对话中就任何 ChatGPT 回复获得独立的第二意见。 Qu Review 使用独立 AI 审核员小组从多个角度批判性地检查 ChatGPT 告诉您的内容，然后将他们的发现合并成一份清晰、可操作的报告。

每条评论都会告诉您什么是准确的，什么可能是错误的，什么是缺失的，什么是值得进一步探索的，以及一个易于阅读的记分卡，以便您一目了然地知道答案的可信度。

非常适合任何需要正确处理的事情：健康问题、财务决策、学校作业、专业研究或任何听起来不正确的事情。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5767a72d2881919c2f45a7.name: CloudConvert
plugin_asdk_app_6a5767a72d2881919c2f45a7.productIntro: 使用 CloudConvert 将强大的文件转换和处理功能引入 ChatGPT。处理文档、图像、音频、视频、电子书、档案等，无需在单独的工具之间切换。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5767a72d2881919c2f45a7.productIntroEn: Bring powerful file conversion and processing into ChatGPT with CloudConvert. Work with documents, images, audio, video, ebooks, archives, and more—without switching between separate tools.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5767a72d2881919c2f45a7.longDescription:
Bring powerful file conversion and processing into ChatGPT with CloudConvert. Work with documents, images, audio, video, ebooks, archives, and more—without switching between separate tools.

• Convert files between supported formats
• Compress and optimize PDF, PNG, and JPG files
• Merge multiple documents and images into a single PDF
• Create thumbnails from documents, images, videos, and other files
• Add text or image watermarks to PDFs, images, and videos
• Create ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, TAR.GZ, and TAR.BZ2 archives
• Capture websites as PDFs, PNGs, or JPGs
• Extract and update file metadata
• Add OCR text layers to scanned PDFs
• Rotate, split, and extract selected PDF pages
• Encrypt, decrypt, and manage PDF permissions
• Convert PDFs to archival PDF/A or print-ready PDF/X standards
• Run custom FFmpeg, ImageMagick, and GraphicsMagick commands
• Build advanced multi-step conversion workflows and monitor their progress

CloudConvert returns processed files as convenient download links and lets users check job status and remaining conversion credits directly in ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5767a72d2881919c2f45a7.longDescriptionZh:
使用 CloudConvert 将强大的文件转换和处理功能引入 ChatGPT。处理文档、图像、音频、视频、电子书、档案等，无需在单独的工具之间切换。

• 在支持的格式之间转换文件
• 压缩和优化 PDF、PNG 和 JPG 文件
• 将多个文档和图像合并为一个 PDF
• 从文档、图像、视频和其他文件创建缩略图
• 向 PDF、图像和视频添加文本或图像水印
• 创建 ZIP、RAR、7Z、TAR、TAR.GZ 和 TAR.BZ2 存档
• 将网站捕获为 PDF、PNG 或 JPG
• 提取和更新文件元数据
• 将 OCR 文本图层添加到扫描的 PDF
• 旋转、分割和提取选定的 PDF 页面
• 加密、解密和管理 PDF 权限
• 将 PDF 转换为存档 PDF/A 或可打印的 PDF/X 标准
• 运行自定义 FFmpeg、ImageMagick 和 GraphicsMagick 命令
• 构建高级多步骤转换工作流程并监控其进度

CloudConvert 将处理后的文件作为方便的下载链接返回，并让用户可以直接在 ChatGPT 中检查作业状态和剩余转换积分。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4667f9d30c8191a5ad48d3.name: Aide Calendar: AI Planner
plugin_asdk_app_6a4667f9d30c8191a5ad48d3.description: 事件的屏幕截图和语音
plugin_asdk_app_6a4667f9d30c8191a5ad48d3.productIntro: Aide Calendar 是一款适用于 iPhone 和 iPad 的日历和任务应用程序 - 现在位于 ChatGPT 中。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4667f9d30c8191a5ad48d3.productIntroEn: Aide Calendar is a calendar & task app for iPhone and iPad — now in ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4667f9d30c8191a5ad48d3.longDescription:
Aide Calendar is a calendar & task app for iPhone and iPad — now in ChatGPT.

Capture a plan in chat — type it, paste it, or show ChatGPT a screenshot — and it saves straight to Aide Calendar on your iPhone / iPad: event or task created, reminders set, synced across your devices. No retyping.

In ChatGPT
• Type or paste — "lunch Friday 1 pm at Nobu," "submit the report by Friday 5 pm"
• Upload a screenshot — a text, an email, an invite; ChatGPT reads it and saves it
• Saved complete — date, time, venue, attendees, phone, notes, and alerts
• Recurring and all-day events, and no duplicates when you re-save

On your iPhone & iPad — Aide Calendar
Everything you save here lives in the full Aide Calendar app, where you run your day:
• Capture on your phone too — screenshots, photos, voice notes, anything shared, in any language
• Five views (Day · 3-Day · Week · Week-list · Month), drag to reschedule, instant search
• A real task manager — priorities, due dates, Overdue / by day / Completed
• Tap a number to call, message, or WhatsApp; tap an address to open in Maps
• Real-time sync across iPhone and iPad

Private by design
• Saves only what you ask · never reads your other chats
• Keeps no copy of your events — they live only in your Aide account
• No ads, no tracking — Aide never uses your events to train AI models

Requires the Aide Calendar app for iPhone & iPad (iOS 17+)
plugin_asdk_app_6a4667f9d30c8191a5ad48d3.longDescriptionZh:
Aide Calendar 是一款适用于 iPhone 和 iPad 的日历和任务应用程序 - 现在位于 ChatGPT 中。

在聊天中捕获计划 - 键入、粘贴或向 ChatGPT 显示屏幕截图 - 它会直接保存到 iPhone / iPad 上的 Aide Calendar：创建的事件或任务、设置的提醒、在您的设备之间同步。无需重新输入。

在聊天GPT中
• 输入或粘贴 —“周五下午 1 点在 Nobu 吃午餐”、“周五下午 5 点之前提交报告”
• 上传屏幕截图——文本、电子邮件、邀请； ChatGPT 读取并保存
• 保存完整 — 日期、时间、地点、与会者、电话、注释和提醒
• 重复发生的全天事件，重新保存时不会重复

在您的 iPhone 和 iPad 上 — 助手日历
您在此处保存的所有内容都存储在完整的 Aide Calendar 应用程序中，您可以在其中管理您的一天：
• 也可以在手机上捕捉 - 屏幕截图、照片、语音注释、任何共享内容，以任何语言
• 五种视图（日·三天·周·周列表·月），拖动重新安排，即时搜索
• 真正的任务管理器 — 优先级、截止日期、逾期/按天/已完成
• 点击号码即可拨打电话、发送消息或发送 WhatsApp；点击要在地图中打开的地址
• iPhone 和 iPad 之间的实时同步

私人设计
• 只保存您询问的内容 · 绝不阅读您的其他聊天内容
• 不保留您的活动副本 - 它们仅存在于您的 Aide 帐户中
• 无广告、无跟踪 — Aide 绝不会使用您的事件来训练 AI 模型

需要适用于 iPhone 和 iPad (iOS 17+) 的 Aide Calendar 应用程序

defaultPromptsZh: 本周五晚上 7:30 与 Sarah 共进晚餐，并提前一小时提醒我。

plugin_asdk_app_6a1e8ef9486081919612885f.productIntro: Octopad 是构建者的人工智能大脑：人工智能按照共享方法组织工作和知识的工作空间。
plugin_asdk_app_6a1e8ef9486081919612885f.productIntroEn: Octopad is the AI brain for builders: the workspace where AIs organize work and knowledge following a shared method.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1e8ef9486081919612885f.longDescription:
Octopad is the AI brain for builders: the workspace where AIs organize work and knowledge following a shared method.

ChatGPT turns your discussions into structured plans with detailed tasks that persist across sessions, so your projects move forward instead of restarting.

As you work, it saves the knowledge behind your project, from product spec to business model or competitor analysis, along with key information like decisions and their reasons.

Before a task, ChatGPT asks for a briefing built for that exact task, so it starts informed instead of from a blank page.

Every AI you connect works the same way, from the same record, in one workspace.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1e8ef9486081919612885f.longDescriptionZh:
Octopad 是构建者的人工智能大脑：人工智能按照共享方法组织工作和知识的工作空间。

ChatGPT 将您的讨论转化为结构化计划，其中包含跨会话持续的详细任务，因此您的项目可以继续前进，而不是重新开始。

在您工作时，它会保存项目背后的知识，从产品规格到业务模型或竞争对手分析，以及决策及其原因等关键信息。

在执行任务之前，ChatGPT 会要求提供针对该具体任务的简报，因此它会开始通知而不是从空白页面开始。

您连接的每个人工智能在一个工作区中以相同的方式、相同的记录工作。

plugin_asdk_app_6a591c6c9e8c8191a04f6d0f.description: 用人工智能控制你的特斯拉
plugin_asdk_app_6a591c6c9e8c8191a04f6d0f.productIntro: 您的 Tesla 应用程序已发送命令。这是这个插件做不到的。 mytesla.io 将您的汽车插入人工智能已知的一切内容——您的日历、天气、日常生活——并决定何时采取行动。要求一个结果，而不是一个按钮：“在我最后一次会议结束时让机舱冷却”，“在早上 7 点之前充电到 100%，仅限非高峰时段”，“如果预计今晚会霜冻，请在我第一次会议之前除霜。”设置一次，它就会自行运行。
plugin_asdk_app_6a591c6c9e8c8191a04f6d0f.productIntroEn: Your Tesla app already sends commands. This plugin is what it can't do. mytesla.io plugs your car into everything your AI already knows — your calendar, the weather, your routines — and decides when to act.
plugin_asdk_app_6a591c6c9e8c8191a04f6d0f.longDescription: Your Tesla app already sends commands. This plugin is what it can't do. mytesla.io plugs your car into everything your AI already knows — your calendar, the weather, your routines — and decides when to act. Ask for an outcome, not a button: "have the cabin cool by the time my last meeting ends," "be charged to 100% by 7 AM, off-peak only," "if frost is forecast tonight, defrost before my first meeting." Set it once and it runs on its own. Or just ask — "where's my car, is it locked, did I leave the windows open in the rain?" — and get one answer pulled from live data across systems, instead of tapping through a dashboard. Climate, charging, security, and status: 40 actions through Tesla's official Fleet API. No driving control, your car tokens stay server-side, revocable anytime. Not affiliated with Tesla, Inc.
plugin_asdk_app_6a591c6c9e8c8191a04f6d0f.longDescriptionZh: 您的 Tesla 应用程序已发送命令。这是这个插件做不到的。 mytesla.io 将您的汽车插入人工智能已知的一切内容——您的日历、天气、日常生活——并决定何时采取行动。要求一个结果，而不是一个按钮：“在我最后一次会议结束时让机舱冷却”，“在早上 7 点之前充电到 100%，仅限非高峰时段”，“如果预计今晚会霜冻，请在我第一次会议之前除霜。”设置一次，它就会自行运行。或者只是问——“我的车在哪里，锁了吗？我在雨中是否把车窗打开了？” - 并从跨系统的实时数据中获取一个答案，而不是通过仪表板进行点击。气候、充电、安全和状态：通过特斯拉官方车队 API 执行 40 项操作。没有驾驶控制，您的汽车令牌保留在服务器端，可以随时撤销。不隶属于特斯拉公司。

plugin_asdk_app_6a48ad108c5c8191bdb66f84.name: Nudges
plugin_asdk_app_6a48ad108c5c8191bdb66f84.description: 通过电子邮件发送提醒
plugin_asdk_app_6a48ad108c5c8191bdb66f84.productIntro: 只需告诉 ChatGPT 要记住什么以及何时记住即可。 Nudges 会确认确切的时间，然后在到期时通过电子邮件发送给您。无需安装应用程序，没有电话号码，没有设置数量上限，也没有付费专区。
plugin_asdk_app_6a48ad108c5c8191bdb66f84.productIntroEn: Just tell ChatGPT what to remember and when. Nudges confirms the exact time, then emails you the moment it's due. No app to install, no phone number, no cap on how many you set, and no paywall.
plugin_asdk_app_6a48ad108c5c8191bdb66f84.longDescription:
Just tell ChatGPT what to remember and when. Nudges confirms the exact time, then emails you the moment it's due. No app to install, no phone number, no cap on how many you set, and no paywall.

It understands the way you actually talk: "in 30 minutes," "tomorrow at 9," "every morning at 8," "every other Friday." Every reminder comes back with the exact local time and the inbox it's headed to, so you catch a mistake before it matters. Ask for your reminders any time, and cancel any one in a sentence.

Nudges is free and unlimited, and it reaches you in the inbox you already check. Your email is verified the moment you connect, so there's nothing to set up. We deliver reminders to that address and count basic usage events to run the service. We never store what your reminders say.
plugin_asdk_app_6a48ad108c5c8191bdb66f84.longDescriptionZh:
只需告诉 ChatGPT 要记住什么以及何时记住即可。 Nudges 会确认确切的时间，然后在到期时通过电子邮件发送给您。无需安装应用程序，没有电话号码，没有设置数量上限，也没有付费专区。

它理解您实际说话的方式：“30 分钟后”、“明天 9 点”、“每天早上 8 点”、“每隔一个星期五”。每个提醒都会返回准确的当地时间和收件箱，因此您可以在重要的事情发生之前发现错误。随时请求您的提醒，并在一句话中取消任何提醒。

Nudges 是免费且不受限制的，它会通过您已查看的收件箱到达您。您的电子邮件在您连接时就会得到验证，因此无需进行任何设置。我们向该地址发送提醒，并统计基本使用事件以运行服务。我们从不存储您的提醒内容。
