plugin_asdk_app_69e8b6ea372c8191b97e6821.name: withPICA
plugin_asdk_app_69e8b6ea372c8191b97e6821.productIntro: withPICA 在一个地方组织和管理您的整个音乐目录 - 您的作品、录音、制作人员、分割、权利和版税。
plugin_asdk_app_69e8b6ea372c8191b97e6821.productIntroEn: withPICA organizes and manages your whole music catalogue in one place — your works, recordings, credits, splits, rights, and royalties.
plugin_asdk_app_69e8b6ea372c8191b97e6821.longDescription:
withPICA organizes and manages your whole music catalogue in one place — your works, recordings, credits, splits, rights, and royalties.

bring your songs in from the sources you already use: Spotify and YouTube links, spreadsheets, photos of liner notes, even DAW sessions. withPICA builds them into one structured, searchable catalog and fills the gaps for you — looking up your ISWCs, ISRCs, publisher data, and collaborator ids from MLC, MusicBrainz, ISNI, and Spotify. you review everything before it's saved.

from there you can verify credits and splits, establish ownership, track royalties and statements, share a single source of truth with your collaborators, and export registration-ready files for your PRO (performing rights organization) or a full catalog asset report. every well-catalogued work gets equal discoverability in the public directory.

music catalogue management, metadata, rights, and royalties — clear, accurate, and yours.
plugin_asdk_app_69e8b6ea372c8191b97e6821.longDescriptionZh:
withPICA 在一个地方组织和管理您的整个音乐目录 - 您的作品、录音、制作人员、分割、权利和版税。

从您已经使用的来源导入您的歌曲：Spotify 和 YouTube 链接、电子表格、内页注释照片，甚至 DAW 会话。 withPICA 将它们构建到一个结构化、可搜索的目录中，并为您填补空白 - 从 MLC、MusicBrainz、ISNI 和 Spotify 查找您的 ISWC、ISRC、出版商数据和合作者 ID。您在保存之前检查所有内容。

从那里，您可以验证版权和分割，建立所有权，跟踪版税和报表，与您的合作者共享单一事实来源，并为您的 PRO（表演权组织）导出注册就绪文件或完整的目录资产报告。每部精心编目的作品在公共目录中都具有同等的可发现性。

音乐目录管理、元数据、权利和版税——清晰、准确，属于您。
defaultPrompts: What's in my music catalog, and what's missing?
Import my song from this Spotify link and register it
Show me a full rights dossier for my song — credits, splits, and AI disclosure
defaultPromptsZh: 我的音乐目录中有哪些内容，缺少哪些内容？
从此 Spotify 链接导入我的歌曲并注册
显示我的歌曲的完整版权档案 — 制作人员、分割和 AI 披露

plugin_asdk_app_6a682b3e30ec819188a1d912.name: Airepoto
plugin_asdk_app_6a682b3e30ec819188a1d912.productIntro: Airepoto 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的会议录音、文字记录和 AI 摘要。
plugin_asdk_app_6a682b3e30ec819188a1d912.productIntroEn: Airepoto connects ChatGPT to your meeting recordings, transcripts, and AI summaries.
plugin_asdk_app_6a682b3e30ec819188a1d912.longDescription:
Airepoto connects ChatGPT to your meeting recordings, transcripts, and AI summaries.

Find meetings across your workspaces and groups, read speaker-labeled transcripts, and get AI summaries with action items — all in natural language, without leaving the conversation.

What you can do
- Search and list meetings across workspaces, groups, and keywords
- Read full transcripts with speaker labels
- Read AI summaries, including decisions and action items
- Ask questions that span several meetings at once
- Create meeting minutes from an audio file, request a new AI summary, move minutes between groups, or move minutes to the trash

Access and privacy
Airepoto uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. Every request is scoped to the signed-in user: the server resolves the verified email claim in the access token to an Airepoto member, and rejects any token without one. You only ever see the meetings your Airepoto account already has access to. Deletion moves minutes to the trash, where they can be restored.

Airepoto is a meeting recording, transcription, and AI-summary service by RSUPPORT Co., Ltd. An Airepoto account is required.
plugin_asdk_app_6a682b3e30ec819188a1d912.longDescriptionZh:

你能做什么
- 跨工作区、组和关键字搜索并列出会议
- 阅读带有演讲者标签的完整文字记录

访问和隐私
Airepoto 使用带有 PKCE 的 OAuth 2.1。每个请求的范围仅限于登录用户：服务器将访问令牌中经过验证的电子邮件声明解析为 Airepoto 成员，并拒绝任何没有令牌的令牌。您只能看到您的 Airepoto 帐户已经有权访问的会议。删除会将分钟移至垃圾箱，在那里可以恢复它们。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4d0a2713b8819190c1b085.name: Is It Down? Availability Check
plugin_asdk_app_6a4d0a2713b8819190c1b085.productIntro: 需要知道网站是否已关闭？输入它的地址，我会为您检查。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4d0a2713b8819190c1b085.productIntroEn: Need to know if a website is down? Type its address and I’ll check it for you.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4d0a2713b8819190c1b085.longDescription:
Need to know if a website is down? Type its address and I’ll check it for you. 

I quickly test if the site can be reached and tell you what I find in clear, simple words. If the site is working, I’ll say it is online. If it is not working, I’ll explain that too. You do not need special computer skills. Just ask, and I’ll do the checking.

This is helpful when a page will not load, an app will not connect, or a service seems broken. Many problems look the same, but they can have different causes. A website may be down for everyone. It may only be blocked for you. Your internet may have a problem. The site may be slow. I help you understand what is most likely happening so you know what to try next.

Using me is easy. Tell me the website you want to check. You can paste a full web address or simply type the name of the site. I will test whether it can be reached and share the result in plain English. If there is useful extra information, I will explain what it means without lots of hard words.

You can check almost any public website. News sites, shops, games, schools, blogs, company pages, and online tools can all be checked. If a page is public on the internet, I can usually test whether it is responding. If a site cannot be checked for a technical reason, I will tell you instead of guessing.

If a website is online, I can help you think about why it still is not working for you. Maybe your browser needs to refresh. Maybe your internet connection has a problem. Maybe a VPN, firewall, or network setting is getting in the way. Sometimes waiting a few minutes is enough because a busy service starts working again.

If a website is down, I explain that in a simple way. I will not make up reasons or pretend to know something I cannot see. If there is not enough information, I will say so. Clear answers are better than confusing ones.

This tool is useful for everyone. Students can check school websites before class. Families can see if a favorite game or video site is having trouble. Workers can test company pages before reporting a problem. Developers can quickly check a public site before spending time looking for bugs. Support teams can use it as a fast first step when helping customers.

You can ask things like “Is this website down?”, “Can you check example.com?”, “Why won’t this page load?”, “Is the server online?”, or “Can anyone reach this site?” I understand many different ways of asking the same question, so you do not have to use special commands.

My goal is to save you time. Instead of trying many different things, start with a quick check. Knowing whether a website is online or offline helps you decide what to do next. That can stop wasted time, reduce worry, and make fixing problems much easier.

I focus on giving short, useful answers first. If you want more detail, just ask. I can explain what the result means, what you can try next, and which common problems might fit the situation. I keep the language simple, avoid unnecessary jargon, and stay honest about what I know.

Whether you are checking one website or many, I aim to make the process fast, clear, and easy. Paste a web address, type a site name, or ask if a service is down. I’ll check its reachability, explain the result, and help you understand what to do next.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4d0a2713b8819190c1b085.longDescriptionZh:
需要知道网站是否已关闭？输入它的地址，我会为您检查。 

我会快速测试该网站是否可以访问，并用清晰、简单的语言告诉您我发现了什么。如果该网站正在运行，我会说它是在线的。如果它不起作用，我也会解释一下。您不需要特殊的计算机技能。只要询问，我就会进行检查。

当页面无法加载、应用程序无法连接或服务似乎损坏时，这非常有用。许多问题看起来很相似，但它们可能有不同的原因。每个人的网站都可能无法访问。可能只有你被屏蔽了。您的互联网可能有问题。该网站可能会很慢。我帮助您了解最有可能发生的情况，以便您知道下一步要尝试什么。

使用我很容易。告诉我你想查的网站。您可以粘贴完整的网址或仅键入网站名称。我会测试是否可以达到并用简单的英语分享结果。如果有有用的额外信息，我会解释它的含义，而不用太多晦涩难懂的话。

您几乎可以查看任何公共网站。新闻网站、商店、游戏、学校、博客、公司页面和在线工具都可以检查。如果一个页面在互联网上是公开的，我通常可以测试它是否有响应。如果某个网站因技术原因无法检查，我会告诉你而不是猜测。

如果一个网站是在线的，我可以帮助您思考为什么它仍然不适合您。也许您的浏览器需要刷新。也许您的互联网连接有问题。也许 VPN、防火墙或网络设置造成了阻碍。有时等待几分钟就足够了，因为繁忙的服务再次开始工作。

如果某个网站出现故障，我会用简单的方式进行解释。我不会编造理由或假装知道我看不到的事情。如果没有足够的信息，我会这么说。清晰的答案比令人困惑的答案更好。

这个工具对每个人都有用。学生可以在课前查看学校网站。家人可以查看喜爱的游戏或视频网站是否出现问题。工作人员可以在报告问题之前测试公司页面。开发人员可以在花时间寻找错误之前快速检查公共站点。支持团队可以将其用作帮助客户的快速第一步。
您可以询问诸如“此网站是否已关闭？”、“您可以检查 example.com 吗？”、“为什么此页面无法加载？”、“服务器在线吗？”或“任何人都可以访问此网站吗？”我了解提出同一问题的多种不同方式，因此您不必使用特殊命令。

我的目标是节省您的时间。不要尝试许多不同的事情，而是从快速检查开始。了解网站是在线还是离线可以帮助您决定下一步该做什么。这可以避免浪费时间，减少担忧，并使解决问题变得更加容易。

我首先专注于给出简短、有用的答案。如果您想了解更多详细信息，请询问。我可以解释结果的含义、下一步可以尝试什么以及哪些常见问题可能适合这种情况。我保持语言简单，避免不必要的行话，并对我所知道的保持诚实。

无论您是查看一个还是多个网站，我的目标是让这一过程变得快速、清晰和简单。粘贴网址、键入站点名称或询问服务是否已关闭。我将检查其可达性，解释结果，并帮助您了解下一步该做什么。

plugin_asdk_app_6a622afd7288819194766478.longDescription:
Vasara connects ChatGPT to Lithuania's primary legal sources: national legislation, EU regulations and directives, and case law from the Constitutional Court, Supreme Court, Supreme Administrative Court, the Court of Justice of the EU, and the European Court of Human Rights.

Use it to look up a specific court decision by case number, search case law and legislation by topic, pull relevant passages from long legal documents, or find guidance from state authorities and municipalities — with sources ChatGPT can cite directly in its answers.

Plugin searches and retrieves legal sources, doesn't create, edit, or submit anything. Requires a Vasara account.
plugin_asdk_app_6a622afd7288819194766478.longDescriptionZh:
Vasara 将 ChatGPT 与立陶宛的主要法律来源连接起来：国家立法、欧盟法规和指令以及宪法法院、最高法院、最高行政法院、欧盟法院和欧洲人权法院的判例法。

使用它可以按案件编号查找特定的法院判决，按主题搜索判例法和立法，从冗长的法律文件中提取相关段落，或查找州当局和市政府的指导 - ChatGPT 可以在其答案中直接引用来源。

Reportei is a marketing reporting and dashboard platform designed for agencies 
and marketing teams. It provides a unified data layer where all your client 
performance data is stored, structured, and accessible.

With this integration, your AI assistant connects directly to your Reportei 
account and can:

- Fetch structured marketing metrics stored in Reportei for any client project 
  and date range
- Browse your projects, connected data sources, and available templates
- Create reports and live dashboards for any client project
- Set up and manage scheduled report automations with email or notification delivery
- Log timeline events and milestones for client projects

All data is served from Reportei's own API. Reportei manages authorization and 
data collection from each connected source on your behalf.

This integration is intended for existing Reportei subscribers who want to 
query their account data and automate reporting workflows through conversation.

- 通过电子邮件或通知传递设置和管理计划的报告自动化

所有数据均由 Reportei 自己的 API 提供。 Reportei 管理授权和 
代表您从每个连接的源收集数据。

此集成适用于想要的现有 Reportei 订阅者 
通过对话查询他们的帐户数据并自动化报告工作流程。

plugin_asdk_app_6a57946a7e008191a57e77c8.productIntro: LIAM 是个人记忆助手。它可以保存并回忆您想要在对话中保留的事实、偏好和注释；存储和搜索您的联系人；保留多步骤食谱和例程；并记录您的膳食和收据以及每日营养和支出摘要。您可以输入请求或仅上传照片（收据、餐食、名片或便条），LIAM 会读取它并自动将其归档在正确的位置（餐厅收据会同时记录为费用和餐食）。仅存储提取的文本/值，而不存储原始图像。 示例用例 “记住，我更喜欢飞机上靠窗的座位——把它标记为‘旅行’。
plugin_asdk_app_6a57946a7e008191a57e77c8.productIntroEn: LIAM is a personal memory assistant. It saves and recalls the facts, preferences, and notes you want to keep across conversations; stores and searches your contacts; keeps multi-step recipes and routines; and logs your meals and receipts with daily nutrition and spending summaries.
plugin_asdk_app_6a57946a7e008191a57e77c8.longDescription:
LIAM is a personal memory assistant. It saves and recalls the facts, preferences, and notes you want to keep across conversations; stores and searches your contacts; keeps multi-step recipes and routines; and logs your meals and receipts with daily nutrition and spending summaries. You can type a request or just upload a photo — a receipt, a meal, a business card, or a note — and LIAM reads it and files it in the right place automatically (a restaurant receipt is logged as both an expense and a meal). Only extracted text/values are stored, never the raw image.
Example use cases
"Remember I prefer window seats on flights — tag it 'travel'."
"Who do I know at Nova Retail?" / "Add Sarah Chen from Acme as a contact."
"Log my lunch: chicken caesar salad" → "How much protein did I have today?"
"Log this receipt: Loblaws $87.43 groceries" → "How much did I spend today?"
Upload a business-card photo → contact created; upload a receipt photo → expense + meal logged.
plugin_asdk_app_6a57946a7e008191a57e77c8.longDescriptionZh:
LIAM 是个人记忆助手。它可以保存并回忆您想要在对话中保留的事实、偏好和注释；存储和搜索您的联系人；保留多步骤食谱和例程；并记录您的膳食和收据以及每日营养和支出摘要。您可以输入请求或仅上传照片（收据、餐食、名片或便条），LIAM 会读取它并自动将其归档在正确的位置（餐厅收据会同时记录为费用和餐食）。仅存储提取的文本/值，而不存储原始图像。

“记住，我更喜欢飞机上靠窗的座位——把它标记为‘旅行’。”
“我在 Nova Retail 认识谁？” /“添加 Acme 的 Sarah Chen 作为联系人。”

“记录这张收据：Loblaws 87.43 美元杂货”→“我今天花了多少钱？”
上传名片照片 → 创建联系人；上传收据照片 → 记录费用+餐食。
defaultPrompts: Remember that I prefer window seats on flights and I'm allergic to shellfish

Log my lunch — chicken caesar salad — and tell me how much protein I've had today

记录我的午餐——鸡肉凯撒沙拉——并告诉我今天摄入了多少蛋白质

Tolstoy Library brings your video and image content into ChatGPT.

Tolstoy Library 将您的视频和图像内容带入 ChatGPT。

plugin_asdk_app_69fa6610711c8191bffd6775.name: 1to1 Mate
plugin_asdk_app_69fa6610711c8191bffd6775.description: 每 1:1 的 AI 背景
plugin_asdk_app_69fa6610711c8191bffd6775.productIntro: 1to1 Mate 是一款围绕一对一会议构建的关系管理应用程序。
plugin_asdk_app_69fa6610711c8191bffd6775.productIntroEn: 1to1 Mate is a relationship management app built around 1:1 meetings.
plugin_asdk_app_69fa6610711c8191bffd6775.longDescription:
1to1 Mate is a relationship management app built around 1:1 meetings.

It is an "external memory" tool for people whose work depends on stacking one-on-one conversations — sales professionals,
community builders, managers, founders, advisors, and anyone who runs recurring 1:1s.

CORE FEATURES

・Member management: Structured storage of each person's goals, values, skills, referral needs, background, and tags
・AI meeting notes: Automatic transcription of meeting audio with AI-generated summaries and action items
・Dashboard: Chronological view of who you met, when, and what you discussed
・Profile import: Extract member information from business cards or web pages
・Referral matching: AI suggests who to introduce to whom based on past conversations

Note: the above are features of the 1to1 Mate app itself. Audio transcription, new meeting note creation, and member
registration all happen inside the 1to1 Mate app. The MCP / ChatGPT integration only provides read-only access to data already
 recorded through those features.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH CHATGPT

Once you connect 1to1 Mate to ChatGPT, you can ask things like:

・"Draft the next agenda for my 1:1 with Tanaka based on what we discussed last time."
・"Find members who are struggling with marketing."
・"Who on my member list would be a good introduction for Yamada, given her goals?"
・"Summarize the action items I committed to across last month's 1:1s."

The AI reads your data on a strictly read-only basis. Nothing is modified or deleted through this connection.

PERMISSIONS & DATA HANDLING

・A Pro plan subscription is required to connect
・Authentication via OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; sign in with your Google account
・Raw contact details (phone numbers, email addresses, messaging IDs) are never exposed to the AI. Not even the channel type label is returned — the MCP layer simply omits all contact-related fields
・You can disconnect the integration at any time from your account settings

See https://1to1mate.com/guide/mcp for the full connection walkthrough and the exact fields each tool returns.
plugin_asdk_app_69fa6610711c8191bffd6775.longDescriptionZh:
1to1 Mate 是一款围绕一对一会议构建的关系管理应用程序。

对于那些工作依赖于堆积一对一对话的人来说，它是一种“外部记忆”工具——销售专业人员、
社区建设者、经理、创始人、顾问以及任何进行定期一对一交流的人。

核心特点

・会员管理：结构化存储每个人的目标、价值观、技能、推荐需求、背景和标签
・人工智能会议记录：自动转录会议音频以及人工智能生成的摘要和行动项目
・仪表板：按时间顺序显示您遇到的人、时间以及讨论的内容
・资料导入：从名片或网页中提取会员信息
・推荐匹配：人工智能根据过去的对话建议向谁介绍谁

注：以上是1to1 Mate应用程序本身的功能。音频转录、新会议记录创建和成员
注册全部发生在 1to1 Mate 应用程序内。 MCP / ChatGPT 集成仅提供对已存在数据的只读访问
 通过这些功能记录下来。

您可以使用 CHATPT 做什么

将 1to1 Mate 连接到 ChatGPT 后，您可以询问以下问题：

・“根据上次讨论的内容，起草我和田中1:1的下一个议程。”
・“寻找在营销方面遇到困难的会员。”
・“考虑到山田的目标，我的成员名单上的谁会是一个很好的介绍人？”
・“总结一下我在上个月的一对一会议中承诺的行动项目。”

人工智能以严格只读的方式读取您的数据。通过此连接不会修改或删除任何内容。

权限和数据处理

・需要订阅 Pro 套餐才能连接
・通过 OAuth 2.1 使用 PKCE 进行身份验证；使用您的 Google 帐户登录
・原始联系方式（电话号码、电子邮件地址、消息 ID）永远不会暴露给人工智能。甚至不返回通道类型标签 - MCP 层只是省略所有与联系人相关的字段
・您可以随时从您的帐户设置中断开集成

请参阅 https://1to1mate.com/guide/mcp 了解完整的连接演练以及每个工具返回的确切字段。

plugin_asdk_app_6a206df34f6c8191a125958d.productIntro: Anchor 为 ChatGPT 提供了一个共享驱动器，可以在其中创建文件并将其组织到文件夹中。 ChatGPT 可以读写 HTML、Markdown (MD)、JSON、CSV 和其他文本格式的文件，设计类型表并使用 SQL 查询它们。它可以移动文件、制作副本并使一切井井有条。它创建的每个文件、表和文件夹都可以与您的团队共享，而 Anchor 则负责处理存储、权限和版本控制。登录一次，无需 API 密钥，无需设置，ChatGPT 只会触及您可以访问的内容。

plugin_asdk_app_69b7b4b8c9288191898267eb.name: Priority Guardian
plugin_asdk_app_69b7b4b8c9288191898267eb.productIntro: 优先守护者——您的优先事项值得的不仅仅是良好的意愿。
plugin_asdk_app_69b7b4b8c9288191898267eb.productIntroEn: Priority Guardian — Your priorities deserve more than good intentions.
plugin_asdk_app_69b7b4b8c9288191898267eb.longDescription:
Priority Guardian — Your priorities deserve more than good intentions.

Protected Time, Flexible Planning: Priorities don't fail because you stopped caring. They fail because everything else is loud and your most important work is quiet. Priority Guardian makes the quiet work visible — so you can protect it.

Built for people who do entrepreneurial work and juggle more than one thing at a time.

HOW IT WORKS:
Priority Guardian connects your priorities to your Google Calendar so you can see where your time is actually going and stay accountable to what matters. 

Two modes:
Deadline work — hours invested, pace against deadline, where effort is going
Ongoing commitments — weekly hour targets, streaks, monthly results check-in


1. Kick off with: "Set up my priorities in Priority Guardian."
2. Name your priorities and assign a keyword (P1, P2, P3) to tag your Google Calendar events
3. See your priorities dashboard anytime — current progress at a glance. → "Show me my priorities."
4. Get your first weekly report  → "Show me my weekly report."
5. Inspect and adjust weekly → "Let's dig into what helps me progress/ hinders my progress"
6. Discover patterns over time  → "How was I keeping up with my priorities over the last weeks and months?"

The AI guides setup, narrates your data, and asks the questions worth sitting with. You decide what to do with it.
plugin_asdk_app_69b7b4b8c9288191898267eb.longDescriptionZh:
优先守护者——您的优先事项值得的不仅仅是良好的意愿。

受保护的时间，灵活的计划：优先事项不会因为您不再关心而失败。他们之所以失败，是因为其他一切都很吵闹，而你最重要的工作却很安静。 Priority Guardian 让安静的工作变得可见，这样您就可以保护它。

专为从事创业工作并同时处理多件事的人们而设计。

运作原理：
Priority Guardian 将您的优先事项连接到您的 Google 日历，以便您可以了解自己的时间实际花在哪里，并对重要的事情负责。 

两种模式：
截止日期工作——投入的时间、截止日期的进度、努力的方向
持续的承诺——每周工作时间目标、连续时间、每月结果检查


1. 首先：“在优先监护人中设置我的优先事项。”
2. 指定您的优先事项并指定关键字（P1、P2、P3）来标记您的 Google 日历活动
3. 随时查看您的优先事项仪表板 — 当前进度一目了然。 →“告诉我我的优先事项。”
4. 获取您的第一份周报告→“显示我的周报告。”
5. 每周检查和调整→“让我们深入研究一下是什么帮助我进步/阻碍我进步”
6.随着时间的推移发现模式→“过去几周和几个月我是如何跟上我的优先事项的？”

人工智能指导设置、讲述数据并提出值得思考的问题。您决定如何处理它。
defaultPrompts: Show me my priorities
Show me how I spent my non-priority time
How was I keeping up with my priorities in the last few months?
defaultPromptsZh: 显示我的优先事项
告诉我我是如何度过非优先时间的
过去几个月我如何跟上我的优先事项？

plugin_asdk_app_6a3ba5ef1c448191a4c89868.description: 搜索摩洛哥法律和裁决
plugin_asdk_app_6a3ba5ef1c448191a4c89868.productIntro: Juridata 将摩洛哥法律研究直接引入 ChatGPT。搜索数千份法院判决（判例）和法律文本，然后在几秒钟内打开完整文档 - 不再需要挖掘分散的数据库。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3ba5ef1c448191a4c89868.productIntroEn: Juridata brings Moroccan legal research directly into ChatGPT. Search thousands of court decisions (jurisprudence) and legal texts, then open the full document in seconds — no more digging through scattered databases.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3ba5ef1c448191a4c89868.longDescription:
Juridata brings Moroccan legal research directly into ChatGPT. Search thousands of court decisions (jurisprudence) and legal texts, then open the full document in seconds — no more digging through scattered databases.

Ask in plain language and Juridata surfaces the relevant rulings and statutes, with filters by court chamber, year, and legal category. Whether you're a lawyer building a case, a law student researching precedent, or a business checking your obligations, you get answers grounded in real Moroccan legal sources.

The first AI legal research assistant for Morocco and North Africa in ChatGPT — making the region's case law and legislation searchable, readable, and instantly accessible.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3ba5ef1c448191a4c89868.longDescriptionZh:
Juridata 将摩洛哥法律研究直接引入 ChatGPT。搜索数千份法院判决（判例）和法律文本，然后在几秒钟内打开完整文档 - 不再需要挖掘分散的数据库。

用简单的语言询问，Juridata 就会显示相关的裁决和法规，并按法庭、年份和法律类别进行过滤。无论您是立案的律师、研究先例的法学院学生，还是检查您的义务的企业，您都会得到基于真实摩洛哥法律来源的答案。

Describe a topic, paste in text, or share a file (TXT, PPTX, PDF, DOCX, XLS, or HTML), and Twistly builds a structured deck of up to 50 slides with clear layouts and matching visuals in seconds. plugin_asdk_app_6a578a625b448191ac23be68.longDescription:
Twistly turns your ideas, notes, and documents into ready-to-edit PowerPoint presentations. Describe a topic, paste in text, or share a file (TXT, PPTX, PDF, DOCX, XLS, or HTML), and Twistly builds a structured deck of up to 50 slides with clear layouts and matching visuals in seconds. Pick from 50+ templates to keep a consistent, on-brand look.
Everything comes out as a native, fully editable .pptx file, not a web export, so it opens cleanly in PowerPoint with no broken layouts. Edit it by hand like any normal presentation, or use the Twistly add-in for PowerPoint to keep refining and redesigning your slides. Nothing stays locked in a separate editor.
Used by students, educators, business professionals, and teams around the world.

plugin_asdk_app_6a2f8d084db08191aec15ef7.productIntro: 表单字段提取器从用户提供的表单文本中提取字段名称和值，并返回结构化字段结果。
plugin_asdk_app_6a2f8d084db08191aec15ef7.productIntroEn: Form Field Extractor extracts field names and values from user-provided form text and returns a structured field result.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2f8d084db08191aec15ef7.longDescription:
Form Field Extractor extracts field names and values from user-provided form text and returns a structured field result.

It is designed for forms such as registration forms, application forms, customer intake forms, feedback forms, onboarding forms, and similar business form text.

The app can identify form-like lines, extract field names and values, normalize field names when requested, identify empty fields, and provide a short extraction summary.

This app is read-only. It does not submit forms, modify forms, validate required fields, check whether a form is ready to submit, approve or reject applications, contact people, send emails, call phone numbers, update CRM systems, update databases, or perform any external system action.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2f8d084db08191aec15ef7.longDescriptionZh:
表单字段提取器从用户提供的表单文本中提取字段名称和值，并返回结构化字段结果。

它专为注册表、申请表、客户接收表、反馈表、入职表和类似的业务表单文本等表单而设计。

该应用程序可以识别类似表单的行，提取字段名称和值，根据请求规范字段名称，识别空字段并提供简短的提取摘要。

此应用程序是只读的。它不会提交表单、修改表单、验证必填字段、检查表单是否准备好提交、批准或拒绝申请、联系人员、发送电子邮件、拨打电话号码、更新 CRM 系统、更新数据库或执行任何外部系统操作。

plugin_asdk_app_6a76984525848191901ac2d2.name: CodeQR - Link and QR Analytics
plugin_asdk_app_6a76984525848191901ac2d2.description: 可编辑、可追踪的二维码
plugin_asdk_app_6a76984525848191901ac2d2.productIntro: CodeQR 创建短链接和 QR 码，在打印或共享后仍可编辑。每个代码都编码一个短链接而不是目的地本身，因此您可以更改它的通向位置而无需重新打印任何内容，并且每次扫描和点击都会记录时间、国家/地区和设备。它适合这样的工作：代码必须在创建之日起就一直存在：每个房产列表、每个客户、每个证书、每个职位发布或登录页面移动的印刷活动都有一个代码。
plugin_asdk_app_6a76984525848191901ac2d2.productIntroEn: CodeQR creates short links and QR codes that stay editable after they are printed or shared. Each code encodes a short link instead of the destination itself, so you can change where it leads without reprinting anything, and every scan and click is recorded with time, country, and device.
plugin_asdk_app_6a76984525848191901ac2d2.longDescription: CodeQR creates short links and QR codes that stay editable after they are printed or shared. Each code encodes a short link instead of the destination itself, so you can change where it leads without reprinting anything, and every scan and click is recorded with time, country, and device. It fits work where a code has to outlive the moment it was made: one code per property listing, per customer, per certificate, per job posting, or a printed campaign whose landing page moves. Your agent can create short links and QR codes on your own domain or a shared one, change where an existing code points, list codes it made earlier, and pull scan, click, lead, and sale analytics for one code or for the whole workspace.
plugin_asdk_app_6a76984525848191901ac2d2.longDescriptionZh: CodeQR 创建短链接和 QR 码，在打印或共享后仍可编辑。每个代码都编码一个短链接而不是目的地本身，因此您可以更改它的通向位置而无需重新打印任何内容，并且每次扫描和点击都会记录时间、国家/地区和设备。它适合这样的工作：代码必须在创建之日起就一直存在：每个房产列表、每个客户、每个证书、每个职位发布或登录页面移动的印刷活动都有一个代码。您的代理可以在您自己的域或共享域上创建短链接和二维码，更改现有代码点的位置，列出之前制作的代码，并对一个代码或整个工作区进行拉扫描、点击、潜在客户和销售分析。

plugin_asdk_app_6948b56084f88191b0c86f77.longDescription:
1. Exclusive Side-by-Side View 
Instant Verification: Unlike native ChatGPT, our split-screen mode lets you compare original and translated text paragraph by paragraph for instant accuracy checks.
2. Preserve Original Layout 
Format Retention: Keeps tables, charts, and text layout perfectly structured so you can read with ease—no more broken formatting.
3. Global Language Support 
50+ Languages: Easily translate English to Spanish, French to German, and more with professional precision.
4. Download & Ready-to-Use 
Clean PDF Output: Get a downloadable, layout-preserved PDF instantly. No more copying raw Markdown text manually.

Ideal Use Cases: For business professionals, students, and researchers who need to translate contracts and papers without losing the original formatting.

How to Use in ChatGPT
1. Connect App: Connect PDF Translator to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Type “@PDF Translator ”.
Sample prompts: "@PDF Translator Translate this PDF to Spanish."

1. 独家并排视图 
即时验证：与原生 ChatGPT 不同，我们的分屏模式可让您逐段比较原始文本和翻译文本，以进行即时准确性检查。
2. 保留原始布局 
格式保留：保持表格、图表和文本布局完美的结构，以便您可以轻松阅读 - 不再出现格式损坏的情况。
3. 全球语言支持 
50 多种语言：以专业的精度轻松将英语翻译成西班牙语、法语翻译成德语等。
4. 下载并立即使用 
干净的 PDF 输出：立即获取可下载、保留布局的 PDF。不再需要手动复制原始 Markdown 文本。

理想用例：适合需要翻译合同和论文而不丢失原始格式的商业专业人士、学生和研究人员。

如何在 ChatGPT 中使用
1. 连接应用程序：将 PDF 翻译器连接到 ChatGPT。
2. 触发：输入“@PDF Translator”。
示例提示：“@PDF 翻译器将此 PDF 翻译为西班牙语。”

plugin_asdk_app_6a3a264ac530819183680874.name: AI Attorney Pakistan
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a264ac530819183680874.productIntro: AI律师通过只读法律语料库帮助用户研究巴基斯坦法律。 它可以找到巴基斯坦的判决和先例，检索案件的完整细节 通过 ID 或法律报告引用已知案例，并从中查找相关条款 巴基斯坦的法案、条例、法典、规则、条例和宪法。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a264ac530819183680874.productIntroEn: AI Attorney helps users research Pakistani law through a read-only legal corpus. It can find Pakistani judgments and precedents, retrieve the full details of a known case by ID or law-report citation, and locate relevant provisions from Pakistani Acts, Ordinances, codes, rules, regulations, and the Constitution.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a264ac530819183680874.longDescription:
AI Attorney helps users research Pakistani law through a read-only legal corpus.
It can find Pakistani judgments and precedents, retrieve the full details of a
known case by ID or law-report citation, and locate relevant provisions from
Pakistani Acts, Ordinances, codes, rules, regulations, and the Constitution.

For Pakistan-specific legal questions and fact patterns, the plugin can supply
case law, legislation, or both so ChatGPT can produce a source-grounded answer.
Case results include citations and links when available. Full case records may
also include the earlier authorities cited by a judgment and later judgments that
cite it. Citation history does not by itself establish that a case remains good
law.

The plugin is retrieval-only: it does not file cases, contact courts, create or
modify external records, or act on a user's behalf. It requires an existing AI
Attorney account and eligible entitlement. Retrieved material and generated
analysis should be independently verified and are not a substitute for advice
from a qualified legal professional.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a264ac530819183680874.longDescriptionZh:
AI律师通过只读法律语料库帮助用户研究巴基斯坦法律。
它可以找到巴基斯坦的判决和先例，检索案件的完整细节
通过 ID 或法律报告引用已知案例，并从中查找相关条款
巴基斯坦的法案、条例、法典、规则、条例和宪法。

对于巴基斯坦特定的法律问题和事实模式，该插件可以提供
判例法、立法或两者兼而有之，以便 ChatGPT 可以生成基于来源的答案。
案例结果包括可用的引文和链接。完整的案件记录可能
还包括判决所引用的早期权威以及后来的判决
引用它。引用历史本身并不能证明案例仍然良好
法。

该插件仅供检索：它不会归档案件、联系法院、创建或
修改外部记录，或代表用户行事。它需要现有的人工智能
律师帐户和合格权利。检索材料并生成
分析应经过独立验证，不能替代建议
来自合格的法律专业人士。

plugin_asdk_app_6a22ce5f60dc8191a56bf3f6.longDescription: tela is a markdown-native team wiki where AI agents are first-class participants. Connect ChatGPT to your team's knowledge base to read, write, and maintain docs at scale. • Semantic search ("research") — answer questions by meaning, returning assembled grounding from full page bodies with flagged source disagreements • Keyword search — ranked, snippet-highlighted full-text lookup • Authoring — create, update, and surgically patch pages; move, delete, share with public links • Knowledge health — surface near-duplicate pages, identify unanswered questions, suggest links • Atlas — auto-generate technical docs from git repos and Jira; trigger re-ingestion, poll coverage • Presentations — author, lint, and preview Slidev slide decks stored as wiki pages. Connect by signing in with your tela account. Self-host via docker compose (AGPL) or use telawiki.com.

plugin_asdk_app_6a42b1a21e3c8191a436847a.productIntro: 将您的 Userflow 帐户连接到官方 Userflow MCP 以查询产品采用数据并直接在 ChatGPT 中构建。询问流程、细分、用户和分析（完成率、NPS、调查响应和事件数据），以了解用户如何浏览您的产品并找到他们陷入困境的地方，然后让 ChatGPT 创建答案指向的细分、流程、图表或仪表板。每次写入都会作为草稿返回给您审阅；没有您，任何内容都无法发布，无需离开 ChatGPT。
plugin_asdk_app_6a42b1a21e3c8191a436847a.productIntroEn: Connect your Userflow account to the official Userflow MCP to query product adoption data and build directly in ChatGPT. plugin_asdk_app_6a42b1a21e3c8191a436847a.longDescription: Connect your Userflow account to the official Userflow MCP to query product adoption data and build directly in ChatGPT. Every write comes back as a draft you review; nothing publishes without you, all without leaving ChatGPT.

plugin_asdk_app_6a6aaa5d13bc8191bd7384e0.name: Atlas AI Agent
plugin_asdk_app_6a6aaa5d13bc8191bd7384e0.productIntro: Atlas AI Agent 将您的 Atlas 工作区带入 ChatGPT，将三名助手集中在一处。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6aaa5d13bc8191bd7384e0.productIntroEn: Atlas AI Agent brings your Atlas workspace into ChatGPT, with three assistants in one place.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6aaa5d13bc8191bd7384e0.longDescription:
Atlas AI Agent brings your Atlas workspace into ChatGPT, with three assistants in one place.

Ask for a briefing and the executive assistant reads your connected mailbox and calendar to tell you what needs attention today, what decisions are pending, and what you're still waiting on. Ask about sales and you get live pipeline figures, your leads ranked by score across campaigns, and a personalised outreach email drafted for whichever lead you name. Ask about marketing and you get channel performance, everything in the content queue with its status, whatever is sitting in your approvals, and new post drafts on request.

Nothing is sent or published from ChatGPT. Outreach emails and social posts come back as drafts you approve inside Atlas, so the assistant can never speak to a customer on your behalf without you seeing it first.

Connecting is a normal sign-in, and permissions are granted per assistant: you can give ChatGPT your marketing without handing over your inbox, and disconnect any time from Atlas under Connected apps.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6aaa5d13bc8191bd7384e0.longDescriptionZh:
Atlas AI Agent 将您的 Atlas 工作区带入 ChatGPT，将三名助手集中在一处。

如果要求提供简报，行政助理会读取您连接的邮箱和日历，告诉您今天需要注意什么、哪些决定正在等待以及您仍在等待什么。询问销售情况，您将获得实时渠道数据、按营销活动得分排名的潜在客户，以及为您指定的潜在客户起草的个性化外展电子邮件。询问营销方面的问题，您可以获得渠道绩效、内容队列中的所有内容及其状态、您批准的内容以及根据要求提供的新帖子草稿。

ChatGPT 不会发送或发布任何内容。外展电子邮件和社交帖子会作为您在 Atlas 内批准的草稿返回，因此在您没有先看到之前，助理永远无法代表您与客户交谈。

连接是正常登录，每个助理都会授予权限：您可以在不移交收件箱的情况下向 ChatGPT 提供营销信息，并随时在“已连接的应用程序”下断开与 Atlas 的连接。

plugin_asdk_app_694a4cde0c0881918c8d6b33.longDescription:
Don't let your temporary conversations disappear. Chat2Doc helps you save, view, and chat with your history. Turn your chats into a permanent Knowledge Base of editable documents.
1. Save What Matters
- Save ChatGPT History: Save chats as editable documents to capture and refine insights.
2. View Saved History
- Instant Access: Click the "View History" button to browse your saved chat history directly in the chat window.
3. Chat with Your History
- Use Your Knowledge Base: Ask ChatGPT to generate new content based specifically on your collection.

How to Use in ChatGPT
1. Connect App: Connect Chat2Doc to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Type “@Chat2Doc”.
Sample Prompts
- Save: "@Chat2Doc Save this conversation."
- Chat: "@Chat2Doc Research 'AI Trends' using my Knowledge Base to draft a comprehensive report."
plugin_asdk_app_694a4cde0c0881918c8d6b33.longDescriptionZh:
不要让临时谈话消失。 Chat2Doc 可帮助您保存、查看和聊天您的历史记录。将您的聊天变成可编辑文档的永久知识库。
1. 保存重要的东西
- 保存 ChatGPT 历史记录：将聊天保存为可编辑文档以捕获和完善见解。
2.查看保存的历史记录
- 即时访问：点击“查看历史记录”按钮，可直接在聊天窗口中浏览您保存的聊天记录。
3. 与你的历史聊天
- 使用您的知识库：要求 ChatGPT 根据您的收藏生成新内容。

如何在 ChatGPT 中使用
1. 连接应用程序：将 Chat2Doc 连接到 ChatGPT。
2. 触发器：输入“@Chat2Doc”。
示例提示
- 保存：“@Chat2Doc 保存此对话。”
- 聊天：“@Chat2Doc 使用我的知识库研究‘人工智能趋势’，起草一份综合报告。”

plugin_asdk_app_6a83795db1e48191be5a38ce.name: SuperMCP
plugin_asdk_app_6a83795db1e48191be5a38ce.productIntro: SuperMCP 根据以色列在线超市的购物清单定价，并告诉您哪家商店将其运送到您的地址，价格最低。
plugin_asdk_app_6a83795db1e48191be5a38ce.productIntroEn: SuperMCP prices a shopping list against Israeli online supermarkets and tells you which store delivers it for the least, to your address.
plugin_asdk_app_6a83795db1e48191be5a38ce.longDescription:
SuperMCP prices a shopping list against Israeli online supermarkets and tells you which store delivers it for the least, to your address.

Give it a list in Hebrew and a delivery address. It matches each item to real products in each chain's catalogue, adds delivery fees where the chain publishes verified terms, and returns a per-store total with a per-item breakdown, plus a link to each product on the retailer's own site.

It is built not to guess. Items a store does not carry are marked missing rather than swapped silently, every price carries the date it was last seen in the chain's price file, and a delivery fee is quoted only when the chain publishes terms that have been verified. When several products match one line, it asks you instead of picking for you.

Prices come from the price files Israeli retailers publish under the Price Transparency Law, ingested nightly.

Coverage is Israeli online supermarket delivery, and the product catalogue is in Hebrew.
plugin_asdk_app_6a83795db1e48191be5a38ce.longDescriptionZh:
SuperMCP 根据以色列在线超市的购物清单定价，并告诉您哪家商店将其运送到您的地址，价格最低。

给它一份希伯来语列表和送货地址。它将每个商品与每个连锁店目录中的真实产品进行匹配，在连锁店发布经过验证的条款的情况下添加送货费用，并返回每个商店的总计以及每个商品的详细信息，以及零售商自己网站上每个产品的链接。

它的建立不是为了猜测。商店不销售的商品会被标记为丢失，而不是默默地交换，每个价格都带有该连锁店价格文件中最后一次出现的日期，并且只有当连锁店发布经过验证的条款时才会报价送货费。当多个产品与一条线匹配时，它会询问您而不是为您挑选。

价格来自以色列零售商根据价格透明度法发布的价格文件，每晚获取。

覆盖范围为以色列在线超市配送，产品目录为希伯来语。

plugin_asdk_app_6a30ab89b10081919f808589.longDescription: AirPrompter helps users find, inspect, create, improve, and run saved AirPrompter prompts and saved AirPrompter workflows from ChatGPT. plugin_asdk_app_6a0100e531548191b53db8ed.productIntro: Temponia 是一款时间跟踪和时间表应用程序，适合自由职业者、代理机构和内部团队，他们希望记录自己的工作时间，但又不想让自己感觉是一件苦差事。
plugin_asdk_app_6a0100e531548191b53db8ed.productIntroEn: Temponia is a time-tracking and timesheet app for freelancers, agencies, and in-house teams who want their hours logged without it feeling like a chore.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0100e531548191b53db8ed.longDescription:
Temponia is a time-tracking and timesheet app for freelancers, agencies, and in-house teams who want their hours logged without it feeling like a chore.

Instead of a long list of empty fields, Temponia gives you a calendar view: drag to log hours the way you'd block out a meeting. Connect Google Calendar or Outlook and turn existing events into billable entries in a click. Native iOS and Android apps keep your week up to date when you're away from your desk.

What you can do with it:
  - Log time on a calendar, list, or timer, whichever fits the moment
  - Track tasks and projects with groupable dashboards by week, month, or year
  - Manage expenses alongside hours in one place
  - Sign in with Google or Microsoft SSO; provision teams via SCIM/JIT
  - Export clean timesheets and reports for clients or payroll
  
Good for solo consultants tracking billable hours, agencies invoicing clients, and teams that need a tidy record of where the week went.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0100e531548191b53db8ed.longDescriptionZh:
Temponia 是一款时间跟踪和时间表应用程序，适合自由职业者、代理机构和内部团队，他们希望记录自己的工作时间，但又不想让自己感觉是一件苦差事。

Temponia 为您提供了日历视图，而不是一长串的空字段：通过拖动来记录时间，就像您安排会议一样。连接 Google 日历或 Outlook，只需点击一下即可将现有事件转变为可计费条目。当您离开办公桌时，本机 iOS 和 Android 应用程序可让您了解一周的最新情况。

你可以用它做什么：
  - 在日历、列表或计时器上记录时间（以适合的时刻为准）
  - 使用可分组的仪表板按周、月或年跟踪任务和项目
  - 在一个地方管理费用和时间
  - 使用 Google 或 Microsoft SSO 登录；通过 SCIM/JIT 提供团队
  - 为客户或工资单导出干净的时间表和报告
  
非常适合跟踪计费时间的独立顾问、为客户开具发票的代理机构以及需要整洁记录一周工作情况的团队。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5c830b0fe48191a605e979.description: 保存一次，在任何 AI 中调用
plugin_asdk_app_6a5c830b0fe48191a605e979.originalDescription: Save once, recall in any AI
plugin_asdk_app_6a5c830b0fe48191a605e979.productIntro: Contextick 是人工智能的个人知识层。保存任何文本一次 — 一个决定、一个想法、一个代码片段、研究笔记——以及您连接的人工智能 稍后可以在相关的时候通过意义将其带回来。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5c830b0fe48191a605e979.productIntroEn: Contextick is a personal knowledge layer for your AI. Save any text once — a decision, an idea, a code snippet, research notes — and the AIs you connect can bring it back later by meaning, right when it's relevant.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5c830b0fe48191a605e979.longDescription:
Contextick is a personal knowledge layer for your AI. Save any text once —
a decision, an idea, a code snippet, research notes — and the AIs you connect
can bring it back later by meaning, right when it's relevant.

Because your knowledge lives in one private store instead of inside a single
assistant, it follows you across the tools you already use — ChatGPT, Claude,
and other MCP-compatible apps. Save something in one, recall it in another.

There's nothing to organize: no folders, no tags. You just save, and a short
bit of context surfaces the closest match when you ask. Use it to keep working
decisions, team conventions, preferences, and anything you'd rather not explain
to your AI twice.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5c830b0fe48191a605e979.longDescriptionZh:
Contextick 是人工智能的个人知识层。保存任何文本一次 —
一个决定、一个想法、一个代码片段、研究笔记——以及您连接的人工智能

plugin_asdk_app_6a2c9f4e240c8191b5ae7c28.productIntroEn: GoLinks helps teams find, access, and share workplace knowledge faster by turning long URLs into secure, human-readable go links.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2c9f4e240c8191b5ae7c28.longDescription:
GoLinks helps teams find, access, and share workplace knowledge faster by turning long URLs into secure, human-readable go links.

With the GoLinks app for ChatGPT, employees can search their company’s GoLinks library, find important resources, and get details about go links without leaving ChatGPT. Ask ChatGPT to look up a go link, search by keyword, summarize what a link is for, review ownership and usage details, or create a new go link for quick access to a resource.

GoLinks makes it easier for teams to navigate the apps, documents, dashboards, and information they use every day. Instead of remembering long URLs or searching through multiple tools, employees can simply ask ChatGPT for the go link they need.

Go links created by your organization are only accessible based on your workspace permissions, helping keep company resources secure while making knowledge easier to discover.

Use GoLinks in ChatGPT to reduce context switching, improve productivity, and give your team a faster way to access trusted workplace resources.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2c9f4e240c8191b5ae7c28.longDescriptionZh:
GoLinks 将长 URL 转换为安全、人类可读的 Go 链接，帮助团队更快地查找、访问和共享工作场所知识。

借助适用于 ChatGPT 的 GoLinks 应用程序，员工无需离开 ChatGPT 即可搜索公司的 GoLinks 库、查找重要资源并获取有关 Go 链接的详细信息。要求 ChatGPT 查找 go 链接、按关键字搜索、总结链接的用途、查看所有权和使用详细信息，或者创建新的 go 链接以快速访问资源。

GoLinks 使团队可以更轻松地导航他们每天使用的应用程序、文档、仪表板和信息。员工无需记住长 URL 或搜索多种工具，只需向 ChatGPT 询问他们所需的链接即可。

您的组织创建的 Go 链接只能根据您的工作区权限进行访问，这有助于确保公司资源的安全，同时使知识更容易发现。

使用 ChatGPT 中的 GoLinks 可以减少上下文切换、提高工作效率，并让您的团队更快地访问受信任的工作场所资源。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9188de900081918f7b17f4.productIntro: 撰写清晰、引人入胜的描述，突出显示您的插件的功能以及人们为什么会喜欢它。关注具体的用户价值，避免夸大、误导性的主张。这将公开显示在您的插件的目录页面上。 将 ChatGPT 直接连接到您的文档，因此起草和修改文档与您的其余工作在同一位置进行：无需在聊天窗口和浏览器选项卡之间来回复制文本。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9188de900081918f7b17f4.productIntroEn: Write a clear, engaging description that highlights what your plugin does and why people will love it. Focus on concrete user value and avoid exaggerative, misleading claims. This will appear publicly on your plugin’s directory page.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9188de900081918f7b17f4.longDescription:
Write a clear, engaging description that highlights what your plugin does and why people will love it. Focus on concrete user value and avoid exaggerative, misleading claims. This will appear publicly on your plugin’s directory page.
Connect ChatGPT directly to your Docs, so drafting and revising documents happens in the same place as the rest of your work: no copying text back and forth between a chat window and a browser tab.

Ask for a document by name and it searches your Drive to find it, then reads the contents back as clean markdown you can quote, summarize, translate or rework. Ask for something new and it creates the document and writes the first draft. From there you get real editing, not just appending: insert and replace text anywhere in the document, replace every occurrence of a phrase in one pass, restyle paragraphs and individual runs of text, and turn lists into proper bullets or strip them back out.

Tables are fully supported: create them, add or remove rows and columns, merge cells, style rows and cells, and pin header rows so they repeat across pages. So is the document furniture most tools skip: headers, footers, footnotes, page and section breaks, page layout settings, inline images, dates and people chips.

Every edit starts by inspecting the document's actual structure, so changes land in the right place instead of clobbering the surrounding text, and related changes are applied together as a single batch rather than one risky rewrite. Word files in your Drive work too: .docx is converted so it can be read and
edited like anything else.

It fits naturally into recurring document work: updating status reports, filling out templates, cleaning up formatting across a long file, and reworking a draft someone else started.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9188de900081918f7b17f4.longDescriptionZh:
撰写清晰、引人入胜的描述，突出显示您的插件的功能以及人们为什么会喜欢它。关注具体的用户价值，避免夸大、误导性的主张。这将公开显示在您的插件的目录页面上。
将 ChatGPT 直接连接到您的文档，因此起草和修改文档与您的其余工作在同一位置进行：无需在聊天窗口和浏览器选项卡之间来回复制文本。

按名称请求文档，它会搜索您的云端硬盘来找到它，然后以干净的 Markdown 形式读回内容，您可以引用、总结、翻译或修改。要求一些新的东西，它就会创建文档并写出初稿。从那里您可以进行真正的编辑，而不仅仅是附加：在文档中的任何位置插入和替换文本，一次性替换短语的每个出现位置，重新设计段落和单独的文本运行，以及将列表转换为正确的项目符号或将其删除。

完全支持表格：创建表格、添加或删除行和列、合并单元格、设置行和单元格样式以及固定标题行，以便它们在页面上重复。大多数工具都会跳过的文档家具也是如此：页眉、页脚、脚注、分页符和分节符、页面布局设置、内联图像、日期和人员芯片。

每次编辑都从检查文档的实际结构开始，因此在正确的位置进行更改，而不是破坏周围的文本，并且相关的更改作为单个批次一起应用，而不是一次危险的重写。云端硬盘中的 Word 文件也可以使用：.docx 已转换，以便可以读取和使用
像其他任何东西一样编辑。

它自然地适合重复的文档工作：更新状态报告、填写模板、清理长文件的格式以及重新编写其他人开始的草稿。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5f8d6c47708191b8a7e459.longDescription:
Turn recordings, lectures, documents, and voice notes into structured, customizable notes. Choose a format—from meeting and sales-call notes to study guides, project updates, interview summaries, and more—then review the transcript and prompt before generating notes you can save, copy, or share.

- Upload MP3, MP4, WEBM, M4A, PDF, or TXT files, or record a voice note directly.
- Select from tailored templates for meetings, lectures, sales calls, research, strategy, support, and more.
- Customize your note generation prompt before creating notes.
- Auto-Save generated notes and transcripts to your private file library
- 1-click share your notes to a dedicated public link

- 上传 MP3、MP4、WEBM、M4A、PDF 或 TXT 文件，或直接录制语音笔记。
- 从会议、讲座、销售电话、研究、策略、支持等定制模板中进行选择。
- 在创建笔记之前自定义笔记生成提示。

plugin_asdk_app_6a78ba71aebc8191b32c1120.longDescription:

Connect your Traspion account to find recent files, read completed transcripts and translations, upload media for transcription, rename files, export content, and save approved transcript edits—all through natural conversation.

plugin_asdk_app_6a818ab42f908191a5576692.name: Fraghab
plugin_asdk_app_6a818ab42f908191a5576692.productIntro: Fraghab 是一位香水系列经理。它会追踪您拥有的瓶子和醒酒器、每个瓶子和醒酒器中还剩下多少、您穿着什么、何时穿着以及您正在储蓄什么。
plugin_asdk_app_6a818ab42f908191a5576692.productIntroEn: Fraghab is a fragrance collection manager. It tracks the bottles and decants you own, how much is left in each, what you wore and when, and what you are saving up for.
plugin_asdk_app_6a818ab42f908191a5576692.longDescription:
Fraghab is a fragrance collection manager. It tracks the bottles and decants you own, how much is left in each, what you wore and when, and what you are saving up for.

Connect it and you can work with your own shelf in plain language. Ask what you have not worn since spring and it reads your collection. Say you wore the Santal 33 decant today, four sprays, and it logs the wearing and deducts the millilitres. Add a bottle you just bought in a sentence instead of a form, correct a rating or a note on one you already have, group bottles onto shelves, and save the layering combos you actually wear.

It also prices your wishlist. Ask for the best price on something you are saving for and Fraghab searches fragrance retailers for the cheapest current offer, tells you which shop has it, and gives the entry a product photo.

You authorize the connection on a Fraghab screen and approve each permission. Nothing can be deleted through it. Editing replaces what was there, so ChatGPT asks before it changes something you already had. Changing your Fraghab password revokes access immediately. Fraghab is free and takes no payment of any kind.
plugin_asdk_app_6a818ab42f908191a5576692.longDescriptionZh:
Fraghab 是一位香水系列经理。它会追踪您拥有的瓶子和醒酒器、每个瓶子和醒酒器中还剩下多少、您穿着什么、何时穿着以及您正在储蓄什么。

连接它，您就可以用简单的语言使用您自己的架子。问你自春天以来没有穿过什么，它会显示你的收藏。假设您今天使用了 Santal 33 醒酒器，喷了四次喷雾，它会记录磨损情况并扣除毫升数。在句子中而不是表格中添加您刚刚购买的瓶子，更正您已有瓶子的评级或注释，将瓶子分组到架子上，并保存您实际佩戴的分层组合。

它还为您的愿望清单定价。当你询问你想省钱的东西的最优惠价格时，Fraghab 会搜索香水零售商当前最便宜的报价，告诉你哪家商店有这种产品，并为条目提供一张产品照片。

您在 Fraghab 屏幕上授权连接并批准每个权限。通过它无法删除任何内容。编辑会替换现有内容，因此 ChatGPT 在更改您已有的内容之前会进行询问。更改 Fraghab 密码会立即撤销访问权限。 Fraghab 是免费的，不收取任何形式的费用。

CloudMindMaps turns anything you're discussing in ChatGPT into a clear, interactive mind map. Ask it to map meeting notes, a report, a reading list, a project plan, or just a topic — CloudMindMaps structures the ideas and returns a live map with an inline preview, right in the chat.

Every map opens at cloudmindmaps.app as a free, browser-based, editable and shareable diagram, and uses the open FreeMind/Freeplane .mm format, so it also opens in those desktop apps.

What you can do:
• "Turn these notes into a mind map"
• "Make a mind map of the pros and cons of X"
• "List my mind maps and open the roadmap one"

Sign in once with your CloudMindMaps account; maps you create are saved there.

plugin_asdk_app_6a659686fea081918d13823f.description: 在 AI 聊天之间携带上下文
plugin_asdk_app_6a659686fea081918d13823f.productIntro: Jotter 会保存一次 AI 对话中重要的内容，因此您无需在下一次对话中重新解释自己。说“记下这个”，Jotter 就会私下保存一条笔记，或者整个对话的交接摘要。在稍后的新聊天中，或在另一个人工智能助手中，说“加载我的最新笔记”，然后从上次停下的地方继续，保持你的决定、偏好和后续步骤不变。您还可以直接在聊天中按关键字搜索您的笔记、列出它们或删除它们。除非您提出要求，否则不会保存任何内容，也不会自动删除任何内容，并且您的笔记对您来说是私人的。

plugin_asdk_app_6a0cd408b54081919ff287c7.longDescription:
GoSearch connects your AI assistant to your organization's knowledge base. Ask a question and get answers pulled from the apps your team already uses, like Google Drive, Slack, Jira, Notion, and 100+ more, all in one place.

  Use it two ways:
  - Search across your connected apps to find the document, message, or ticket you need, with links back to the source.
  - Ask GoAI a question and get a written answer grounded in your organization's content, with citations so you can verify where it came from.

  GoSearch respects your existing permissions, so you only see results from content you already have access to.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0cd408b54081919ff287c7.longDescriptionZh:
GoSearch 将您的 AI 助手连接到您组织的知识库。提出问题并从您的团队已使用的应用程序（例如 Google Drive、Slack、Jira、Notion 等 100 多个应用程序）中获取答案，所有这些都集中在一个地方。

  有两种使用方式：
  - 在连接的应用程序中搜索以查找所需的文档、消息或票证，并提供返回源的链接。
  - 向 GoAI 提出问题，并获得基于您组织内容的书面答案，并附有引用，以便您可以验证其来源。

  GoSearch 尊重您现有的权限，因此您只能看到您已有权访问的内容的结果。

plugin_asdk_app_6a403a26e8ac8191b2f29f79.productIntro: VaDa Genius 使用您的真实能源数据帮助您了解家中的能源。
plugin_asdk_app_6a403a26e8ac8191b2f29f79.productIntroEn: VaDa Genius helps you understand the energy in your home using your real energy data.
plugin_asdk_app_6a403a26e8ac8191b2f29f79.longDescription:
VaDa Genius helps you understand the energy in your home using your real energy data.

Ask about your electricity consumption, solar panels, batteries, electricity tariffs, EV charging and opportunities to use energy better. Discover when you consume the most, how much of your consumption happens during solar hours, whether solar panels or a battery could make sense, or whether your existing solar installation is performing as expected.

Genius can work with connected energy sources such as VaDa SmartHouse, supported solar platforms and consumption data, depending on your setup. If VaDa Smart is available, Genius can also explain what is happening in your home in real time and what VaDa is doing.

VaDa Genius is read-only. It can explain, compare, recommend and visualize energy information, but it does not operate electrical equipment, change contracts or replace a certified installer, electrical study, legal advice or guaranteed savings calculation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a403a26e8ac8191b2f29f79.longDescriptionZh:
VaDa Genius 使用您的真实能源数据帮助您了解家中的能源。

询问您的用电量、太阳能电池板、电池、电价、电动汽车充电以及更好地利用能源的机会。了解您何时消耗最多，有多少消耗发生在太阳能时段，太阳能电池板或电池是否有意义，或者您现有的太阳能装置是否按预期运行。

Genius 可以使用连接的能源，例如 VaDa SmartHouse、支持的太阳能平台和消耗数据，具体取决于您的设置。如果 VaDa Smart 可用，Genius 还可以实时解释您家中发生的情况以及 VaDa 正在做什么。

VaDa Genius 是只读的。它可以解释、比较、推荐和可视化能源信息，但它不会操作电气设备、更改合同或更换经过认证的安装人员、电气研究、法律建议或保证节省计算。
defaultPrompts: ¿Cuánto de mi consumo ocurre cuando hay sol?
¿Me compensaría instalar placas solares?
¿Puedo bajar mi potencia contratada?
defaultPromptsZh: （翻译待补）¿Cuánto de mi consumo ocurre cuando hay sol?
我可以补偿安装太阳能吗？

plugin_asdk_app_6a7ad0afe3ec819188809d77.name: StarryKit
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ad0afe3ec819188809d77.productIntro: 将人工智能驱动的视觉设计工作流程引入 ChatGPT 和 Codex。通过自然对话创建、完善、审查和导出精美的可编辑设计。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ad0afe3ec819188809d77.productIntroEn: Bring an AI-powered visual design workflow into ChatGPT and Codex. Create, refine, review, and export polished, editable designs through natural conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ad0afe3ec819188809d77.longDescription:
Bring an AI-powered visual design workflow into ChatGPT and Codex. Create, refine, review, and export polished, editable designs through natural conversation.

What you can create: AI presentations and pitch decks, posters and flyers, social media graphics, infographics, diagrams, cards, email designs, web concepts, UI mockups, and visual documents.

Create presentations: Turn a topic, outline, brief, or existing content into a polished, editable presentation. Create posters: Design event posters, promotional graphics, flyers, and visual art in any supported format. Create social media content: Produce editable designs for Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and other channels. Create infographics and diagrams: Transform complex ideas, processes, and data into clear visual stories.

Recreate designs: Provide an image, screenshot, website, document, or design.md file as a visual reference. StarryKit analyzes its composition, typography, colors, hierarchy, and visual language, then recreates the direction with editable elements—without requiring a template.

Edit and refine: Rewrite complete pages or request focused changes to text, layout, colors, imagery, hierarchy, and formatting while preserving the rest of the design. Review generated page drafts in StarryKit before accepting them into your document.

Export designs: Download your finished work as PowerPoint, PDF, SVG, PNG, JPEG, or HTML, or export an editable presentation to Google Slides.

Once installed, describe what you want in plain language or invoke StarryKit directly with @StarryKit.

Try prompts like:
- @StarryKit, create a 10-slide investor pitch deck for a sustainable urban farming startup.
- @StarryKit, design a bold poster for an electronic music festival in Tokyo.
- @StarryKit, turn this report into a clear, visual infographic.
- @StarryKit, recreate this website screenshot as an editable visual design.
- @StarryKit, make the headline larger, highlight the key metric, and preserve everything else.
- @StarryKit, export this presentation to PowerPoint and Google Slides.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ad0afe3ec819188809d77.longDescriptionZh:
将人工智能驱动的视觉设计工作流程引入 ChatGPT 和 Codex。通过自然对话创建、完善、审查和导出精美的可编辑设计。

您可以创建什么：人工智能演示文稿和宣传材料、海报和传单、社交媒体图形、信息图表、图表、卡片、电子邮件设计、网页概念、UI 模型和视觉文档。

创建演示文稿：将主题、大纲、简介或现有内容转变为精美的、可编辑的演示文稿。创建海报：以任何支持的格式设计活动海报、宣传图形、传单和视觉艺术。创建社交媒体内容：为 Instagram、LinkedIn、Facebook 和其他渠道制作可编辑的设计。创建信息图表和图表：将复杂的想法、流程和数据转化为清晰的视觉故事。

重新创建设计：提供图像、屏幕截图、网站、文档或 design.md 文件作为视觉参考。 StarryKit 分析其构成、版式、颜色、层次结构和视觉语言，然后使用可编辑元素重新创建方向，而无需模板。

编辑和优化：重写完整页面或请求对文本、布局、颜色、图像、层次结构和格式进行重点更改，同时保留设计的其余部分。在将生成的页面草稿接受到文档中之前，先查看 StarryKit 中生成的页面草稿。

导出设计：将完成的作品下载为 PowerPoint、PDF、SVG、PNG、JPEG 或 HTML 格式，或将可编辑的演示文稿导出到 Google 幻灯片。

安装后，用简单的语言描述您想要的内容或直接使用 @StarryKit 调用 StarryKit。

尝试如下提示：
- @StarryKit，为可持续城市农业初创公司创建一个包含 10 张幻灯片的投资者推介材料。
- @StarryKit，为东京电子音乐节设计一张大胆的海报。
- @StarryKit，将此报告变成清晰、直观的信息图。
- @StarryKit，重新创建此网站屏幕截图作为可编辑的视觉设计。
- @StarryKit，使标题更大，突出显示关键指标，并保留其他所有内容。
- @StarryKit，将此演示文稿导出到 PowerPoint 和 Google 幻灯片。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3919bc5fb08191b7602962.name: HOUSE ’N’ STARS
plugin_asdk_app_6a3919bc5fb08191b7602962.productIntro: HOUSE 'N' STARS 是 ChatGPT 的只读 AI 原生豪华房地产数据集连接器。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3919bc5fb08191b7602962.productIntroEn: HOUSE ’N’ STARS is a read-only AI-native luxury real estate dataset connector for ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3919bc5fb08191b7602962.longDescription:
HOUSE ’N’ STARS is a read-only AI-native luxury real estate dataset connector for ChatGPT.

It allows users to search and retrieve real public luxury property listings from the HOUSE ’N’ STARS structured dataset, including Monaco, the French Riviera, Dubai, Abu Dhabi and selected international luxury destinations.

The app helps ChatGPT access public property data such as title, location, property type, Sale/Rent status, price display, bedrooms, bathrooms, surface, features and public listing URL.

Listings are supplied by professional real estate agencies admitted to the HOUSE ’N’ STARS platform. The platform applies a curation and quality-control layer to support reliable discovery, structured presentation and a consistent user experience.

The connector is strictly read-only and public-data-only. It does not create, edit, delete, reserve, buy, sell or publish properties. It does not request or process sensitive personal data, payment details, identity documents, financial documents or precise user location. It also does not provide legal, financial, valuation or investment advice.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3919bc5fb08191b7602962.longDescriptionZh:
HOUSE 'N' STARS 是 ChatGPT 的只读 AI 原生豪华房地产数据集连接器。

它允许用户从 HOUSE 'N' STARS 结构化数据集中搜索和检索真实的公共豪华房产列表，包括摩纳哥、法国里维埃拉、迪拜、阿布扎比和选定的国际豪华目的地。

该应用程序帮助 ChatGPT 访问公共财产数据，例如标题、位置、财产类型、销售/租赁状态、价格显示、卧室、浴室、表面、功能和公开列表 URL。

房源由 HOUSE 'N' STARS 平台认可的专业房地产机构提供。该平台应用管理和质量控制层来支持可靠的发现、结构化的呈现和一致的用户体验。

该连接器是严格只读的且仅限公共数据。它不会创建、编辑、删除、保留、购买、出售或发布财产。它不会请求或处理敏感的个人数据、付款详细信息、身份文件、财务文件或精确的用户位置。它也不提供法律、财务、估值或投资建议。

plugin_asdk_app_6a80cc8edfb48191b895cbae.productIntroEn: O CoachPilot é o sistema de gestão de personal trainers — alunos, prescrição de treino, avaliações físicas, histórico de sessões, agenda e financeiro. Conectando sua conta, você consulta e ajusta a sua carteira sem sair da conversa: "quem não treina há mais de 10 dias?", "como está a evolução de agachamento da Marina?", "monta o treino B dela para esta semana respeitando a anamnese".
plugin_asdk_app_6a80cc8edfb48191b895cbae.longDescription:
O CoachPilot é o sistema de gestão de personal trainers — alunos, prescrição de treino, avaliações físicas, histórico de sessões, agenda e financeiro. Conectando sua conta, você consulta e ajusta a sua carteira sem sair da conversa: "quem não treina há mais de 10 dias?", "como está a evolução de agachamento da Marina?", "monta o treino B dela para esta semana respeitando a anamnese".

Você autoriza com a sua própria conta CoachPilot e escolhe conceder apenas leitura ou também escrita de treinos. A conexão alcança somente os seus alunos. Toda alteração de treino é registrada, notificada a você e pode ser desfeita por 7 dias. Quem prescreve continua sendo você — o assistente analisa, propõe e, quando você pede, aplica.
plugin_asdk_app_6a80cc8edfb48191b895cbae.longDescriptionZh:
CoachPilot 是私人教练的管理系统 — 营养、训练处方、健身记录、课程历史、议程和财务。 Conectando sua conta，você coacha a justa a sua carteira sem sair da conversa：“quem não treina há mais de 10 dias？”，“como está a evolução de agachamento da Marina？”，“monta o treino B dela para esta semana respeitando aamnese”。

您有权使用 CoachPilot 的权限，并学习如何轻松地学习或使用其他内容。 A conexão alcança somente os seus alunos.要更改注册和注册，请在 7 天内发出通知。如果需要连续发送声音 — 或辅助分析、支持、全部声音、应用。

plugin_asdk_app_6a315470ce608191b84918b5.name: Upfluence
plugin_asdk_app_6a315470ce608191b84918b5.productIntro: 发现合适的创作者并开展您的活动，而无需浏览多个平台。只需用简单的语言描述您要查找的内容，ChatGPT 就会返回由 Upfluence 搜索引擎提供支持的结果。
plugin_asdk_app_6a315470ce608191b84918b5.productIntroEn: Discover the right creators and run your campaigns without navigating multiple platforms. Simply describe what you're looking for in plain language, and ChatGPT will return results powered by Upfluence's search engine.
plugin_asdk_app_6a315470ce608191b84918b5.longDescription:
Discover the right creators and run your campaigns without navigating multiple platforms. Simply describe what you're looking for in plain language, and ChatGPT will return results powered by Upfluence's search engine.

For example:
"Give me english-speaking TikTok creators interested in sustainable fashion with 50K–200K followers."
"What does the audience demographic look like for this creator?"

Based on your request, you'll receive a curated list of creator profiles that match your criteria. Review key details, explore their profiles, and check recent posts to evaluate whether they're a strong fit for your next campaign. From there, you can organize creators into campaigns and track your outreach, all without leaving the conversation.

Upfluence inside ChatGPT makes creator discovery and campaign management faster, more intuitive, and easier to act on.
plugin_asdk_app_6a315470ce608191b84918b5.longDescriptionZh:
发现合适的创作者并开展您的活动，而无需浏览多个平台。只需用简单的语言描述您要查找的内容，ChatGPT 就会返回由 Upfluence 搜索引擎提供支持的结果。

例如：
“给我提供对可持续时尚感兴趣、拥有 5 万至 20 万粉丝的英语 TikTok 创作者。”
“这位创作者的受众群体是什么样的？”

根据您的请求，您将收到一份符合您条件的创作者个人资料精选列表。查看关键详细信息，探索他们的个人资料，并检查最近的帖子，以评估他们是否非常适合您的下一个广告系列。从那里，您可以将创作者组织到活动中并跟踪您的推广活动，所有这些都无需离开对话。

ChatGPT 内部的 Upfluence 使创作者发现和活动管理更快、更直观、更容易采取行动。

plugin_asdk_app_6a836e56e4dc8191bbc1b86d.name: stierproducts
plugin_asdk_app_6a836e56e4dc8191bbc1b86d.description: 产品等级列表，全部引用
plugin_asdk_app_6a836e56e4dc8191bbc1b86d.productIntro: 208 个产品类别的 S 到 F 等级列表是通过整合专家评论和所有者报告的独立研究而构建的。每个位置都被引用，每个引用都带有出处、逐字引用、谁说的以及我们是否获取了链接并确认了它。董事会的评级有两种方式：研究表明要避免的产品会发布在底层而不是被删除，因此您会得到购买指南遗漏的一半。产品带有 GTIN 条形码，并且在制造商发布条形码的地方还带有发布日期。没有附属链接，也没有赞助展示位置：没有品牌可以付费进入董事会。
plugin_asdk_app_6a836e56e4dc8191bbc1b86d.productIntroEn: S-to-F tier lists for 208 product categories, built by consolidating independent research runs over expert reviews and owner reports. Every placement is cited, and every citation carries the outlet, a verbatim quote, who said it, and whether we fetched the link and confirmed it.
plugin_asdk_app_6a836e56e4dc8191bbc1b86d.longDescription: S-to-F tier lists for 208 product categories, built by consolidating independent research runs over expert reviews and owner reports. Every placement is cited, and every citation carries the outlet, a verbatim quote, who said it, and whether we fetched the link and confirmed it. Boards are graded both ways: the products the research says to avoid are published in the bottom tiers rather than dropped, so you get the half a buying guide leaves out. Products carry GTIN barcodes and, where the maker published one, an announcement date. No affiliate links and no sponsored placements: no brand can pay to move on a board.

plugin_asdk_app_6a3c0c69e2dc81918636e251.name: Native Soil
plugin_asdk_app_6a3c0c69e2dc81918636e251.originalDescription: Save and load AI chat state
plugin_asdk_app_6a3c0c69e2dc81918636e251.productIntro: Native Soil 保存 AI 聊天的工作状态（决策、上下文和计划），并允许您将其加载到任何其他模型、客户端或提供商中。切换工具，达到上下文限制，或者明天再回来，从上次停下的地方继续，而不是重新解释所有内容。每次保存的内容在存储之前都会经过检查和评分，秘密和私人数据将被剥离，并且聊天中的任何内容都不会被更改或删除。在共享项目中，负载是通过召回检查来测量的，因此您可以看到实际结转的内容以及需要审查的内容。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3c0c69e2dc81918636e251.productIntroEn: Native Soil saves the working state of your AI chat (the decisions, the context, and the plan) and lets you load it in any other model, client, or provider. Switch tools, hit a context limit, or come back tomorrow, and pick up where you left off instead of re-explaining everything.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3c0c69e2dc81918636e251.longDescription: Native Soil saves the working state of your AI chat (the decisions, the context, and the plan) and lets you load it in any other model, client, or provider. Switch tools, hit a context limit, or come back tomorrow, and pick up where you left off instead of re-explaining everything. Every save is checked and graded before it is stored, secrets and private data are stripped, and nothing in your chat is changed or deleted. On shared projects, loads are measured with a recall check, so you can see what actually carried over and what needs review. Type "soil save" to capture the state, then "soil load" to restore it anywhere.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3c0c69e2dc81918636e251.longDescriptionZh: Native Soil 保存 AI 聊天的工作状态（决策、上下文和计划），并允许您将其加载到任何其他模型、客户端或提供商中。切换工具，达到上下文限制，或者明天再回来，从上次停下的地方继续，而不是重新解释所有内容。每次保存的内容在存储之前都会经过检查和评分，秘密和私人数据将被剥离，并且聊天中的任何内容都不会被更改或删除。在共享项目中，负载是通过召回检查来测量的，因此您可以看到实际结转的内容以及需要审查的内容。输入“soil save”以捕获状态，然后输入“soil load”以在任何地方恢复它。

plugin_asdk_app_6a03afdf3120819195026f6a.productIntro: Weft 是一个 Scrumban 任务管理器：一个用于流程的看板，用于焦点的冲刺，没有站立或仪式。它是为独立创始人、独立制作人和没有项目经理的小型初创团队而构建的。
plugin_asdk_app_6a03afdf3120819195026f6a.productIntroEn: Weft is a Scrumban task manager: a kanban board for flow, sprints for focus, no standups or ceremonies. It's built for solo founders, indie makers, and small startup teams who ship without a project manager.
plugin_asdk_app_6a03afdf3120819195026f6a.longDescription:
Weft is a Scrumban task manager: a kanban board for flow, sprints for focus, no standups or ceremonies. It's built for solo founders, indie makers, and small startup teams who ship without a project manager.

 Once your Weft account is connected, you can manage your board in a conversation:
• Ask "what's on my board?" to get a summary of your columns and active sprint
• Search tasks by keyword across the whole board
• Add new tasks to the backlog and update their details
• Move work across Backlog, Todo, Doing, and Done
• Plan a sprint, start it, and mark it complete — without leaving the chat

Your board stays in sync with Weft on web, desktop, and mobile.
plugin_asdk_app_6a03afdf3120819195026f6a.longDescriptionZh:
Weft 是一个 Scrumban 任务管理器：一个用于流程的看板，用于焦点的冲刺，没有站立或仪式。它是为独立创始人、独立制作人和没有项目经理的小型初创团队而构建的。

 连接您的 Weft 帐户后，您可以在对话中管理您的董事会：
• 问“我的板上有什么？”获取您的专栏和活跃冲刺的摘要
• 通过关键字全盘搜索任务
• 将新任务添加到待办事项并更新其详细信息
• 在待办事项、待办事项、正在执行和已完成之间移动工作
• 计划冲刺、开始冲刺并将其标记为完成 — 无需离开聊天室

您的主板在网络、桌面和移动设备上与 Weft 保持同步。

Convert units instantly with AnyConversion, the simple and powerful conversion app for everyday use, travel, education, engineering, and professional work.

Easily convert between hundreds of units across multiple categories, including length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed, pressure, energy, data storage, and more. Whether you need to convert pounds to kilograms, miles to kilometers, Celsius to Fahrenheit, or gigabytes to megabytes, Unit Converter delivers accurate results in real time.

Features

• Convert units across 9 categories
• Length, weight, temperature, volume, area, speed, time, and more
• Engineering and scientific unit conversions
• Metric and imperial unit support
• Instant calculations as you type
• Clean, easy-to-use interface
• Fast and accurate conversion results
• Works offline – no internet required
• Save time with favorite conversions
• Lightweight and optimized for all devices

Perfect for students, travelers, engineers, builders, scientists, professionals, and anyone who needs quick and reliable unit conversions on the go.

Download AnyConversion today and get all your conversion tools in one convenient app.

特点

• 工程和科学单位转换

非常适合学生、旅行者、工程师、建筑商、科学家、专业人士以及任何需要在旅途中快速可靠的单位转换的人。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3c5ffc48548191a2731305.productIntro: RaidRunner 帮助 Twitch 主播运行并加入 Raid 列车——背靠背的直播转播活动。从 ChatGPT 中，您可以查看您参加或组织的活动、即将领取的时段以及完整的活动阵容；发现要参加的公共活动；申领、释放或列入候补名单并管理老虎机交易请求。一切都仅限于您自己连接的 RaidRunner 帐户。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3c5ffc48548191a2731305.productIntroEn: RaidRunner helps Twitch streamers run and join raid trains — back-to-back stream relay events. From ChatGPT you can see the events you perform in or organize, your upcoming claimed slots, and full event lineups; discover public events to join; and claim, release, or waitlist slots and manage slot-trade requests. Everything is scoped to your own connected RaidRunner account.

Everything is scoped to your own connected RaidRunner account.

plugin_asdk_app_69fcbb4ebdfc8191b623b088.name: SocialHub
plugin_asdk_app_69fcbb4ebdfc8191b623b088.productIntro: 将您的想法转化为社交媒体帖子和有组织的项目板。
plugin_asdk_app_69fcbb4ebdfc8191b623b088.productIntroEn: Transform your ideas into social media posts and organised project boards.
plugin_asdk_app_69fcbb4ebdfc8191b623b088.longDescription:
Transform your ideas into social media posts and organised project boards.

With this app you can turn the ideas and media you generated through ChatGPT into social media drafts or even scheduled posts in the SocialHub Content Planner. Additionally, you can get channel suggestions for the content based on your connected platforms in SocialHub.

If you use the Idea Board, you can also use this app to draft cards or build complete boards with structured columns and cards based on your current discussion/prompt.
plugin_asdk_app_69fcbb4ebdfc8191b623b088.longDescriptionZh:
将您的想法转化为社交媒体帖子和有组织的项目板。

如果您使用创意板，您还可以使用此应用程序根据当前的讨论/提示起草卡片或构建带有结构化列和卡片的完整板。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4fd2c344b481919340e841.description: 与罗伊的礼宾代理交谈
plugin_asdk_app_6a4fd2c344b481919340e841.productIntro: Consult with Roy 是 ROY 的 Apps SDK 应用程序 — 技术咨询。它解释了 Roy 的产品组合和产品，在内嵌 ChatGPT 卡中展示案例研究，捕捉您的目标，用 Roy 精心策划的礼宾指导进行回答，并将财务、法律、定价、合同和低信任度问题上报给 Roy 个人。技能涵盖吸收、发现、展示、咨询答案、会议提案、回忆和人工交接。身份通过电子邮件进行验证，参与记录保留在 Roy 的工作空间中。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4fd2c344b481919340e841.productIntroEn: Consult with Roy is the Apps SDK app for ROY — Technology Consultation. It explains Roy's portfolio and offerings, shows case studies in inline ChatGPT cards, captures your goal, answers with Roy's curated concierge guidance, and escalates finance, legal, pricing, contracts, and low-confidence matters to Roy personally.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4fd2c344b481919340e841.longDescription: Consult with Roy is the Apps SDK app for ROY — Technology Consultation. Skills cover intake, discovery, showcase, advisory answers, meeting proposals, recall, and human handoff. Identity is verified by email and engagement records stay in Roy's workspace.

plugin_asdk_app_6a7da66a64d081919863d575.name: Memco Shared Memory
plugin_asdk_app_6a7da66a64d081919863d575.productIntro: （人类和代理组成的）团队共享知识，以便所有人都能获得一个人学到的经验教训。代理很聪明，但他们不知道您的内部实践、IP 和遗留代码。共享内存填补了这些空白，并且比 RAG 更有效。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7da66a64d081919863d575.productIntroEn: Teams (of humans and agents) share knowledge so that lessons learned by one are available to all. Agents are smart but they don't know your internal practices, IP, and legacy code. Shared memory fills-in those gaps, and is orders of magnitude more effective than RAG.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7da66a64d081919863d575.longDescription:
Teams (of humans and agents) share knowledge so that lessons learned by one are available to all. Agents are smart but they don't know your internal practices, IP, and legacy code. Shared memory fills-in those gaps, and is orders of magnitude more effective than RAG.

Each team's workspace is private and protected by role-based access controls. 

Create your account for free at https://memco.ai.

Available as an MCP, cross-compatible  with agents from all vendors.

Your memory space is private to your team, protected by enterprise-grade information security, and governed by policies.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7da66a64d081919863d575.longDescriptionZh:
（人类和代理组成的）团队共享知识，以便所有人都能获得一个人学到的经验教训。代理很聪明，但他们不知道您的内部实践、IP 和遗留代码。共享内存填补了这些空白，并且比 RAG 更有效。

每个团队的工作空间都是私有的，并受到基于角色的访问控制的保护。 

在 https://memco.ai 免费创建您的帐户。

作为 MCP 提供，与所有供应商的代理交叉兼容。

您的内存空间是您的团队私有的，受企业级信息安全保护，并受策略管理。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3e81be8f8481918e1e2cd1.name: OWOX Data Marts
plugin_asdk_app_6a3e81be8f8481918e1e2cd1.productIntro: OWOX 数据集市将 ChatGPT/Codex 连接到您公司的受管分析层。数据分析师在您自己的仓库（BigQuery、Snowflake、Databricks、Redshift、Athena）之上定义可信数据集市（指标、维度和联接逻辑）。从 ChatGPT/Codex，您可以通过自然语言搜索发现正确的数据集市、检查其字段、查询受管理的数据并通过服务器端总计（根据分析师定义的指标和联接计算，从未从原始表猜测）获得答案，并管理定期报告运行计划。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3e81be8f8481918e1e2cd1.productIntroEn: OWOX Data Marts connects ChatGPT/Codex to your company's governed analytics layer. Data Analysts define trusted data marts — metrics, dimensions, and join logic — on top of your own warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, Athena).
plugin_asdk_app_6a3e81be8f8481918e1e2cd1.longDescription: OWOX Data Marts connects ChatGPT/Codex to your company's governed analytics layer. Data Analysts define trusted data marts — metrics, dimensions, and join logic — on top of your own warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, Athena). From ChatGPT/Codex you can discover the right data mart with natural-language search, inspect its fields, query governed data and get answers with server-side totals — computed from analyst-defined metrics and joins, never guessed from raw tables — and manage recurring report run schedules. Your data stays in your warehouse; OWOX connects to it but never retains it.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3e81be8f8481918e1e2cd1.longDescriptionZh: OWOX 数据集市将 ChatGPT/Codex 连接到您公司的受管分析层。数据分析师在您自己的仓库（BigQuery、Snowflake、Databricks、Redshift、Athena）之上定义可信数据集市（指标、维度和联接逻辑）。从 ChatGPT/Codex，您可以通过自然语言搜索发现正确的数据集市、检查其字段、查询受管理的数据并通过服务器端总计（根据分析师定义的指标和联接计算，从未从原始表猜测）获得答案，并管理定期报告运行计划。您的数据保留在您的仓库中； OWOX 连接到它但从不保留它。

plugin_asdk_app_69d5925bcec48191bf76d70c.name: decisionpoint.io
plugin_asdk_app_69d5925bcec48191bf76d70c.productIntro: 使用层次分析法 (AHP) 进行结构化决策，这是一种经过验证的比较选项和解决权衡的框架。
plugin_asdk_app_69d5925bcec48191bf76d70c.productIntroEn: Structured decision-making using the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) , a proven framework for comparing options and resolving trade-offs.
plugin_asdk_app_69d5925bcec48191bf76d70c.longDescription:
Structured decision-making using the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) , a proven framework for comparing options and resolving trade-offs.

Whether you're evaluating cars, comparing job offers, choosing a vendor, or weighing any set of alternatives, decisionpoint.io guides you through the process step by step. You define the goal, identify the factors that matter, list your options, and then compare them two at a time. AHP derives ranked results from your comparisons, showing which option best matches your priorities and why.

The app provides:
- A visual overview of your decision structure
- An interactive comparison interface within the conversation
- Ranked results with scores and criteria weights
- Consistency analysis to identify contradictory judgments

Decisions are saved to your decisionpoint.io account and can be revisited, refined, or continued at any time.
plugin_asdk_app_69d5925bcec48191bf76d70c.longDescriptionZh:
使用层次分析法 (AHP) 进行结构化决策，这是一种经过验证的比较选项和解决权衡的框架。

无论您是评估汽车、比较工作机会、选择供应商还是权衡任何替代方案，decisionpoint.io 都会引导您逐步完成整个过程。您定义目标，确定重要因素，列出您的选择，然后一次比较它们。 AHP 根据您的比较得出排名结果，显示哪个选项最符合您的优先级以及原因。

该应用程序提供：
- 决策结构的直观概览
- 对话内的交互式比较界面
- 带有分数和标准权重的排名结果
- 一致性分析以识别矛盾的判断

决策将保存到您的 Decisionpoint.io 帐户中，并且可以随时重新访问、完善或继续。
defaultPrompts: Use AHP to help my family choose a new car
Let's start the pairwise comparisons
Show me the final AHP results
defaultPromptsZh: 使用 AHP 帮助我的家人选择新车
让我们开始两两比较
显示最终的 AHP 结果

plugin_asdk_app_6a267cdfb48081919a4c5b8e.productIntro: CopyCharm 是一个上下文工作台，用于保存和重用提示、注释、喜爱的剪辑和策划的工作上下文。
plugin_asdk_app_6a267cdfb48081919a4c5b8e.productIntroEn: CopyCharm is a context workbench for saving and reusing prompts, notes, favorite clips, and curated working context.
plugin_asdk_app_6a267cdfb48081919a4c5b8e.longDescription:
CopyCharm is a context workbench for saving and reusing prompts, notes, favorite clips, and curated working context.

With this ChatGPT integration, existing CopyCharm users can access selected CopyCharm items directly within ChatGPT. Instead of manually copying and pasting the same background information, project notes, or templates into each chat, users can ask ChatGPT to find and retrieve the exact context they need.

This integration only accesses items that have been intentionally made available for AI Access in CopyCharm. It does not provide ChatGPT with access to a user's broader workspace or general clipboard history.
plugin_asdk_app_6a267cdfb48081919a4c5b8e.longDescriptionZh:
CopyCharm 是一个上下文工作台，用于保存和重用提示、注释、喜爱的剪辑和策划的工作上下文。

通过此 ChatGPT 集成，现有 CopyCharm 用户可以直接在 ChatGPT 中访问选定的 CopyCharm 项目。用户可以要求 ChatGPT 查找并检索他们需要的确切上下文，而不是手动将相同的背景信息、项目注释或模板复制并粘贴到每个聊天中。

此集成仅访问已特意为 CopyCharm 中的 AI Access 提供的项目。它不向 ChatGPT 提供对用户更广泛的工作空间或一般剪贴板历史记录的访问权限。

plugin_asdk_app_6a0227574dd4819184a0fa29.longDescription:
Query your work activity, career scores, and impact data directly in ChatGPT. Pull in Slack messages, GitHub PRs, Linear issues, meeting transcripts, and decisions to summarize your week, prep for 1-on-1s, or draft stakeholder updates — all through conversation.

Find Your Great captures your day-to-day work across platforms, scores you against your team's career framework, and surfaces behavioral patterns from your activity. 

Ask things like:
- "What did I work on this week?"
- "How are my evaluation scores trending?"
- "Draft an impact update for my manager covering the last two weeks"
- "What decisions did I make on the authentication project?"

The connection is OAuth-secured with granular scope control — you choose exactly which categories of data to share during setup.

plugin_asdk_app_6a5b7332e2bc8191bf1dc7ce.name: table
plugin_asdk_app_6a5b7332e2bc8191bf1dc7ce.productIntro: 表将 ChatGPT 连接到您的关系工作区，以便您可以在需要时找到联系人上下文，并将新详细信息保存回您的人员智能工具。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5b7332e2bc8191bf1dc7ce.productIntroEn: table connects ChatGPT to your relationship workspace, so you can find contact context when you need it and save new details back to your people intelligence tool.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5b7332e2bc8191bf1dc7ce.longDescription:
table connects ChatGPT to your relationship workspace, so you can find contact context when you need it and save new details back to your people intelligence tool.

Use the table connector to look up information about people in table, then create or update contacts from explicit details in conversations, emails, notes, or meeting recaps. ChatGPT can help with fields like name, email, phone, organization, job title, location, birthday, and contact status.

The connector works through table’s secure OAuth flow, acts as the authenticated table user, and exposes focused contact tools instead of raw database access.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5b7332e2bc8191bf1dc7ce.longDescriptionZh:
表将 ChatGPT 连接到您的关系工作区，以便您可以在需要时找到联系人上下文，并将新详细信息保存回您的人员智能工具。

使用表格连接器查找有关表格中人员的信息，然后根据对话、电子邮件、笔记或会议回顾中的明确详细信息创建或更新联系人。 ChatGPT 可以帮助处理姓名、电子邮件、电话、组织、职位、位置、生日和联系状态等字段。

连接器通过表的安全 OAuth 流程工作，充当经过身份验证的表用户，并公开集中的联系工具而不是原始数据库访问。
defaultPrompts: Add the contacts from this CSV file to table.

plugin_asdk_app_6a84511f5db88191906baf1e.productIntro: 起草、修改和组织您在镜头上阅读的脚本，而无需离开对话。连接您的 Teleprompter.com 帐户，ChatGPT 可以与您一起编写脚本，然后将其直接保存到您的工作区，归档到正确的文件夹中，并为您的下一次拍摄做好准备。
plugin_asdk_app_6a84511f5db88191906baf1e.productIntroEn: Draft, revise, and organize the scripts you read on camera, without leaving the conversation. Connect your Teleprompter.com account and ChatGPT can write a script with you, then save it straight to your workspace, filed in the right folder and ready for your next take.
plugin_asdk_app_6a84511f5db88191906baf1e.longDescription:
Draft, revise, and organize the scripts you read on camera, without leaving the conversation. Connect your Teleprompter.com account and ChatGPT can write a script with you, then save it straight to your workspace, filed in the right folder and ready for your next take.

What ChatGPT can do:

- Create scripts with playback settings applied as they're written: font size, scroll speed, timed-speed mode, text alignment, and estimated duration
- Revise existing scripts in place. Updates touch only the fields you ask for, so the rest of your setup stays as you left it
- Read your library: list scripts newest first, pull the full text of any script, and see what's inside each folder
- Organize: create folders, rename them, and move scripts between folders or back to the root

Because ChatGPT can read what you've already written, you can work from your own back catalogue: ask for a tighter cut of last month's intro, a 30-second version of a product explainer, or a consistent sign-off across everything in one folder.

You'll need a Teleprompter.com account; the integration is available on every account tier. Connecting uses OAuth, so there are no keys to copy or store, and you choose which permissions to grant: reading and writing scripts and folders are separate approvals, so read-only access is a valid choice. ChatGPT only ever sees your own personal workspace.

Scripts saved here are the same scripts your Teleprompter apps read, so anything drafted in a conversation is waiting for you the next time you open one up.

Differences from the Claude description, both deliberate:
plugin_asdk_app_6a84511f5db88191906baf1e.longDescriptionZh:
起草、修改和组织您在镜头上阅读的脚本，而无需离开对话。连接您的 Teleprompter.com 帐户，ChatGPT 可以与您一起编写脚本，然后将其直接保存到您的工作区，归档到正确的文件夹中，并为您的下一次拍摄做好准备。

ChatGPT 可以做什么：

- 创建脚本并在编写时应用播放设置：字体大小、滚动速度、定时速度模式、文本对齐和预计持续时间
- 修改现有脚本。更新仅涉及您要求的字段，因此其余设置将保持原样
- 阅读您的库：首先列出最新的脚本，提取任何脚本的全文，并查看每个文件夹中的内容
- 组织：创建文件夹、重命名文件夹以及在文件夹之间移动脚本或移回根目录

由于 ChatGPT 可以读取您已经编写的内容，因此您可以根据自己的过往目录进行工作：要求对上个月的介绍进行更严格的剪辑、30 秒版本的产品解释，或者对一个文件夹中的所有内容进行一致的签核。

您需要一个 Teleprompter.com 帐户；该集成适用于每个帐户级别。连接使用 OAuth，因此无需复制或存储密钥，并且您可以选择授予哪些权限：读取和写入脚本和文件夹是单独的批准，因此只读访问是有效的选择。 ChatGPT 只能看到您自己的个人工作区。

此处保存的脚本与提词器应用程序读取的脚本相同，因此对话中起草的任何内容都会在您下次打开对话时等待您。

与克劳德描述的差异，都是有意为之：
