plugin_asdk_app_6a632759aaf08191bf66f226.longDescription:
Schedule and publish social media posts from ChatGPT. PostSyncer connects ChatGPT to your Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Telegram and Mastodon accounts - 11 networks from one app.

Ask ChatGPT to write a caption, attach an image or video (including ones it just generated), and post now or schedule it across several networks at once, with per-platform variants. Ask how a post or an account performed and get views, likes, comments and shares back in the chat. Sync and reply to comments, hide spam, group posts into campaigns, and keep a media library - all without opening a dashboard.

Setup is one click: install the app and sign in to PostSyncer. Publishing goes through PostSyncer's official platform integrations, so ChatGPT never sees your social logins.

Try: "@PostSyncer schedule this video to TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts for tomorrow at 9am" - "@PostSyncer draft a week of LinkedIn and X posts about our launch and schedule them" - "@PostSyncer which of my posts got the most views this month?"

plugin_asdk_app_6a6fa68253a481918b4349a0.name: CiteLaw
plugin_asdk_app_6a6fa68253a481918b4349a0.productIntro: ChatGPT 内有完整的法律研究和公司管理工具包。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6fa68253a481918b4349a0.productIntroEn: A complete legal research and firm-management toolkit inside ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6fa68253a481918b4349a0.longDescription:
A complete legal research and firm-management toolkit inside ChatGPT.

Connect ChatGPT to CiteLaw’s U.S. legal database of millions of court opinions, statutes, regulations, court rules, standing orders, agency materials, and other legal authorities. ChatGPT retrieves CiteLaw’s source text instead of relying solely on model memory, producing answers grounded in identifiable authorities with direct citation links.

Legal research:
Ask legal questions in plain English and search cases, statutes, regulations, and rules across jurisdictions. Run Boolean, exact-phrase, metadata, and keyword searches. Retrieve an authority’s text and metadata, investigate how later courts have treated a case, and review a judge’s standing orders and practices. Paste a brief or citation list to verify authorities and identify possible, missing, or mismatched citations. Search documents and revisit prior research stored in your CiteLaw matters.

Firm management:
Review clients, contacts, tasks, deadlines, notes, documents, discovery, clauses, matters, saved workflows, team members, invitations, and workspace activity. Create and update leads, contacts, tasks, calendar events, discovery sets, clauses, matters, team workspaces, and reusable workflows. Run saved workflows in ChatGPT to follow your firm’s standardized research, review, and document processes. Use AI-assisted bulk imports to migrate contacts, matters, leads, tasks, deadlines, and notes from an existing case-management system in batches of 50, with source IDs that make reruns safe. Invite colleagues, manage workspace and matter access, assign roles, and set billing rates. Save notes and drafted Word documents to the active matter. Switch workspaces and matters so work remains in the correct team context.

Built for attorneys, law students, and legal scholars. CiteLaw retrieves and explains legal information; it does not provide legal advice, and using it does not create an attorney-client relationship.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6fa68253a481918b4349a0.longDescriptionZh:
ChatGPT 内有完整的法律研究和公司管理工具包。

将 ChatGPT 连接到 CiteLaw 的美国法律数据库，其中包含数百万条法院意见、法规、法规、法院规则、常规命令、机构材料和其他法律权威。 ChatGPT 检索 CiteLaw 的源文本，而不是仅仅依赖模型记忆，生成基于具有直接引用链接的可识别权威的答案。

法律研究：
用简单的英语询问法律问题并搜索跨司法管辖区的案例、法规、法规和规则。运行布尔、精确短语、元数据和关键字搜索。检索权威的文本和元数据，调查后来法院如何处理案件，并审查法官的常规命令和做法。粘贴简短或引文列表以验证权威并识别可能的、缺失的或不匹配的引文。搜索文档并重新访问您的 CiteLaw 事务中存储的先前研究。

公司管理：
查看客户、联系人、任务、截止日期、注释、文档、发现、条款、事项、保存的工作流程、团队成员、邀请和工作区活动。创建和更新潜在客户、联系人、任务、日历事件、发现集、条款、事项、团队工作区和可重用工作流程。在 ChatGPT 中运行保存的工作流程，以遵循公司的标准化研究、审查和文档流程。使用 AI 辅助的批量导入功能，以 50 个为一组的方式从现有案例管理系统中迁移联系人、事务、潜在客户、任务、截止日期和注释，并使用可确保重新运行安全的源 ID。邀请同事、管理工作区和事务访问、分配角色并设置计费费率。将笔记和起草的 Word 文档保存到活动事项中。切换工作空间和事务，以便工作保持在正确的团队环境中。

专为律师、法律学生和法律学者而设计。 CiteLaw 检索并解释法律信息；它不提供法律建议，并且使用它不会建立律师与委托人的关系。

Runa is read-only in ChatGPT. It cannot edit meetings, complete action items, or send messages. Results are limited by the connected user’s Runa access, workspace external-AI policy, and Runa’s public connector safety controls. A Runa account is required. Upcoming meeting info reflects Runa’s latest desktop sync and may not be live.

plugin_asdk_app_6a7da30673a481918a1f6867.name: PlatoForms
plugin_asdk_app_6a7da30673a481918a1f6867.productIntro: PlatoForms 是一个在线表单生成器，适用于 Web 表单、可填写的 PDF 表单和 PDF 文档。该插件连接您的 PlatoForms 帐户，以便您可以在对话中处理您自己的表单及其提交内容，而无需打开仪表板。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7da30673a481918a1f6867.productIntroEn: PlatoForms is an online form builder for web forms, fillable PDF forms and PDF documents. This plugin connects your PlatoForms account so you can work with your own forms and their submissions in conversation, instead of opening the dashboard.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7da30673a481918a1f6867.longDescription:
PlatoForms is an online form builder for web forms, fillable PDF forms and PDF documents. This plugin connects your PlatoForms account so you can work with your own forms and their submissions in conversation, instead of opening the dashboard.

What you can do

• Find forms. List published, draft or archived forms with their folder, publish state and submission count, or search by name.

• Understand a form. Read a form's full field schema — every field's id, type, label, whether it is required, its options and its validation rules — so you can reason about the data before you touch it.

• Review submissions. List a form's submissions newest-first, filter them by date range or keyword, find one by an exact field value (for example the submission where the email field is a particular address), and read every answer of a single submission with its field labels.

• Export. Mint a time-limited download URL for a submission's PDF, CSV, signing certificate, zipped attachments or a single attachment. Files are never streamed through the conversation — you get a link that expires.

• Share a prefilled link. Create one or more tracked invitation links to a form with fields already filled in, optionally single-use, optionally with an expiry. The plugin returns the URLs for you to send; it never sends email itself.

• Submit an entry. Post an entry to a published form after reading its schema, with validation errors returned verbatim so mistakes can be corrected and resubmitted.

• Start something new. Describe a form or a PDF document in plain English and get a builder link back. The design happens in the PlatoForms builder when you open the link, with its own AI asking you the clarifying questions.

How it connects

Sign in with your PlatoForms account over OAuth — your password is never shared with the assistant, access is scoped to read or read-and-write, and you can revoke it at any time from your PlatoForms account. The plugin can only see what your own account can see. A team owner controls whether the team is reachable this way at all, from Account → API.

Requirements

A PlatoForms account on a plan that includes API access. Actions count against your plan's API allowance. Teams in HIPAA mode have this access switched off by default and must opt in explicitly; data sent to a third-party AI assistant is not covered by the PlatoForms Business Associate Agreement.

What the plugin cannot do

It cannot edit an existing form or document, publish, delete, rename or duplicate anything, send email, or configure workflows, integrations or notifications. Those stay in the PlatoForms editor.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7da30673a481918a1f6867.longDescriptionZh:
PlatoForms 是一个在线表单生成器，适用于 Web 表单、可填写的 PDF 表单和 PDF 文档。该插件连接您的 PlatoForms 帐户，以便您可以在对话中处理您自己的表单及其提交内容，而无需打开仪表板。

你能做什么

• 查找表格。列出已发布、草稿或存档的表单及其文件夹、发布状态和提交计数，或按名称搜索。

• 了解表格。阅读表单的完整字段架构 - 每个字段的 ID、类型、标签、是否必需、其选项及其验证规则 - 这样您就可以在接触数据之前对其进行推理。

• 审核提交的内容。按最新的顺序列出表单的提交内容，按日期范围或关键字过滤它们，按精确的字段值查找（例如电子邮件字段是特定地址的提交内容），并读取单个提交内容的每个答案及其字段标签。

• 出口。为提交的 PDF、CSV、签名证书、压缩附件或单个附件创建一个限时下载 URL。文件永远不会通过对话进行流式传输 - 您会得到一个过期的链接。

• 分享预先填写的链接。创建一个或多个指向已填写字段的表单的跟踪邀请链接，可以选择一次性使用，也可以选择过期。该插件返回 URL 供您发送；它本身从不发送电子邮件。

• 提交参赛作品。阅读其架构后将条目发布到已发布的表单，并逐字返回验证错误，以便可以更正并重新提交错误。

• 开始新的事情。用简单的英语描述表单或 PDF 文档并获取构建器链接。当您打开链接时，设计会在 PlatoForms 构建器中进行，它自己的 AI 会向您询问澄清问题。

如何连接

通过 OAuth 使用您的 PlatoForms 帐户登录 - 您的密码永远不会与助手共享，访问权限仅限于读取或读写，并且您可以随时从 PlatoForms 帐户中撤销它。该插件只能看到您自己的帐户可以看到的内容。团队所有者通过帐户 → API 控制是否可以通过这种方式访问​​团队。

要求
包含 API 访问权限的计划中的 PlatoForms 帐户。操作将计入您计划的 API 限额。处于 HIPAA 模式的团队默认关闭此访问权限，并且必须明确选择加入； PlatoForms 业务伙伴协议不涵盖发送给第三方人工智能助手的数据。

插件不能做什么

它无法编辑现有表单或文档、发布、删除、重命名或复制任何内容、发送电子邮件或配置工作流程、集成或通知。这些保留在 PlatoForms 编辑器中。

plugin_asdk_app_6a83289f4e3c8191acbcc015.longDescription:
SourcePRD reads your codebase and writes the product story: the doors people come in through, the areas inside, and every capability — what it is, how people use it, and the files that implement it. Not the plan; the product as it exists in the code today.

Connect it and ChatGPT can answer from that story: what the product does, how a capability works for the person using it, which files stand behind it, and what changed this day, week or month. Seven read-only tools cover your projects, the product overview, the full story, doors and areas and capabilities, one capability in depth with its implementing files, search, and recent change.

Sign in with your SourcePRD account and allow read access; every project you can open is available. Nothing is written back to your code or your account. Every account can read the public demo projects, so you can try it before connecting a repository.
plugin_asdk_app_6a83289f4e3c8191acbcc015.longDescriptionZh:

连接它，ChatGPT 可以从这个故事中回答：产品的用途、功能如何为使用它的人发挥作用、它背后有哪些文件，以及这一天、一周或一个月发生了什么变化。七个只读工具涵盖您的项目、产品概述、完整故事、门、领域和功能，其中一项功能深入其实施文件、搜索和最近的更改。

使用您的 SourcePRD 帐户登录并允许读取访问权限；您可以打开的每个项目都可用。不会将任何内容写回您的代码或您的帐户。每个帐户都可以读取公共演示项目，因此您可以在连接存储库之前尝试它。

plugin_asdk_app_6a58cedb3f008191afee175c.productIntroEn: Meet Hero, your AI teammate for Sales. Hero can join your calls, write your follow-ups, research accounts, and help you keep every deal moving. This connector provides ChatGPT read-only access to your Hero data so you can get Hero’s insights wherever you work best.
plugin_asdk_app_6a58cedb3f008191afee175c.longDescription:
Meet Hero, your AI teammate for Sales. Hero can join your calls, write your follow-ups, research accounts, and help you keep every deal moving. This connector provides ChatGPT read-only access to your Hero data so you can get Hero’s insights wherever you work best. 

What you can do in ChatGPT with the Hero connector
• Search meeting transcripts by keyword, meaning, date range, or workspace to  pull the full transcript with per-speaker segments.
• Find and read Hero-generated artifacts like call summaries, account research, saved notes, and uploaded files.
• Browse and revisit your Hero conversation threads.
• Get a list of your Workspaces (accounts and deals) to scope your work. 

Example prompts
• “Summarize my calls with Acme this month, and draft a follow-up email.”
• “Can you tell me what objections came up during yesterday’s demo with Hooli?” 
• “Pull the account research Hero wrote for Globex and turn it into a one-pager.”
• “Find every call where pricing came up this quarter.”

Security and Privacy
• Sign in with secure OAuth: no passwords or API keys to manage.
• Strictly read-only: ChatGPT can retrieve your Hero data but cannot create, modify, or delete anything.
• Scoped to your own account: ChatGPT only sees data you already have access to in Hero
• Requires a Hero account: get started at meethero.ai.
plugin_asdk_app_6a58cedb3f008191afee175c.longDescriptionZh:
来认识一下 Hero，您的销售人工智能队友。 Hero 可以加入您的通话、撰写后续内容、研究账户，并帮助您推动每笔交易。此连接器提供 ChatGPT 对您的 Hero 数据的只读访问权限，因此无论您在哪里工作得最好，都可以获取 Hero 的见解。 

使用 Hero 连接器在 ChatGPT 中可以做什么
• 按关键字、含义、日期范围或工作区搜索会议记录，以提取包含每个发言者片段的完整记录。
• 查找并阅读 Hero 生成的工件，例如通话摘要、帐户研究、保存的笔记和上传的文件。
• 浏览并重新访问您的英雄对话线程。
• 获取您的工作空间（帐户和交易）列表以确定您的工作范围。 

提示示例
• “总结本月我与 Acme 的通话，并起草一封后续电子邮件。”
• “你能告诉我在昨天与Hooli 进行的演示中出现了哪些反对意见吗？” 
• “提取 Hero 为 Globex 撰写的帐户研究并将其变成一页纸。”
• “查找本季度定价上涨的每一个电话。”

安全和隐私
• 使用安全OAuth 登录：无需管理密码或API 密钥。
• 严格只读：ChatGPT 可以检索您的英雄数据，但无法创建、修改或删除任何内容。
• 范围仅限于您自己的帐户：ChatGPT 只能查看您在 Hero 中已有权访问的数据
• 需要英雄帐户：从meethero.ai 开始。

plugin_asdk_app_6a72ff3452c48191849926bc.productIntro: Bravos AI 允许企业创建根据自己的内容（网站、文档、产品目录）进行训练的人工智能聊天机器人，并将其部署在自己的网站或 WhatsApp 上。此应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Bravos 帐户，以便您无需打开仪表板即可管理一切：检查客户的要求、审核机器人用于每个答案的来源、修复知识差距、更新机器人的指令、系统提示和语气，并根据您的计划跟踪使用情况。
plugin_asdk_app_6a72ff3452c48191849926bc.productIntroEn: Bravos AI lets businesses create AI chatbots trained on their own content (website, documents, product catalogs) and deploy them on their website or WhatsApp. This app connects ChatGPT to your Bravos account so you can manage everything without opening the dashboard: check what your customers asked, audit which sources the bot used for each answer, fix knowledge gaps, update your bot's i…
plugin_asdk_app_6a72ff3452c48191849926bc.longDescription: Bravos AI lets businesses create AI chatbots trained on their own content (website, documents, product catalogs) and deploy them on their website or WhatsApp. This app connects ChatGPT to your Bravos account so you can manage everything without opening the dashboard: check what your customers asked, audit which sources the bot used for each answer, fix knowledge gaps, update your bot's instructions, system prompt and tone, and track usage against your plan. It comes with Bravos' professional judgment built in: the app knows how Bravos works internally and guides you toward changes that actually improve your bot's answers. Requires a Bravos AI account (bravos-ai.com).
plugin_asdk_app_6a72ff3452c48191849926bc.longDescriptionZh: Bravos AI 允许企业创建根据自己的内容（网站、文档、产品目录）进行训练的人工智能聊天机器人，并将其部署在自己的网站或 WhatsApp 上。此应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Bravos 帐户，以便您无需打开仪表板即可管理一切：检查客户的要求、审核机器人用于每个答案的来源、修复知识差距、更新机器人的指令、系统提示和语气，并根据您的计划跟踪使用情况。它内置了 Bravos 的专业判断：该应用程序了解 Bravos 内部的工作原理，并指导您做出真正改善机器人答案的更改。需要 Bravos AI 帐户 (bravos-ai.com)。
defaultPrompts: Show me my bots and how my account setup is going
What did my customers ask this week that the bot answered poorly?
Review my bot's knowledge base and tell me what is missing
defaultPromptsZh: 向我展示我的机器人以及我的帐户设置进展如何
本周我的客户问了哪些问题而机器人回答不佳？
检查我的机器人的知识库并告诉我缺少什么

plugin_asdk_app_6a3941529248819187322ac5.name: Flatre
plugin_asdk_app_6a3941529248819187322ac5.productIntro: Flatre 帮助房地产经纪人、交易协调员和经纪团队保持交易从第一次接触到成交。它将联系人、属性、交易、任务、展示、文档、佣金、日历和团队工作流程集成到一个共享工作区中，以便每个人都可以看到需要注意的内容以及发生的变化。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3941529248819187322ac5.productIntroEn: Flatre helps real estate agents, transaction coordinators, and brokerage teams keep deals moving from first contact to closing. It brings contacts, properties, transactions, tasks, showings, documents, commissions, calendars, and team workflows into one shared workspace, so everyone can see what needs attention and what changed.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3941529248819187322ac5.longDescription:
Flatre helps real estate agents, transaction coordinators, and brokerage teams keep deals moving from first contact to closing. It brings contacts, properties, transactions, tasks, showings, documents, commissions, calendars, and team workflows into one shared workspace, so everyone can see what needs attention and what changed.

Built for day-to-day brokerage work, Flatre connects with tools like email, calendars, MLS, e-signature, accounting, and storage. Its approval-first AI can help draft communications, review documents, organize intake, and surface next steps, giving teams clearer handoffs and fewer missed details.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3941529248819187322ac5.longDescriptionZh:
Flatre 帮助房地产经纪人、交易协调员和经纪团队保持交易从第一次接触到成交。它将联系人、属性、交易、任务、展示、文档、佣金、日历和团队工作流程集成到一个共享工作区中，以便每个人都可以看到需要注意的内容以及发生的变化。

Flatre 专为日常经纪工作而设计，可与电子邮件、日历、MLS、电子签名、会计和存储等工具连接。其审批优先的人工智能可以帮助起草沟通、审查文件、组织接收并确定后续步骤，从而使团队更清晰地交接并减少遗漏的细节。
defaultPrompts: What deals need my attention today?
Prep me for my next closing.
Create a follow-up task for my most urgent deal.
defaultPromptsZh: 今天有哪些交易需要我注意？
为我的下一次闭幕式做好准备。
为我最紧急的交易创建后续任务。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7b08b34cac8191813fecc5.name: Menti
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b08b34cac8191813fecc5.productIntro: 使用 Menti 免费创建交互式演示文稿。无论您是在线演示还是现场演示，Menti 都可以帮助您使用实时民意调查、现场测验、问答和文字云来吸引观众。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b08b34cac8191813fecc5.productIntroEn: Create interactive presentations for free with Menti. Whether you’re presenting online or in-person, Menti helps you engage your audience using real-time polls, live quizzes, Q&As and word clouds.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b08b34cac8191813fecc5.longDescription:
Create interactive presentations for free with Menti. Whether you’re presenting online or in-person, Menti helps you engage your audience using real-time polls, live quizzes, Q&As and word clouds.

Ask participants to join your Menti from their phone or laptop, and they can answer questions and share insights together in the moment.

Turn an idea for your next meeting into a Menti in seconds. Suitable for all types of live speaking, from town halls and presentations to workshops, lectures and classes. Simply describe what you want to ask your audience, and Menti will build the perfect slide. Edit and reorder as much as you like, then decide whether to make the answers public so everyone can see, or keep them private to reduce bias. Time to turn your presentations into conversations with Menti by Mentimeter!
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b08b34cac8191813fecc5.longDescriptionZh:
使用 Menti 免费创建交互式演示文稿。无论您是在线演示还是现场演示，Menti 都可以帮助您使用实时民意调查、现场测验、问答和文字云来吸引观众。

要求参与者通过手机或笔记本电脑加入您的 Menti，他们可以立即回答问题并分享见解。

在几秒钟内将您下次会议的想法变成 Menti。适合所有类型的现场演讲，从市政厅和演示到研讨会、讲座和课程。只需描述您想问观众的问题，Menti 就会制作完美的幻灯片。根据需要进行编辑和重新排序，然后决定是将答案公开以便每个人都可以看到，还是将其保密以减少偏见。是时候将您的演示变成与 Mentimeter 的 Menti 的对话了！
defaultPrompts: Create a poll to understand how clear the new company vision is to employees, and what questions there are for leadership team
Shorten "Q3 Team Kickoff" to five questions and add a quick word cloud icebreaker.
defaultPromptsZh: 创建一项民意调查，了解新公司愿景对员工来说有多清晰，以及领导团队有哪些问题
将“第三季度团队启动”缩短为五个问题，并添加一个快速的词云破冰游戏。

Find company registration details, status, and filings

plugin_asdk_app_6a7380d05fac8191b6082b0a.name: Izifete
plugin_asdk_app_6a7380d05fac8191b6082b0a.description: 查找附近的活动供应商
plugin_asdk_app_6a7380d05fac8191b6082b0a.productIntro: Izifete 可以帮助您在法国组织一场活动——婚礼、生日、洗礼、企业研讨会或聚会——找到经过验证的当地专业人士，并在您做出承诺之前为您提供切合实际的规划数据。按行业和城市搜索 15 个活动行业：餐饮服务商、街头小吃、DJ、摄影师、摄像师、照相亭、装饰师、娱乐、糕点师、花店、设备租赁、私人厨师、化妆师、美发师和接待场所。每个结果都是 izifete.fr 上真实发布的个人资料，显示其城市、交易和评级。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7380d05fac8191b6082b0a.productIntroEn: Izifete helps you organise an event in France - a wedding, a birthday, a christening, a corporate seminar or a party - by finding verified local professionals and giving you realistic planning figures before you commit.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7380d05fac8191b6082b0a.longDescription: Izifete helps you organise an event in France - a wedding, a birthday, a christening, a corporate seminar or a party - by finding verified local professionals and giving you realistic planning figures before you commit. Search by trade and by city across 15 event trades: caterer, street food, DJ, photographer, videographer, photo booth, decorator, entertainment, pastry chef, florist, equipment rental, private chef, make-up artist, hairdresser and reception venue. Every result is a real published profile on izifete.fr, shown with its city, its trades and its rating. You can also get planning figures taken from Izifete's published guides and calculators - a typical budget per trade, quantities to order, how far ahead to book each professional - and check whether a French company is officially registered from its SIRET number, using public government data. When you are ready, you can send a quote request to a professional. Izifete recaps the details and asks you to confirm first, and the request is then reviewed by the Izifete team before it reaches the professional. Nothing is sent automatically. Izifete covers France and Monaco only. When no verified professional matches a search yet, the plugin says so plainly instead of suggesting someone in another trade or another city.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7380d05fac8191b6082b0a.longDescriptionZh: Izifete 可以帮助您在法国组织一场活动——婚礼、生日、洗礼、企业研讨会或聚会——找到经过验证的当地专业人士，并在您做出承诺之前为您提供切合实际的规划数据。按行业和城市搜索 15 个活动行业：餐饮服务商、街头小吃、DJ、摄影师、摄像师、照相亭、装饰师、娱乐、糕点师、花店、设备租赁、私人厨师、化妆师、美发师和接待场所。每个结果都是 izifete.fr 上真实发布的个人资料，显示其城市、交易和评级。您还可以从 Izifete 出版的指南和计算器中获取规划数据 - 每笔交易的典型预算、订购数量、提前预订每位专业人员的时间 - 并使用公共政府数据通过其 SIRET 号码检查法国公司是否已正式注册。准备好后，您可以向专业人士发送报价请求。 Izifete 会重述详细信息并要求您先确认，然后 Izifete 团队会审核该请求，然后再发送给专业人员。不会自动发送任何内容。 Izifete 仅覆盖法国和摩纳哥。当尚未经过验证的专业人士与搜索匹配时，该插件会直接说明这一点，而不是建议其他行业或另一个城市的人员。

plugin_asdk_app_6a869455f9348191a74170c5.name: Atlas Red
plugin_asdk_app_6a869455f9348191a74170c5.productIntro: Atlas Red 是结构化思维导图的工作区。导图是一棵主题树，导图中的每个主题都共享相同的作者定义的字段（纯文本或键入的字段，例如带有自己的选项、数字或日期的选择），因此导图的行为就像您可以看到的小型数据库。
plugin_asdk_app_6a869455f9348191a74170c5.productIntroEn: Atlas Red is a workspace for structured mind maps. A map is a tree of topics, and every topic in a map shares the same author-defined fields — plain text, or typed ones like a select with its own options, a number or a date — so a map behaves like a small database you can see.
plugin_asdk_app_6a869455f9348191a74170c5.longDescription:
Atlas Red is a workspace for structured mind maps. A map is a tree of topics, and every topic in a map shares the same author-defined fields — plain text, or typed ones like a select with its own options, a number or a date — so a map behaves like a small database you can see.

Connect your account and you can create maps, read a single topic's neighbourhood without pulling in the whole map, add and reorganise topics, fill in typed fields, link topics across branches, and import or export maps as Markdown, OPML, YAML and other formats. Every change is saved to your account, and anything you do here can be undone — from this conversation or later in the app.

The maps persist and stay yours: the same map opens in the Atlas Red web app on any device, on a visual canvas where you can rearrange it, colour it by one of its fields, attach images and share a read-only link.
plugin_asdk_app_6a869455f9348191a74170c5.longDescriptionZh:
Atlas Red 是结构化思维导图的工作区。导图是一棵主题树，导图中的每个主题都共享相同的作者定义的字段（纯文本或键入的字段，例如带有自己的选项、数字或日期的选择），因此导图的行为就像您可以看到的小型数据库。

连接您的帐户，您可以创建地图、读取单个主题的邻域而无需提取整个地图、添加和重新组织主题、填写键入的字段、跨分支链接主题以及将地图导入或导出为 Markdown、OPML、YAML 和其他格式。每项更改都会保存到您的帐户中，您在此处所做的任何操作都可以通过此对话或稍后在应用程序中撤消。

地图会保留并保留在您手中：同一张地图会在任何设备上的 Atlas Red Web 应用程序中打开，在可视化画布上，您可以在其中重新排列它、按其字段之一为其着色、附加图像并共享只读链接。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5cc3a722c08191a8d64f1e.productIntro: RuleFoundry 查找您创建的或分配给您的提取，显示其状态和 RuleFoundry 链接，并使已完成的提取中的最终工件可用作规划、代码、文档和分析的引用源材料。在您确认确切的主题、可选描述和参与者后，它可以为您或外部电子邮件地址创建一个提取请求。 RuleFoundry 自动发送外部邀请。 RuleFoundry 中仍然会发生提取会话；该插件无法启动、执行、继续、完成、重新发送、修改或删除它们。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5cc3a722c08191a8d64f1e.longDescription: RuleFoundry finds Extractions you created or that were assigned to you, shows their status and RuleFoundry link, and makes finalized artifacts from completed Extractions available as cited source material for planning, code, documents, and analysis. After you confirm the exact topic, optional description, and participant, it can create one Extraction request for you or an external email address. RuleFoundry sends the external invitation automatically. Extraction sessions still happen in RuleFoundry; the plugin cannot start, conduct, continue, complete, resend, modify, or delete them.

plugin_asdk_app_6a84157cb71081918007c014.name: Planday
plugin_asdk_app_6a84157cb71081918007c014.description: 管理 Planday 日程安排
plugin_asdk_app_6a84157cb71081918007c014.productIntro: 直接连接到您的 Planday 帐户，完全通过自然对话来管理日程安排、轮班和团队缺勤。
plugin_asdk_app_6a84157cb71081918007c014.productIntroEn: Connect directly to your Planday account to manage scheduling, shifts, and team absences entirely through natural conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a84157cb71081918007c014.longDescription:
Connect directly to your Planday account to manage scheduling, shifts, and team absences entirely through natural conversation.

Save time and streamline your daily operations by bringing instant workforce insights directly into your workflow. Instead of switching tabs, you can simply ask for what you need: check who is on shift next Saturday, see Anna’s remaining annual leave balance, or instantly verify James’s working-time compliance before booking his next shift. You can draft, assign, and publish shifts individually, or ask ChatGPT to factor in upcoming events to help you quickly coordinate next week's schedule.

Core Capabilities:

Scheduling: View, create, assign, and publish shifts by department, employee, or date.
Employees: Look up staff groups, roles, and department structures.
Absence: Check live leave balances and review policies
Compliance: Check working-time rules on a schedule

Enterprise-Grade Security & Permissions:
Every action respects your existing Planday user permissions. Managers only access manager-level data, while employees only see their own information. No data is surfaced that would not normally be available to you inside the Planday app.

Securely connect via your standard Planday login with zero configuration required.
plugin_asdk_app_6a84157cb71081918007c014.longDescriptionZh:
直接连接到您的 Planday 帐户，完全通过自然对话来管理日程安排、轮班和团队缺勤。

通过将即时的劳动力洞察直接引入您的工作流程，节省时间并简化您的日常运营。您无需切换标签，只需询问您需要的内容：检查下周六谁轮班，查看安娜的剩余年假余额，或者在预订下一个轮班之前立即验证詹姆斯的工作时间合规性。您可以单独起草、分配和发布班次，或者要求 ChatGPT 将即将发生的事件考虑在内，以帮助您快速协调下周的日程安排。

核心能力：

排班：按部门、员工或日期查看、创建、分配和发布班次。
员工：查找员工群体、角色和部门结构。
缺勤：检查实时休假余额并审查政策
合规性：检查时间表上的工作时间规则

企业级安全和权限：
每个操作都会尊重您现有的 Planday 用户权限。经理只能访问经理级别的数据，而员工只能看到自己的信息。 Planday 应用程序中不会显示通常无法提供的数据。

通过标准 Planday 登录安全连接，无需零配置。

plugin_asdk_app_6a35ffa426c081919e10b714.description: 随时随地计划。在 D/R 中执行。
plugin_asdk_app_6a35ffa426c081919e10b714.productIntro: 想要养成更好的习惯、坚持目标、改善健康、加强日常生活或制定个人成长计划？ ChatGPT 可以帮助您集思广益，构建目标，建立习惯系统，并根据您想要实现的目标制定问责计划。
plugin_asdk_app_6a35ffa426c081919e10b714.productIntroEn: Want to build better habits, stay consistent with goals, improve your health, strengthen your routines, or create a plan for personal growth? ChatGPT can help you brainstorm ideas, structure goals, build habit systems, and create accountability plans tailored to what you're trying to achieve.
plugin_asdk_app_6a35ffa426c081919e10b714.longDescription:
Want to build better habits, stay consistent with goals, improve your health, strengthen your routines, or create a plan for personal growth? ChatGPT can help you brainstorm ideas, structure goals, build habit systems, and create accountability plans tailored to what you're trying to achieve.

When you're ready, ChatGPT can send that plan to Discipline Rewards as a pending draft for review. Nothing is added automatically. Every plan must be reviewed and approved inside Discipline Rewards before habits, goals, or accountability commitments are created.

Discipline Rewards helps turn good intentions into consistent action. Use ChatGPT to think through the plan, then use Discipline Rewards to review, approve, and execute it.

This integration is designed to keep planning flexible while keeping execution intentional. Build plans in ChatGPT, then follow through in Discipline Rewards.
plugin_asdk_app_6a35ffa426c081919e10b714.longDescriptionZh:
想要养成更好的习惯、坚持目标、改善健康、加强日常生活或制定个人成长计划？ ChatGPT 可以帮助您集思广益，构建目标，建立习惯系统，并根据您想要实现的目标制定问责计划。

当您准备好后，ChatGPT 可以将该计划作为待审核草稿发送至纪律奖励。不会自动添加任何内容。在创建习惯、目标或责任承诺之前，每个计划都必须在纪律奖励中进行审查和批准。

纪律奖励有助于将良好的意愿转化为一致的行动。使用 ChatGPT 仔细考虑该计划，然后使用纪律奖励来审查、批准和执行该计划。

这种集成旨在保持计划的灵活性，同时保持执行的目的性。在 ChatGPT 中制定计划，然后在纪律奖励中执行。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5ef4bbceb88191bf6030d2.productIntro: Breeze 将您的项目引入 ChatGPT，以便您可以通过描述您的需求来管理工作。询问“什么逾期了？”、“给我发布项目的概述”或“找到有关客户引导的任务”——然后得到清晰、直接的答案。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5ef4bbceb88191bf6030d2.productIntroEn: Breeze brings your projects into ChatGPT, so you can manage work by describing what you need. Ask "what's overdue?", "give me an overview of the launch project", or "find the task about customer onboarding" — and get a clear, straight answer.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5ef4bbceb88191bf6030d2.longDescription:
Breeze brings your projects into ChatGPT, so you can manage work by describing what you need. Ask "what's overdue?", "give me an overview of the launch project", or "find the task about customer onboarding" — and get a clear, straight answer.

It doesn't just read — it does the work: create projects and cards, add checklists, post comments, log time, set estimates, move tasks forward, and see everything that changed today. Breeze figures out which people, columns, and projects you mean, so a quick sentence is enough to get things done.

Can't remember the exact title of a task? Search by meaning, not just keywords, and it still turns up. And because changes preview before they apply, you always see what's about to happen before it does.

From kicking off a launch to triaging your week, Breeze turns project management into a conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5ef4bbceb88191bf6030d2.longDescriptionZh:
Breeze 将您的项目引入 ChatGPT，以便您可以通过描述您的需求来管理工作。询问“什么逾期了？”、“给我发布项目的概述”或“找到有关客户引导的任务”——然后得到清晰、直接的答案。

它不只是阅读——它还可以工作：创建项目和卡片、添加清单、发表评论、记录时间、设置估算、推进任务以及查看今天发生的所有变化。 Breeze 会弄清楚您指的是哪些人、哪些专栏和哪些项目，因此简短的一句话就足以完成工作。

不记得任务的确切标题？按含义搜索，而不仅仅是关键字，它仍然会出现。而且由于更改会在应用之前进行预览，因此您始终可以在应用之前看到即将发生的情况。

从启动发布到对一周进行分类，Breeze 将项目管理变成了一场对话。

Plan my product launch and set up the board for it

plugin_asdk_app_69aabb9fed388191a27178a8.productIntro: 标记 AI 在一次调用中根据组织配置的质量检查来审查草稿：品牌声音漂移、未经批准的术语、违反风格指南、难以阅读的句子、人工智能听起来的措辞、不受支持或有风险的声明、缺少来源和人工智能搜索准备情况。用户在 ChatGPT 中共享内容，可选择说明他们想要实现的目标，并获取运行的检查、任何配置警告以及标记的问题位置、解释和建议的更正。团队还可以使用选定的角色、品牌语音配置文件、风格指南或内容配置文件运行一组明确的命名检查，并列出其组织可用的检查和配置。
plugin_asdk_app_69aabb9fed388191a27178a8.productIntroEn: Markup AI reviews drafts against an organization's configured quality checks in a single call: brand voice drift, unapproved terminology, style-guide violations, hard-to-read sentences, AI-sounding phrasing, unsupported or risky claims, missing sourcing, and AI-search readiness.
plugin_asdk_app_69aabb9fed388191a27178a8.longDescription: Markup AI reviews drafts against an organization's configured quality checks in a single call: brand voice drift, unapproved terminology, style-guide violations, hard-to-read sentences, AI-sounding phrasing, unsupported or risky claims, missing sourcing, and AI-search readiness. plugin_asdk_app_6a03edda077081918b92a934.description: MS Team 的 AI 行动
plugin_asdk_app_6a03edda077081918b92a934.productIntro: AB (ActionBridge) 在您的 AI 代理和 Microsoft Teams 之间提供安全可靠的集成层。它使您的模型能够直接与工作空间交互，将被动的人工智能见解转变为团队日常运营的积极参与者。
plugin_asdk_app_6a03edda077081918b92a934.productIntroEn: AB (ActionBridge) provides a secure and reliable integration layer between your AI agents and Microsoft Teams. It enables your models to interact directly with your workspace, transforming passive AI insights into active participants in your team's daily operations.
plugin_asdk_app_6a03edda077081918b92a934.longDescription:
AB (ActionBridge) provides a secure and reliable integration layer between your AI agents and Microsoft Teams. It enables your models to interact directly with your workspace, transforming passive AI insights into active participants in your team's daily operations.

Key Features
Direct Teams Connectivity: Seamlessly link your AI models to Microsoft Teams channels and private chats.

Workflow Automation: Trigger real-time messages, notifications, and status updates based on agent-driven logic.

Secure Integration: Designed as a professional conduit to ensure stable data flow between LLMs and enterprise communication hubs.

Why You’ll Love It
AB eliminates the need to manually relay information between your AI tools and your team. By allowing your agent to communicate where the work happens, it reduces context switching and ensures that AI-generated actions are delivered instantly to the right stakeholders. Whether you are automating project updates or facilitating AI-driven collaboration, AB makes your agents more actionable and effective.
plugin_asdk_app_6a03edda077081918b92a934.longDescriptionZh:
AB (ActionBridge) 在您的 AI 代理和 Microsoft Teams 之间提供安全可靠的集成层。它使您的模型能够直接与工作空间交互，将被动的人工智能见解转变为团队日常运营的积极参与者。

主要特点
直接 Teams 连接：将您的 AI 模型无缝链接到 Microsoft Teams 频道和私人聊天。

工作流程自动化：根据代理驱动的逻辑触发实时消息、通知和状态更新。

安全集成：设计为专业渠道，确保法学硕士和企业通信中心之间的稳定数据流。

为什么你会喜欢它
AB 消除了在 AI 工具和团队之间手动传递信息的需要。通过允许您的代理在工作发生的地点进行沟通，可以减少上下文切换，并确保人工智能生成的操作立即交付给正确的利益相关者。无论您是自动化项目更新还是促进人工智能驱动的协作，AB 都能使您的代理更具可操作性和效率。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7e2518fdf88191bcfab1b7.name: RiverScript
plugin_asdk_app_6a7e2518fdf88191bcfab1b7.productIntro: 使用 RiverScript 捕获并转录您在计算机上可以听到的所有内容，然后将您的转录内容带入您的 ChatGPT 工作流程中。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7e2518fdf88191bcfab1b7.productIntroEn: Capture and transcribe everything you can hear on your computer with RiverScript, then bring your transcripts into your ChatGPT workflow.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7e2518fdf88191bcfab1b7.longDescription:
Capture and transcribe everything you can hear on your computer with RiverScript, then bring your transcripts into your ChatGPT workflow.

RiverScript turns meetings, calls, lectures, podcasts, interviews, and any other media content into text. Record your system audio directly from any app with RiverScript Desktop client for Windows and Mac, or transcribe your audio and video files up to 50 GB and 8 hours long.

In RiverScript click the Share button for the transcript you want to bring into ChatGPT and get the link. Add it to this app. Continue working with your transcript in ChatGPT however you like. 

It works with both transcripts and their AI translations.
Transcribe with RiverScript. Work with ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7e2518fdf88191bcfab1b7.longDescriptionZh:
使用 RiverScript 捕获并转录您在计算机上可以听到的所有内容，然后将您的转录内容带入您的 ChatGPT 工作流程中。

RiverScript 将会议、电话、讲座、播客、采访和任何其他媒体内容转换为文本。使用适用于 Windows 和 Mac 的 RiverScript 桌面客户端直接从任何应用程序录制系统音频，或转录最大 50 GB 和 8 小时的音频和视频文件。

在 RiverScript 中，单击您想要引入 ChatGPT 的记录的“共享”按钮并获取链接。将其添加到此应用程序中。按照您喜欢的方式继续在 ChatGPT 中处理您的成绩单。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5729b1c8708191bf68d3ff.name: mfloow
plugin_asdk_app_6a5729b1c8708191bf68d3ff.description: mflow：人工智能工作流程平台
plugin_asdk_app_6a5729b1c8708191bf68d3ff.productIntro: mfloow 是一个业务流程改进平台，它使用人工智能提供端到端支持，从可视化操作到确保改进成功嵌入整个组织。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5729b1c8708191bf68d3ff.productIntroEn: mfloow is a business process improvement platform that uses AI to provide end-to-end support, from visualizing operations to ensuring that improvements are successfully embedded across the organization.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5729b1c8708191bf68d3ff.longDescription:
mfloow is a business process improvement platform that uses AI to provide end-to-end support, from visualizing operations to ensuring that improvements are successfully embedded across the organization.

By visualizing task progress, assignees, deadlines, and approval statuses, mfloow enables users to quickly understand the overall state of their operations. It also standardizes business workflows to reduce inconsistencies between individuals and prevent processes from becoming dependent on specific employees. In addition, mfloow automates routine activities such as initiating workflows, assigning tasks, and sending notifications, thereby reducing administrative effort and human error. Its AI-assisted workflow creation capabilities help organizations reduce the time required to design processes, improve operational quality, and establish a sustainable framework for continuous improvement.

The mfloow plugin allows users to access flow and task information stored in mfloow and check progress, deadlines, and assigned work through a conversational interface. Users can review ongoing flows, identify their assigned tasks, and detect overdue tasks, as well as view detailed information such as task comments, checklists, related tasks, and approval statuses.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5729b1c8708191bf68d3ff.longDescriptionZh:
mfloow 是一个业务流程改进平台，它使用人工智能提供端到端支持，从可视化操作到确保改进成功嵌入整个组织。

通过可视化任务进度、受让人、截止日期和审批状态，mfloow 使用户能够快速了解​​其操作的整体状态。它还标准化业务工作流程，以减少个人之间的不一致，并防止流程依赖于特定员工。此外，mfloow 还可以自动执行日常活动，例如启动工作流程、分配任务和发送通知，从而减少管理工作和人为错误。其人工智能辅助工作流程创建功能可帮助组织减少设计流程所需的时间、提高运营质量并建立持续改进的可持续框架。

mfloow 插件允许用户访问 mfloow 中存储的流程和任务信息，并通过对话界面检查进度、截止日期和分配的工作。用户可以查看正在进行的流程、识别其分配的任务、检测过期任务，以及查看详细信息，例如任务注释、清单、相关任务和审批状态。

plugin_asdk_app_6a601eb637a081919a66a094.description: 跟踪发货并在全球范围内预订
plugin_asdk_app_6a601eb637a081919a66a094.productIntro: 使用 TX Logis 轻松进行全球运输和跟踪
plugin_asdk_app_6a601eb637a081919a66a094.productIntroEn: Effortless Global Shipping and Tracking with TX Logis
plugin_asdk_app_6a601eb637a081919a66a094.longDescription:
Effortless Global Shipping and Tracking with TX Logis

TX Logis is a global logistics and parcel delivery assistant that helps users navigate international shipping services with ease.

Whether you are sending personal parcels overseas, booking a pickup, submitting a shipping request, or tracking a business shipment, TX Logis provides step-by-step guidance for smooth and reliable delivery support.

TX Logis supports users looking for logistics services, parcel delivery, courier service, shipping reservations, shipment requests, personal shipping, quick delivery, international shipping, and shipment tracking.

Key Features:

- Real-time Tracking: Learn how to check your shipment status instantly using your tracking number or waybill.
- SmartPost Booking: Guidance for C2C international parcel delivery, personal shipping, pickup booking, and door-to-door services.
- Shipping Reservation and Request Support: Help with delivery reservations, shipment requests, parcel booking, and international shipping applications.
- Global Shipping Guide: Instructions for shipping to 70+ countries including Japan, Singapore, the US, and other major destinations.
- Logistics and Courier Support: Quick answers about logistics services, parcel delivery, courier service, quick delivery, shipping rates, prohibited items, and required documentation.
- Personal and Business Shipping: Support for both individual customers and business users sending parcels or managing shipments.

Simplify your international logistics, parcel delivery, booking, and tracking experience with the TX Logis assistant.
plugin_asdk_app_6a601eb637a081919a66a094.longDescriptionZh:
使用 TX Logis 轻松进行全球运输和跟踪

TX Logis 是一款全球物流和包裹递送助手，可帮助用户轻松导航国际运输服务。

无论您是向海外寄送个人包裹、预订取件、提交运输请求还是跟踪商业货件，TX Logis 都会提供分步指导，以实现平稳可靠的递送支持。

TX Logis 支持寻求物流服务、包裹递送、快递服务、运输预订、运输请求、个人运输、快速交付、国际运输和运输跟踪的用户。

主要特点：

- 实时跟踪：了解如何使用您的跟踪号码或运单立即检查您的货件状态。
- SmartPost预订：C2C国际包裹递送、个人寄件、取件预订、上门服务指南。
- 运输预订和请求支持：帮助进行运输预订、运输请求、包裹预订和国际运输申请。
- 全球运送指南：运送至 70 多个国家/地区（包括日本、新加坡、美国和其他主要目的地）的说明。
- 物流和快递支持：有关物流服务、包裹递送、快递服务、快速配送、运费、违禁物品和所需文件的快速解答。
- 个人和企业运输：支持个人客户和企业用户发送包裹或管理货件。

使用 TX Logis 助手简化您的国际物流、包裹递送、预订和跟踪体验。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8138f4b028819199d1e6a4.description: LinkedIn 帖子的起草和评分
plugin_asdk_app_6a8138f4b028819199d1e6a4.productIntro: FeedBoss 将您的助手连接到您的 LinkedIn 内容工作区。它根据您自己的知识库，用您保存的声音起草帖子，在发布任何内容之前根据读者反应质量检查对草稿进行评分，保存您可以编辑的草稿，并安排批准的草稿在您每次确认的时间发布到 LinkedIn。它还报告分析、每周发帖一致性条纹，以及刷新的高绩效帖子墙以获取灵感。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8138f4b028819199d1e6a4.productIntroEn: FeedBoss connects your assistant to your LinkedIn content workspace. It drafts posts in your saved voice grounded in your own knowledge base, scores a draft against a reader-reaction quality check before anything is published, saves drafts you can edit, and schedules approved drafts to publish to LinkedIn at a time you confirm each time.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8138f4b028819199d1e6a4.longDescription: FeedBoss connects your assistant to your LinkedIn content workspace. It drafts posts in your saved voice grounded in your own knowledge base, scores a draft against a reader-reaction quality check before anything is published, saves drafts you can edit, and schedules approved drafts to publish to LinkedIn at a time you confirm each time. It also reports analytics, weekly posting-consistency streaks, and a refreshed wall of high-performing posts for inspiration.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8138f4b028819199d1e6a4.longDescriptionZh: FeedBoss 将您的助手连接到您的 LinkedIn 内容工作区。它根据您自己的知识库，用您保存的声音起草帖子，在发布任何内容之前根据读者反应质量检查对草稿进行评分，保存您可以编辑的草稿，并安排批准的草稿在您每次确认的时间发布到 LinkedIn。它还报告分析、每周发帖一致性条纹，以及刷新的高绩效帖子墙以获取灵感。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7c5944b14c8191ac9a1582.name: Readplace
plugin_asdk_app_6a7c5944b14c8191ac9a1582.productIntro: Readplace 是一款稍后阅读的应用程序，您的助手可以直接使用它来保存搜索的原始来源。在对话中保存链接，它会出现在您在浏览器和手机上阅读的同一个队列中，并填充标题、摘录和清晰的阅读器视图。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7c5944b14c8191ac9a1582.productIntroEn: Readplace is a read-it-later app your assistant can work with directly to dave original sources of your searches. Save a link mid-conversation and it lands in the same queue you read from in the browser and on your phone, with the title, excerpt, and a clean reader view filled in.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7c5944b14c8191ac9a1582.longDescription:
Readplace is a read-it-later app your assistant can work with directly to dave original sources of your searches. Save a link mid-conversation and it lands in the same queue you read from in the browser and on your phone, with the title, excerpt, and a clean reader view filled in.

Your assistant can read that queue back too: list what you've saved, filter to unread, pull an article's details, reader view, or AI summary to talk about it, surface related saves from your own queue, and mark things read or unread as you get to them.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7c5944b14c8191ac9a1582.longDescriptionZh:
Readplace 是一款稍后阅读的应用程序，您的助手可以直接使用它来保存搜索的原始来源。在对话中保存链接，它会出现在您在浏览器和手机上阅读的同一个队列中，并填充标题、摘录和清晰的阅读器视图。

您的助手也可以读回该队列：列出您已保存的内容，过滤未读内容，提取文章的详细信息、读者视图或人工智能摘要以进行讨论，从您自己的队列中显示相关的保存内容，并在您访问它们时将其标记为已读或未读。

plugin_asdk_app_6a75663fc39c81919f9034be.name: VesselTwin
plugin_asdk_app_6a75663fc39c81919f9034be.productIntro: 连接 VesselTwin 向 ChatGPT 询问您已保存的船舶记录。 VesselTwin 新手？访问 Vesseltwin.io 创建免费帐户，然后选择“连接”并登录。基本访问权限显示批准的船只、维护、设备和文档元数据。 Owner Pro 客户可以单独选择让 ChatGPT 读取他们拥有的船只的私人记录，包括提取的文档文本。可选的第二个权限允许 ChatGPT 将建议的注释、清单、维护条目和测量结果发送到 VesselTwin 收件箱以供所有者审核。
plugin_asdk_app_6a75663fc39c81919f9034be.productIntroEn: Connect VesselTwin to ask ChatGPT about the boat records you already keep. New to VesselTwin? Visit vesseltwin.io to create a free account, then select Connect and sign in. Basic access shows approved boat, maintenance, equipment, and document metadata. Owner Pro customers can separately opt in to let ChatGPT read private records, including extracted document text, for boats they own.
plugin_asdk_app_6a75663fc39c81919f9034be.longDescription: Connect VesselTwin to ask ChatGPT about the boat records you already keep. New to VesselTwin? Visit vesseltwin.io to create a free account, then select Connect and sign in. Basic access shows approved boat, maintenance, equipment, and document metadata. Owner Pro customers can separately opt in to let ChatGPT read private records, including extracted document text, for boats they own. An optional second permission lets ChatGPT send proposed notes, checklists, maintenance entries, and measurements to the VesselTwin Inbox for owner review. Nothing becomes a saved record until the owner accepts it, and customers can turn either permission off at any time. Photo files and private records from collaborator-only boats are never included.

plugin_asdk_app_6a7623de3ab881918f64ee87.longDescription:
Promptbanken is an open, curated library of ready-to-use prompt templates for municipalities, schools, companies, associations, and individuals. Search the catalog for a task, fetch a chosen template in full, and follow a prompt package step by step — directly in ChatGPT.

The published connector is open, read-only, and requires no account or sign-in. It receives only the parameters its tools define: a search term, a role word, filters, and the id or slug of a catalog entry. Nothing else from the conversation reaches the server, and the connector publishes no write tools, so it cannot store anything. Search terms are never stored — only the length of a query is counted in anonymous usage statistics.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7623de3ab881918f64ee87.longDescriptionZh:
Promptbanken 是一个开放的、精心策划的库，为市政当局、学校、公司、协会和个人提供即用型提示模板。在目录中搜索任务，完整获取所选模板，然后直接在 ChatGPT 中按照提示包一步步操作。

已发布的连接器是开放的、只读的，不需要帐户或登录。它仅接收其工具定义的参数：搜索词、角色词、过滤器以及目录条目的 id 或 slug。对话中的任何其他内容都不会到达服务器，并且连接器不会发布任何写入工具，因此它无法存储任何内容。搜索词永远不会被存储——只有查询的长度才会被计入匿名使用统计信息。

Plugin_a2dab42b4d448191beca93f30317b2b9.originalDescription: Run independent replays in the in-app or system browser.
Plugin_a2dab42b4d448191beca93f30317b2b9.productIntro: 在可用的环回端口上启动独立的 Codex Replay 控制器。在 Codex Desktop 和 Codex CLI 中，首选可用的 Codex 应用内浏览器，否则使用系统浏览器。选择一个或多个历史 Claude 线程，选择共享 Codex 模型，并启动其独立实现。单独检测每个线程的历史状态和配置，并在需要时提供详细信息。单独或聚合查看已完成的比较，同时剩余线程继续。默认选择可用的 GPT-5.6 Sol、Terra 和 Luna 模型。
Plugin_a2dab42b4d448191beca93f30317b2b9.productIntroEn: Start an independent Codex Replay controller on an available loopback port. In both Codex Desktop and Codex CLI, prefer an available Codex in-app browser and otherwise use your system browser. Select one or more historical Claude threads, choose shared Codex models, and start their isolated implementations.
Plugin_a2dab42b4d448191beca93f30317b2b9.longDescription: Start an independent Codex Replay controller on an available loopback port. In both Codex Desktop and Codex CLI, prefer an available Codex in-app browser and otherwise use your system browser. Select one or more historical Claude threads, choose shared Codex models, and start their isolated implementations. Historical state and configuration are detected separately for each thread, with details available when needed. View finished comparisons individually or in aggregate while remaining threads continue. Available GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna models are selected by default. Multiple replay sessions can run in parallel. Selection, execution, verification, evaluation, and results stay in the browser controller instead of a guided chat workflow.

plugin_asdk_app_6a76351f23588191a3a3f568.name: Socra Cortex
plugin_asdk_app_6a76351f23588191a3a3f568.productIntro: Socra Cortex 将您的特定知识和工作转化为可重用的基础设施，您的代理可以跨工具和时间阅读、思考和采取行动。
plugin_asdk_app_6a76351f23588191a3a3f568.productIntroEn: Socra Cortex turns your specific knowledge and work into reusable infrastructure your agents read, think, and act on across tools and time.
plugin_asdk_app_6a76351f23588191a3a3f568.longDescription:
Socra Cortex turns your specific knowledge and work into reusable infrastructure your agents read, think, and act on across tools and time.

With Cortex, ChatGPT can capture what you know, assemble it into a dependency graph, and learn it on-demand, turning ChatGPT into a subject matter expert in your domain instantly.

Key Features:
- Context Modules: Composable, reusable context that can be assembled into a complex knowledge dependency graph
- Flash: Load the complete dependency graph of any Module into the context window in dependency order on demand, turning a generic agent into an SME
- Issues: Create and manage work across your entire organization
- Collaboration: Works with your entire team, so you can share context and work
plugin_asdk_app_6a76351f23588191a3a3f568.longDescriptionZh:
Socra Cortex 将您的特定知识和工作转化为可重用的基础设施，您的代理可以跨工具和时间阅读、思考和采取行动。

借助 Cortex，ChatGPT 可以捕获您所知道的信息，将其组装成依赖图并按需学习，从而立即将 ChatGPT 变成您所在领域的主题专家。

主要特点：
- 上下文模块：可组合、可重用的上下文，可以组装成复杂的知识依赖图
- Flash：按需将任何模块的完整依赖关系图按依赖顺序加载到上下文窗口中，将通用代理转变为 SME
- 问题：创建和管理整个组织的工作
- 协作：与整个团队合作，以便您可以共享背景和工作

plugin_asdk_app_6a5a92a75f0c8191bd481042.name: Genesys
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a92a75f0c8191bd481042.description: 您在 AI 应用程序中的记忆力
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a92a75f0c8191bd481042.productIntro: Genesys 为您的 AI 提供因果记忆图 - 不是记忆事实的列表，而是一个活生生的网络，其中每个记忆都是一个节点，每个关系都是类型化的因果边，并且每次检索都可以解释。询问为什么某个记忆会出现，Genesys 会显示其相关性分数、因果连接性和重新激活历史记录。追踪记忆如何连接并遵循从决定到结果的完整因果链。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a92a75f0c8191bd481042.productIntroEn: Genesys gives your AI a causal memory graph — not a list of remembered facts, but a living network where every memory is a node, every relationship is a typed causal edge, and every retrieval can be explained. Ask why a memory surfaced and Genesys shows its relevance score, causal connectivity, and reactivation history.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a92a75f0c8191bd481042.longDescription:
Genesys gives your AI a causal memory graph — not a list of remembered facts, but a living network where every memory is a node, every relationship is a typed causal edge, and every retrieval can be explained. Ask why a memory surfaced and Genesys shows its relevance score, causal connectivity, and reactivation history. Trace how memories connect and follow full causal chains from decision to consequence.

Your memory graph is yours: it lives outside any single AI vendor, works identically with ChatGPT, Claude, and any MCP-compatible model, and travels with you when you switch. You control it directly — pin what matters permanently, inspect graph health at any time, and delete anything, anytime, with hard erasure.

Built on neuroscience-inspired scoring (relevance × causal connectivity × reactivation), Genesys forgets safely: only memories that are irrelevant, causally orphaned, and unpinned are ever pruned.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a92a75f0c8191bd481042.longDescriptionZh:
Genesys 为您的 AI 提供因果记忆图 - 不是记忆事实的列表，而是一个活生生的网络，其中每个记忆都是一个节点，每个关系都是类型化的因果边，并且每次检索都可以解释。询问为什么某个记忆会出现，Genesys 会显示其相关性分数、因果连接性和重新激活历史记录。追踪记忆如何连接并遵循从决定到结果的完整因果链。

您的内存图是您的：它位于任何单个 AI 供应商之外，与 ChatGPT、Claude 和任何 MCP 兼容模型的工作方式相同，并且在您切换时与您同行。您可以直接控制它 - 永久固定重要的内容，随时检查图表运行状况，并通过硬擦除随时删除任何内容。

Genesys 建立在受神经科学启发的评分（相关性 × 因果连接性 × 重新激活）的基础上，可以安全地忘记：只有不相关、因果孤儿和未固定的记忆才会被修剪。

plugin_asdk_app_6a693b82b1e081919e6433b6.name: Arkon Vault
plugin_asdk_app_6a693b82b1e081919e6433b6.description: 让 AI 工作持续进行
plugin_asdk_app_6a693b82b1e081919e6433b6.productIntro: 通过一个私有连续性层，让项目在 ChatGPT、Codex、Claude 和其他 AI 工具之间移动。 Arkon Vault 找到正确的项目环境，在工作开始前运行预检，记录决策并创建结构化交接，以便每个人工智能都可以从相同的愿景和下一步继续。使用它来搜索共享项目内存，防止并行分叉，检查点进度，并为下一个会话留下明确的收尾信息。工作空间是私密隔离的，连接使用范围内的 OAuth 访问，并且 Arkon Sync 可以选择捕获支持的本地会话。
plugin_asdk_app_6a693b82b1e081919e6433b6.productIntroEn: Keep projects moving across ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, and other AI tools with one private continuity layer. Arkon Vault finds the right project context, runs a preflight before work starts, records decisions, and creates structured handoffs so every AI can continue from the same vision and next step.
plugin_asdk_app_6a693b82b1e081919e6433b6.longDescription: Keep projects moving across ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, and other AI tools with one private continuity layer. Arkon Vault finds the right project context, runs a preflight before work starts, records decisions, and creates structured handoffs so every AI can continue from the same vision and next step. Use it to search shared project memory, prevent parallel forks, checkpoint progress, and leave a clear closeout for the next session. Workspaces are privately isolated, connections use scoped OAuth access, and Arkon Sync can optionally capture supported local sessions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a693b82b1e081919e6433b6.longDescriptionZh: 通过一个私有连续性层，让项目在 ChatGPT、Codex、Claude 和其他 AI 工具之间移动。 Arkon Vault 找到正确的项目环境，在工作开始前运行预检，记录决策并创建结构化交接，以便每个人工智能都可以从相同的愿景和下一步继续。使用它来搜索共享项目内存，防止并行分叉，检查点进度，并为下一个会话留下明确的收尾信息。工作空间是私密隔离的，连接使用范围内的 OAuth 访问，并且 Arkon Sync 可以选择捕获支持的本地会话。
defaultPrompts: Before I start this task, preflight it and tell me the single next action.

plugin_asdk_app_6a863239273081919a3bc45d.name: Simply-Useful
plugin_asdk_app_6a863239273081919a3bc45d.originalDescription: Manage your tasks and your day
plugin_asdk_app_6a863239273081919a3bc45d.productIntro: 从 ChatGPT 访问和管理您的 Simply-Useful 帐户。用简单的语言安排你的一天：审查你的议程和优先事项，赶上逾期的工作，看看其他人分配给你什么——所有这些都在一个请求中。根据您的想法创建和安排任务，将它们分组到项目中，添加清单和标签，并将约会直接发送到您的 Google 日历。您还可以将任务交给您的联系人并跟进评论；任何影响他人的事情都需要先得到您的确认。每项更改都会立即与简单有用的移动和网络应用程序同步。
plugin_asdk_app_6a863239273081919a3bc45d.productIntroEn: Access and manage your Simply-Useful account from ChatGPT. Organize your day in plain language: review your agenda and priorities, catch up on overdue work, and see what others have assigned to you — all in one ask. Create and schedule tasks as you think of them, group them into projects, add checklists and tags, and send appointments straight to your Google Calendar.
plugin_asdk_app_6a863239273081919a3bc45d.longDescription: Access and manage your Simply-Useful account from ChatGPT. Organize your day in plain language: review your agenda and priorities, catch up on overdue work, and see what others have assigned to you — all in one ask. Create and schedule tasks as you think of them, group them into projects, add checklists and tags, and send appointments straight to your Google Calendar. You can also hand tasks to your contacts and follow up with comments; anything that affects another person asks for your confirmation first. Every change syncs instantly with the Simply-Useful mobile and web apps.

plugin_asdk_app_6a86fd41b29c8191baa0d0e5.name: ArtifactBridge
plugin_asdk_app_6a86fd41b29c8191baa0d0e5.description: 搜索文档，提出更改建议
plugin_asdk_app_6a86fd41b29c8191baa0d0e5.productIntro: ArtifactBridge 将 ChatGPT 连接到您团队的文档工作区。搜索和阅读存储的文档、创建托管文档、讨论更改并提交建议以供审核。受管文件的变更需要经过授权的人工审核；业主无需审核时可直接更新工作文件。您还可以组织文档、协调代理室中的工作以及通过共享链接发布版本。根据您的工作区配置，评论可能会镜像到 Google Docs 或 Notion，提案可能会通知 Slack，活动事件可能会传递到外部 Webhook。访问和审查权限仍然适用。
plugin_asdk_app_6a86fd41b29c8191baa0d0e5.productIntroEn: ArtifactBridge connects ChatGPT to your team's document workspace. Search and read stored documents, create managed documents, discuss changes, and submit proposals for review. Governed document changes require an authorized human review; owners can update working documents directly when review is not required.
plugin_asdk_app_6a86fd41b29c8191baa0d0e5.longDescription: ArtifactBridge connects ChatGPT to your team's document workspace. Search and read stored documents, create managed documents, discuss changes, and submit proposals for review. Governed document changes require an authorized human review; owners can update working documents directly when review is not required. You can also organize documents, coordinate work in Agent Rooms, and publish a version through a share link. Depending on your workspace configuration, comments may be mirrored to Google Docs or Notion, proposals may notify Slack, and activity events may be delivered to external webhooks. Access and review permissions still apply. Requires an ArtifactBridge account.
plugin_asdk_app_6a86fd41b29c8191baa0d0e5.longDescriptionZh: ArtifactBridge 将 ChatGPT 连接到您团队的文档工作区。搜索和阅读存储的文档、创建托管文档、讨论更改并提交建议以供审核。受管文件的变更需要经过授权的人工审核；业主无需审核时可直接更新工作文件。您还可以组织文档、协调代理室中的工作以及通过共享链接发布版本。根据您的工作区配置，评论可能会镜像到 Google Docs 或 Notion，提案可能会通知 Slack，活动事件可能会传递到外部 Webhook。访问和审查权限仍然适用。需要 ArtifactBridge 帐户。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3965fea3048191b9045df1.name: Reflect
plugin_asdk_app_6a3965fea3048191b9045df1.description: 从您的人力资源数据中获取答案
plugin_asdk_app_6a3965fea3048191b9045df1.originalDescription: Get answers from your HR data
plugin_asdk_app_6a3965fea3048191b9045df1.productIntro: Reflect 就在 ChatGPT 内将您的人力资源和劳动力数据转化为答案。用简单的语言提问，Reflect 直接查询您的人员分析：员工人数、营业额、招聘、薪酬等，无需导出或电子表格。它还显示法律和合规报告背后的数据（BDESE、Egapro 指数、欧盟薪酬透明度）。它探索您可以查看的数据目录，运行结构化分析查询，并在需要时处理高级 SQL。只读且安全的设计：每个请求都会尊重您现有的 Reflect 权限。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3965fea3048191b9045df1.productIntroEn: Reflect turns your HR and workforce data into answers, right inside ChatGPT. Ask in plain language and Reflect queries your people analytics directly: headcount, turnover, recruitment, compensation and more, with no export or spreadsheet. It also surfaces the figures behind your legal and compliance reports (BDESE, Egapro index, EU pay transparency).
plugin_asdk_app_6a3965fea3048191b9045df1.longDescription: Reflect turns your HR and workforce data into answers, right inside ChatGPT. Ask in plain language and Reflect queries your people analytics directly: headcount, turnover, recruitment, compensation and more, with no export or spreadsheet. It also surfaces the figures behind your legal and compliance reports (BDESE, Egapro index, EU pay transparency). It explores the data catalog you're allowed to see, runs structured analytics queries, and handles advanced SQL when needed. Read-only and secure by design: every request respects your existing Reflect permissions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3965fea3048191b9045df1.longDescriptionZh: Reflect 就在 ChatGPT 内将您的人力资源和劳动力数据转化为答案。用简单的语言提问，Reflect 直接查询您的人员分析：员工人数、营业额、招聘、薪酬等，无需导出或电子表格。它还显示法律和合规报告背后的数据（BDESE、Egapro 指数、欧盟薪酬透明度）。它探索您可以查看的数据目录，运行结构化分析查询，并在需要时处理高级 SQL。只读且安全的设计：每个请求都会尊重您现有的 Reflect 权限。

plugin_asdk_app_6a761f3e12008191814f6de5.productIntro: DealKeep 是购买终身软件优惠的用户的跟踪器。连接它并用简单的语言询问您已经拥有的堆栈：“我有什么可用于电子邮件营销？”，“在购买之前我是否已经拥有类似的东西？”，“哪些退款窗口即将关闭？”或“我的工具创始人是否会保持沉默？”五个只读工具涵盖了它——搜索您的工具，检查购买的重复项，提取一个许可证的完整详细信息，列出您的交易，并显示创始人风险信号。
plugin_asdk_app_6a761f3e12008191814f6de5.productIntroEn: DealKeep is the tracker for people who buy lifetime software deals. Connect it and ask, in plain language, about the stack you already own: "What do I have for email marketing?", "Do I already own something like this before I buy it?", "Which refund windows are about to close?", or "Are any of my tools' founders going quiet?" Five read-only tools cover it — search your tools, check a pur…
plugin_asdk_app_6a761f3e12008191814f6de5.longDescription: DealKeep is the tracker for people who buy lifetime software deals. Connect it and ask, in plain language, about the stack you already own: "What do I have for email marketing?", "Do I already own something like this before I buy it?", "Which refund windows are about to close?", or "Are any of my tools' founders going quiet?" Five read-only tools cover it — search your tools, check a purchase for duplicates, pull one license's full detail, list your deals, and surface founder-risk signals. The connector is strictly read-only: it can look across your library but can never buy, redeem, edit, or delete anything, and it only ever sees your own data. Connect with your existing DealKeep account (dealkeep.io).
plugin_asdk_app_6a761f3e12008191814f6de5.longDescriptionZh: DealKeep 是购买终身软件优惠的用户的跟踪器。连接它并用简单的语言询问您已经拥有的堆栈：“我有什么可用于电子邮件营销？”，“在购买之前我是否已经拥有类似的东西？”，“哪些退款窗口即将关闭？”或“我的工具创始人是否会保持沉默？”五个只读工具涵盖了它——搜索您的工具，检查购买的重复项，提取一个许可证的完整详细信息，列出您的交易，并显示创始人风险信号。连接器是严格只读的：它可以查看您的图书馆，但永远不能购买、兑换、编辑或删除任何内容，并且它只能看到您自己的数据。连接您现有的 DealKeep 帐户 (dealkeep.io)。

plugin_asdk_app_6a98a1a5db00819184610cec.productIntroEn: Fixture and Finish is a selections and procurement platform built for custom home builders, interior designers, and design-build firms. This plugin brings your project data into ChatGPT so you can ask questions in plain language from anywhere — the office, the job site, or your phone. Ask ChatGPT to:
plugin_asdk_app_6a98a1a5db00819184610cec.longDescription:
Fixture and Finish is a selections and procurement platform built for custom home builders, interior designers, and design-build firms. This plugin brings your project data into ChatGPT so you can ask questions in plain language from anywhere — the office, the job site, or your phone.
Ask ChatGPT to:

Look up any item on a project — fixture specs, finishes, model numbers, dimensions, and installation details
Check procurement status across projects: what’s been ordered, what’s shipped, what needs a decision
Search your selection library of products you’ve already vetted and used
Import a product from any vendor page into your library and attach it to an item
Create follow-up tasks and reminders on a project

Instead of digging through emails, spreadsheets, and spec sheets, ask: “What’s the fan in the Leesburg primary bedroom, and how does the remote work?” or “What’s still unordered for the kitchen at Wilson Lane?” and get an answer grounded in your actual project data.
Fixture and Finish keeps selections, specs, vendors, and purchase status structured in one place, so client-facing docs, field schedules, and answers like these work out of the box. Requires a Fixture and Finish account; trials are free with no credit card required.
plugin_asdk_app_6a98a1a5db00819184610cec.longDescriptionZh:
Fixture and Finish 是一个为定制住宅建筑商、室内设计师和设计建造公司打造的选择和采购平台。该插件将您的项目数据导入 ChatGPT，以便您可以在任何地方（办公室、工作现场或手机）以简单语言提出问题。
要求 ChatGPT ：

查找项目中的任何项目 - 灯具规格、饰面、型号、尺寸和安装详细信息
检查跨项目的采购状态：已订购什么、已发货什么、需要做出决定
搜索您已审查和使用过的产品选择库
将产品从任何供应商页面导入到您的库中并将其附加到项目
创建项目的后续任务和提醒

不要翻阅电子邮件、电子表格和规格表，而是问：“利斯堡主卧室的风扇是什么？远程如何工作？”或者“威尔逊巷的厨房还有什么未订购的吗？”并根据您的实际项目数据获得答案。
Fixture and Finish 将选择、规格、供应商和购买状态保存在一个地方，因此面向客户的文档、现场时间表和答案等可以开箱即用。需要 Fixture 和 Finish 帐户；免费试用，无需信用卡。
defaultPrompts: Give me a list of all my projects
What faucet did we approve for the powder room at 6801 Granby Street?

plugin_asdk_app_6a330848fe108191856054fc.description: 询问有关 Tenzo 数据的问题
plugin_asdk_app_6a330848fe108191856054fc.productIntro: 向你的招聘数据询问任何事情。 Tenzo AI MCP 服务器将您的 AI 助手连接到您的招聘渠道，因此您无需点击屏幕，只需询问：谁申请了该职位、每个候选人的立场、他们在 AI 筛选电话中的表现以及本周发生了什么变化。
plugin_asdk_app_6a330848fe108191856054fc.productIntroEn: Ask your recruiting data anything. The Tenzo AI MCP server connects your AI assistant to your hiring pipeline, so instead of clicking through screens you can just ask: who applied for this role, where each candidate stands, how they did on their AI screening call, and what's changed this week.
plugin_asdk_app_6a330848fe108191856054fc.longDescription:
Ask your recruiting data anything. The Tenzo AI MCP server connects your AI assistant to your hiring pipeline, so instead of clicking through screens you can just ask: who applied for this role, where each candidate stands, how they did on their AI screening call, and what's changed this week.

Pull up a candidate and follow them end to end - their applications and stages, resume, SMS and email history, and the full screening-call transcript, grade, and summary. Check how a job is configured, review meeting notes, and surface hiring analytics, all in plain language.

Access is read-only and OAuth-authenticated, so the assistant can read your data but never change it, and everything stays scoped to your organization.
plugin_asdk_app_6a330848fe108191856054fc.longDescriptionZh:
向你的招聘数据询问任何事情。 Tenzo AI MCP 服务器将您的 AI 助手连接到您的招聘渠道，因此您无需点击屏幕，只需询问：谁申请了该职位、每个候选人的立场、他们在 AI 筛选电话中的表现以及本周发生了什么变化。

找到一名候选人并从头到尾跟踪他们——他们的申请和阶段、简历、短信和电子邮件历史记录，以及完整的筛选电话记录、成绩和摘要。检查工作的配置方式、查看会议记录和表面招聘分析，所有这些都以简单的语言进行。

访问权限是只读的并且经过 OAuth 身份验证，因此助理可以读取您的数据但永远不会更改它，并且所有内容都仅限于您的组织范围。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa28dd99818819199cd8433.name: xpost
plugin_asdk_app_6aa28dd99818819199cd8433.productIntro: 将对话变成发布的社交帖子。
plugin_asdk_app_6aa28dd99818819199cd8433.productIntroEn: Turn a conversation into published social posts.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa28dd99818819199cd8433.longDescription:
Turn a conversation into published social posts.

Tell xpost what you want to post, where and when. It creates the post for each social network and sends it to your approval queue — nothing is published until you approve it.

Publish to X, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky and Pinterest. Brand guardrails check your content before it’s queued, and every published post comes with a receipt linking directly to the live version.

You can also ask how your posts performed, what worked best and when your audience is most active.

Connect your xpost account and start asking. Your first post is free.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa28dd99818819199cd8433.longDescriptionZh:
将对话变成发布的社交帖子。

告诉 xpost 您想发布什么内容、发布地点和时间。它为每个社交网络创建帖子并将其发送到您的批准队列 - 在您批准之前不会发布任何内容。

发布到 X、Instagram、LinkedIn、TikTok、YouTube、Facebook、Threads、Bluesky 和 ​​Pinterest。品牌护栏会在您的内容排队之前对其进行检查，并且每个发布的帖子都附有直接链接到实时版本的收据。

您还可以询问您的帖子表现如何、什么效果最好以及您的受众何时最活跃。

连接您的 xpost 帐户并开始询问。您的第一篇文章是免费的。
defaultPrompts: Write a post about our new launch and publish it to X and LinkedIn tomorrow morning.
Which of my posts performed best last month, and why?
Did yesterday's post publish everywhere?
defaultPromptsZh: 写一篇关于我们新产品发布的文章，并于明天早上将其发布到 X 和 LinkedIn。
我的哪些帖子上个月表现最好，为什么？
昨天的帖子到处都发布了吗？

plugin_asdk_app_6a8bf1514eb8819189449527.description: 私密处理 PDF 文件
plugin_asdk_app_6a8bf1514eb8819189449527.productIntro: 使用隐私优先的工作流程合并、压缩、转换和重命名 PDF 和图像。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8bf1514eb8819189449527.productIntroEn: Merge, compress, convert, and rename PDFs and images with a privacy-first workflow.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8bf1514eb8819189449527.longDescription:
Merge, compress, convert, and rename PDFs and images with a privacy-first workflow. 

Files are processed locally in your browser, and AILabTools does not store your file contents. When needed, the finished file can be sent back to ChatGPT so you can continue working with it in the conversation. 

Quickly combine PDFs, reduce file size, turn images into PDFs, and prepare files in the format you need.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8bf1514eb8819189449527.longDescriptionZh:
使用隐私优先的工作流程合并、压缩、转换和重命名 PDF 和图像。 

文件在您的浏览器中本地处理，AILabTools 不会存储您的文件内容。需要时，可以将完成的文件发送回 ChatGPT，以便您可以在对话中继续使用它。 

快速合并 PDF、减小文件大小、将图像转换为 PDF，并以您需要的格式准备文件。
defaultPrompts: Merge these PDFs, compress the result, and rename it.
Turn these images into a single compressed PDF.
Privately merge and compress these PDFs, then rename the result.
defaultPromptsZh: 合并这些 PDF、压缩结果并重命名。

plugin_asdk_app_6a912ab4b59c819184fa4ed6.name: Letsfind
plugin_asdk_app_6a912ab4b59c819184fa4ed6.description: 创建民意调查并查找日期
plugin_asdk_app_6a912ab4b59c819184fa4ed6.productIntro: Letsfind 根据聊天中的描述创建群组投票。说出您想要提议的日期，或者人们应该选择哪些选项，您就会收到一个可供分享的链接。
plugin_asdk_app_6a912ab4b59c819184fa4ed6.productIntroEn: Letsfind creates group polls from a description in the chat. Say which dates you want to propose, or which options people should choose between, and you get back a link to share.
plugin_asdk_app_6a912ab4b59c819184fa4ed6.longDescription:
Letsfind creates group polls from a description in the chat. Say which dates you want to propose, or which options people should choose between, and you get back a link to share.

There are two kinds of polls. A date poll proposes several days or time slots and asks everyone what works for them, which is the usual way to settle on a meeting, a dinner or a trip. An options poll asks a plain question with answers you define, for picking a restaurant, a name or a plan.

Every poll comes back with two links. The voting link is the one you send to the group; people open it in a browser and answer without creating an account or installing anything. The admin link is yours alone and the only way to edit the poll later, so it is worth keeping.

Once answers come in, you can ask here how the poll is doing instead of opening it yourself. You get the count for each option and the names of the people who picked it.
plugin_asdk_app_6a912ab4b59c819184fa4ed6.longDescriptionZh:
Letsfind 根据聊天中的描述创建群组投票。说出您想要提议的日期，或者人们应该选择哪些选项，您就会收到一个可供分享的链接。

有两种民意调查。日期民意调查会提议几天或几个时间段，并询问每个人什么对他们最合适，这是确定会议、晚餐或旅行的通常方式。选项民意调查会提出一个简单的问题，并提供您定义的答案，用于选择餐厅、名称或计划。

每个民意调查都会返回两个链接。投票链接是您发送到群组的链接；人们在浏览器中打开它并回答，无需创建帐户或安装任何东西。管理链接仅供您个人使用，也是稍后编辑投票的唯一方法，因此值得保留。

一旦得到答案，您可以在此处询问民意调查的进展情况，而无需自己打开。您可以获得每个选项的计数以及选择该选项的人员的姓名。
defaultPrompts: Find a date for our team dinner: Thursday, Friday or Saturday next week at 7pm.
Make a poll for where we eat on Friday, with Pizza, Sushi and Burgers as the options.
Check who has answered my team dinner poll so far.
defaultPromptsZh: 确定我们团队晚餐的日期：下周四、周五或周六晚上 7 点。
对我们周五在哪里吃饭进行投票，选择披萨、寿司和汉堡。
检查到目前为止谁回答了我的团队晚餐民意调查。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5a641cfd6c81918d82e674.description: 跟踪您的 bryny 操作
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a641cfd6c81918d82e674.productIntro: bryny MCP 服务器将您的 AI 助手连接到突尼斯 bryny 履行和物流平台上您自己的运营数据。将实体商品存储在布里尼仓库的商家可以用简单的语言询问他们的订单进展情况、哪些产品缺货、包裹在哪里以及他们的履行活动进展如何，而无需打开仪表板。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a641cfd6c81918d82e674.productIntroEn: bryny MCP Server connects your AI assistant to your own operational data on the bryny fulfilment and logistics platform in Tunisia. Merchants who store their physical goods in bryny warehouses can ask, in plain language, how their orders are progressing, which products are running out of stock, where a parcel is, and how their fulfilment activity is doing — without opening a dashboard.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a641cfd6c81918d82e674.longDescription:
bryny MCP Server connects your AI assistant to your own operational data on the bryny fulfilment and logistics platform in Tunisia. Merchants who store their physical goods in bryny warehouses can ask, in plain language, how their orders are progressing, which products are running out of stock, where a parcel is, and how their fulfilment activity is doing — without opening a dashboard.

Access is strictly scoped: you only ever see the data of the account you signed in with. A merchant sees their own orders, products, stock and deliveries; a customer sees their own orders and returns; an administrator sees platform-wide operations.

Key capabilities:
• Order operations: list, search, filter and analyse your own orders and their delivery statuses
• Inventory and stock: real-time stock levels, low-stock and out-of-stock alerts, stock movements
• Shop operations: your shop profile, product records and fulfilment activity summaries
• Logistics: parcel tracking, delivery progress and delivery failure analysis
• Support: your own support tickets and customer returns
• Platform health: service status and audit trail (administrators only)

No purchase, cart, checkout or payment exists in this app. Every transaction happens outside ChatGPT: end customers pay the delivery driver in cash when the parcel arrives, and bryny never collects card or bank details.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a641cfd6c81918d82e674.longDescriptionZh:
bryny MCP 服务器将您的 AI 助手连接到突尼斯 bryny 履行和物流平台上您自己的运营数据。将实体商品存储在布里尼仓库的商家可以用简单的语言询问他们的订单进展情况、哪些产品缺货、包裹在哪里以及他们的履行活动进展如何，而无需打开仪表板。

访问范围受到严格限制：您只能看到您登录帐户的数据。商家可以看到自己的订单、产品、库存和交货；客户看到自己的订单和退货；管理员可以看到整个平台的操作。

关键能力：
• 订单操作：列出、搜索、过滤和分析您自己的订单及其交付状态
• 库存和库存：实时库存水平、低库存和缺货警报、库存变动
• 商店运营：您的商店简介、产品记录和履行活动摘要
• 物流：包裹追踪、配送进度和配送失败分析
• 支持：您自己的支持票和客户退货
• 平台运行状况：服务状态和审计跟踪（仅限管理员）

此应用程序中不存在购买、购物车、结帐或付款。每笔交易都发生在 ChatGPT 之外：最终客户在包裹到达时以现金向送货司机付款，并且 Bryny 从不收集银行卡或银行详细信息。
defaultPrompts: Show me my store performance on bryny: recent orders, current stock levels, low-stock products, and my wallet balance.
List my pending bryny orders and check for any delivery issues or parcels stuck in transit.
Track my recent orders on bryny and tell me the delivery status of each package.
defaultPromptsZh: 显示我在 bryny 上的商店表现：最近的订单、当前库存水平、低库存产品和我的钱包余额。
列出我待处理的 Bryny 订单，并检查是否有任何交付问题或包裹在运输途中滞留。
跟踪我最近在 bryny 上的订单并告诉我每个包裹的递送状态。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8db5955114819183be4fea.name: Whalesync
plugin_asdk_app_6a8db5955114819183be4fea.description: 应用程序之间的双向同步
plugin_asdk_app_6a8db5955114819183be4fea.productIntro: Whalesync 可在您的团队已使用的工具（Airtable、Webflow、HubSpot、Salesforce、Notion、Postgres 等）之间保持数据同步，双向同步在每个应用程序中都具有原生的感觉。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8db5955114819183be4fea.productIntroEn: Whalesync keeps data in sync between the tools your team already uses — Airtable, Webflow, HubSpot, Salesforce, Notion, Postgres, and more — with two-way sync that feels native in every app.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8db5955114819183be4fea.longDescription:
Whalesync keeps data in sync between the tools your team already uses — Airtable, Webflow, HubSpot, Salesforce, Notion, Postgres, and more — with two-way sync that feels native in every app.

With this app connected, you can build and run syncs by describing them: create a sync between two apps, map tables and fields, validate the mapping, and turn the sync on. Once data is flowing, ask it to monitor things — check sync status, find out why a record isn’t syncing, review pending deletes, and retry failed work after you fix the cause.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8db5955114819183be4fea.longDescriptionZh:
Whalesync 可在您的团队已使用的工具（Airtable、Webflow、HubSpot、Salesforce、Notion、Postgres 等）之间保持数据同步，双向同步在每个应用程序中都具有原生的感觉。

连接此应用程序后，您可以通过描述同步来构建和运行同步：在两个应用程序、映射表和字段之间创建同步，验证映射，然后打开同步。数据流动后，要求它进行监控 - 检查同步状态，找出记录未同步的原因，检查待处理的删除，并在修复原因后重试失败的工作。
defaultPrompts: Are there any problems with my syncs?
Lets set up a new sync from Airtable to Webflow.
Pause my sync.
defaultPromptsZh: 我的同步有问题吗？
让我们设置从 Airtable 到 Webflow 的新同步。
暂停我的同步。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9fface7f348191ad40e90a.name: Pocket Bartender
plugin_asdk_app_6a9fface7f348191ad40e90a.description: 鸡尾酒配方和调酒应用程序
plugin_asdk_app_6a9fface7f348191ad40e90a.productIntro: Pocket Bartender 是一个参考库，包含 700 多种饮品配方——鸡尾酒、烈酒、潘趣酒、咖啡、冰沙和 86 种非酒精饮料，其中包括 113 种官方 IBA 经典饮品。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9fface7f348191ad40e90a.productIntroEn: Pocket Bartender is a reference library of 700+ drink recipes — cocktails, shots, punches, coffees, smoothies and 86 non-alcoholic options, including 113 official IBA classics.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9fface7f348191ad40e90a.longDescription:
Pocket Bartender is a reference library of 700+ drink recipes — cocktails, shots, punches, coffees, smoothies and 86 non-alcoholic options, including 113 official IBA classics.

Ask for any drink by name and get the full recipe: every ingredient with its measure, numbered method steps, preparation time, ABV, calories and food pairings.

Or list what you have at home — “gin, Campari, sweet vermouth, some limes” — and it works out which drinks you can make right now, and which ones you are a single ingredient away from, so your next purchase is the useful one.

Everything is available in 25 languages, with measures written the way a bartender would say them. Every recipe links back to the Pocket Bartender app for iOS and Android.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9fface7f348191ad40e90a.longDescriptionZh:
Pocket Bartender 是一个参考库，包含 700 多种饮品配方——鸡尾酒、烈酒、潘趣酒、咖啡、冰沙和 86 种非酒精饮料，其中包括 113 种官方 IBA 经典饮品。

询问任何饮料的名称并获得完整的配方：每种成分及其尺寸、编号的方法步骤、准备时间、酒精度、卡路里和食物搭配。

或者列出你家里有什么——“杜松子酒、金巴利酒、甜苦艾酒、一些酸橙”——它会计算出你现在可以制作哪些饮料，以及你不需要使用哪种饮料，这样你下一次购买的饮料就是有用的。

一切都以 25 种语言提供，并按照调酒师所说的方式书写。每个食谱都链接回适用于 iOS 和 Android 的 Pocket Bartender 应用程序。

plugin_asdk_app_6a95b4984de08191aa2aea2a.productIntro: 根据独立用户评论，Jibble 是评价最高的时间跟踪和考勤软件。通过无限用户的永久免费时间跟踪，团队可以跟踪时间、出勤、项目、休假等。
plugin_asdk_app_6a95b4984de08191aa2aea2a.productIntroEn: Jibble is the highest-rated time tracking and attendance software according to independent user reviews. With free-forever time tracking for unlimited users, teams can track hours, attendance, projects, time off, and more.
plugin_asdk_app_6a95b4984de08191aa2aea2a.longDescription:
Jibble is the highest-rated time tracking and attendance software according to independent user reviews. With free-forever time tracking for unlimited users, teams can track hours, attendance, projects, time off, and more.

Connect Jibble to ChatGPT and turn your workforce data into instant answers, insights, and actions. Ask how many hours your team worked, where time is being spent, who's working overtime, how attendance is trending, or how many hours have been logged to a project. ChatGPT can analyze your Jibble data, summarize findings, compare results, and surface useful patterns — without having to dig through reports.

You can also take action directly from the conversation: clock in or out, correct missed punches, manage time off, and generate reports.

Whether you're checking a single person's hours or looking for broader workforce trends, Jibble + ChatGPT gives you a faster way to ask questions, understand your data, and get things done.
plugin_asdk_app_6a95b4984de08191aa2aea2a.longDescriptionZh:
根据独立用户评论，Jibble 是评价最高的时间跟踪和考勤软件。通过无限用户的永久免费时间跟踪，团队可以跟踪时间、出勤、项目、休假等。

将 Jibble 连接到 ChatGPT，将您的劳动力数据转化为即时答案、见解和行动。询问您的团队工作了多少小时、时间花在哪里、谁加班、出勤趋势如何，或者项目已记录了多少小时。 ChatGPT 可以分析您的 Jibble 数据、总结发现、比较结果并显示有用的模式，而无需深入研究报告。

您还可以直接从对话中采取行动：上班或下班、纠正错过的打卡、管理休息时间以及生成报告。

无论您是要检查单个人的工作时间还是寻找更广泛的劳动力趋势，Jibble + ChatGPT 都可以让您更快地提出问题、了解数据并完成工作。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa42fc7bb8c8191a23a2979.productIntro: Softr 是一款人工智能应用程序构建器，可将您的数据转化为应用程序、门户和自动化。此连接器使 ChatGPT 可以直接访问您的 Softr 工作区，因此您可以在一次对话中将想法转变为可运行的、已发布的应用程序。
plugin_asdk_app_6aa42fc7bb8c8191a23a2979.productIntroEn: Softr is an AI app builder that turns your data into apps, portals, and automations. This connector gives ChatGPT direct access to your Softr workspace, so you can go from an idea to a working, published app in a single conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa42fc7bb8c8191a23a2979.longDescription:
Softr is an AI app builder that turns your data into apps, portals, and automations. This connector gives ChatGPT direct access to your Softr workspace, so you can go from an idea to a working, published app in a single conversation.

Databases: create tables and the fields to match your project, structure and import records, and browse data sources you have already connected.

Applications: generate an app on top of your data, add and arrange pages and blocks, configure sign-up and login, set user groups and page permissions, and manage app users. Extend any page with a custom code block that ChatGPT writes for you, with every version saved so you can roll back.

Workflows: build multi-step automations with triggers, actions, and branching logic, test each step against real data, and publish when it works.

ChatGPT can preview the result and, when you ask it to, publish live. Everything it makes appears in Softr Studio exactly like work done by hand, so you and your team keep editing in the visual builder afterward - nothing is locked into the chat.

Day to day, ChatGPT can also work with your data directly: search, filter, and aggregate records, and create or update them in bulk.

Every action runs with your own permissions, and you choose the access level per workspace when you connect: read-only, edit, or full access.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa42fc7bb8c8191a23a2979.longDescriptionZh:
Softr 是一款人工智能应用程序构建器，可将您的数据转化为应用程序、门户和自动化。此连接器使 ChatGPT 可以直接访问您的 Softr 工作区，因此您可以在一次对话中将想法转变为可运行的、已发布的应用程序。

数据库：创建表和字段以匹配您的项目、结构和导入记录，并浏览已连接的数据源。

应用程序：在数据之上生成应用程序、添加和排列页面和块、配置注册和登录、设置用户组和页面权限以及管理应用程序用户。使用 ChatGPT 为您编写的自定义代码块扩展任何页面，并保存每个版本以便您可以回滚。

工作流程：使用触发器、操作和分支逻辑构建多步骤自动化，根据真实数据测试每个步骤，并在其有效时发布。

ChatGPT 可以预览结果，并根据您的要求实时发布。它所做的一切都出现在 Softr Studio 中，就像手工完成的工作一样，因此您和您的团队随后可以在可视化构建器中进行编辑 - 聊天中没有任何内容被锁定。

日常工作中，ChatGPT 还可以直接处理您的数据：搜索、过滤和聚合记录，并批量创建或更新它们。

每个操作都以您自己的权限运行，并且您在连接时选择每个工作区的访问级别：只读、编辑或完全访问权限。

plugin_asdk_app_6a50c534586c81918ee27528.name: CherryDrop
plugin_asdk_app_6a50c534586c81918ee27528.productIntro: CherryDrop 是您的个人收件箱，其中包含您在使用 AI 时发现的所有内容。直接从对话中将注释、链接、代码片段和文件保存到您的私人 CherryDrop 帐户中，然后随时从网络应用程序或其他 AI 代理中搜索并重新访问它们。
plugin_asdk_app_6a50c534586c81918ee27528.productIntroEn: CherryDrop is your personal inbox for everything you find while working with AI. Save notes, links, code snippets, and files into your private CherryDrop account straight from the conversation, then search and revisit them any time from the web app or from another AI agent.
plugin_asdk_app_6a50c534586c81918ee27528.longDescription:
CherryDrop is your personal inbox for everything you find while working with AI. Save notes, links, code snippets, and files into your private CherryDrop account straight from the conversation, then search and revisit them any time from the web app or from another AI agent.

CherryDrop also lets agents share working context: store a named context with a summary and attached drops, then load it again in a different agent to continue exactly where you left off.

All tools operate exclusively on the signed-in user's own data. Access is authenticated via OAuth 2.1 (authorization code + PKCE) and enforced with row-level security, so no tool can read or write another user's data.
plugin_asdk_app_6a50c534586c81918ee27528.longDescriptionZh:
CherryDrop 是您的个人收件箱，其中包含您在使用 AI 时发现的所有内容。直接从对话中将注释、链接、代码片段和文件保存到您的私人 CherryDrop 帐户中，然后随时从网络应用程序或其他 AI 代理中搜索并重新访问它们。

CherryDrop 还允许代理共享工作上下文：存储带有摘要和附加 drop 的命名上下文，然后在不同的代理中再次加载它，以准确地从上次中断的位置继续。

所有工具仅对登录用户自己的数据进行操作。访问通过 OAuth 2.1（授权代码 + PKCE）进行身份验证，并通过行级安全性强制实施，因此没有工具可以读取或写入其他用户的数据。
