plugin_asdk_app_6a8ca8d6219081918006f391.description: 保持你的人工智能项目清晰
plugin_asdk_app_6a8ca8d6219081918006f391.productIntro: Giraffe 让您的 AI 项目在 ChatGPT 和其他兼容的 AI 助手中保持清晰和最新。从您使用的任何人工智能工具中保存和检索项目背景、决策、事实、注释、开放式问题和文档。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8ca8d6219081918006f391.productIntroEn: Giraffe keeps your AI projects clear and current across ChatGPT and other compatible AI assistants. Save and retrieve project context, decisions, facts, notes, open questions, and documents from whichever AI tool you are using.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8ca8d6219081918006f391.longDescription:
Giraffe keeps your AI projects clear and current across ChatGPT and other compatible AI assistants. Save and retrieve project context, decisions, facts, notes, open questions, and documents from whichever AI tool you are using.

When plans change, Giraffe helps preserve the latest agreed state, what changed, and which earlier information was replaced—so you can continue working without searching through old chats or rebuilding context.

Use Giraffe to organize Spaces and Projects, search your knowledge, and create or update Documents directly from your AI assistant. Giraffe is free to use.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8ca8d6219081918006f391.longDescriptionZh:
Giraffe 让您的 AI 项目在 ChatGPT 和其他兼容的 AI 助手中保持清晰和最新。从您使用的任何人工智能工具中保存和检索项目背景、决策、事实、注释、开放式问题和文档。

当计划发生变化时，Giraffe 会帮助保留最新商定的状态、更改的内容以及替换的早期信息，以便您可以继续工作，而无需搜索旧聊天或重建上下文。

使用 Giraffe 组织空间和项目，搜索您的知识，并直接从您的 AI 助手创建或更新文档。长颈鹿可以免费使用。

Save this conversation’s conclusions to the right project, reconcile them with existing information, and avoid duplicates.
defaultPromptsZh: 显示我在最近更新的项目中停止的位置，包括当前的决策和未解决的问题。

plugin_asdk_app_6a92e6e7ec10819189c404c0.longDescription: Transcriptor lets ChatGPT work with video the way it works with text. Paste a link from YouTube, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Vimeo, Facebook, Bilibili, VK, Dailymotion or Reddit and ask for a summary, a quote with its timestamp, the chapter list, the publisher and view counts, or the still frame at a given timecode. Eight read-only tools cover the workflow: cleaned plain-text transcripts with cursor pagination for long videos, raw SRT/VTT subtitles, the list of available caption languages, extended metadata, chapter markers, single frames at any timecode, batch transcripts for selected playlist items, and YouTube search. Four of them render interactive widgets in the chat: a search carousel, a searchable timed transcript, a metadata card, and a frame viewer. The service retrieves only public captions, metadata, thumbnails and single still frames; it never returns or redistributes video or audio files.
plugin_asdk_app_6a92e6e7ec10819189c404c0.longDescriptionZh: Transcriptor 让 ChatGPT 可以像处理文本一样处理视频。粘贴来自 YouTube、Twitter/X、Instagram、TikTok、Twitch、Vimeo、Facebook、Bilibili、VK、Dailymotion 或 Reddit 的链接，并要求提供摘要、带有时间戳的引用、章节列表、出版商和观看次数或给定时间码的静止帧。八个只读工具涵盖了整个工作流程：带有光标分页的长视频清理后的纯文本记录、原始 SRT/VTT 字幕、可用字幕语言列表、扩展元数据、章节标记、任何时间码的单帧、选定播放列表项目的批量记录以及 YouTube 搜索。其中四个在聊天中呈现交互式小部件：搜索轮播、可搜索的定时记录、元数据卡和帧查看器。该服务仅检索公共字幕、元数据、缩略图和单个静止帧；它永远不会返回或重新分发视频或音频文件。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4b75d7d9e08191b5d641c2.productIntro: 获取法国土地登记文件的即时定价：抵押状态报告 (état Hypothécaire)、财产契约副本、公寓法规 (RDC) 和描述性分割声明 (EDD)。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4b75d7d9e08191b5d641c2.productIntroEn: Get instant pricing for French land-registry documents: mortgage status reports (état hypothécaire), property deed copies, condominium regulations (RDC) and descriptive division statements (EDD).
plugin_asdk_app_6a4b75d7d9e08191b5d641c2.longDescription:
Get instant pricing for French land-registry documents: mortgage status reports (état hypothécaire), property deed copies, condominium regulations (RDC) and descriptive division statements (EDD).

The app quotes the public price of each service, simulates prices across subscription tiers, and guides you to the right service for your profession — lawyer, bank, credit broker, property manager, real-estate agent or notary. It then provides a direct link to the order page.

Ideal for preparing a real-estate file, verifying a property title or budgeting a mortgage search, without leaving the conversation. French land registry coverage since 1956.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4b75d7d9e08191b5d641c2.longDescriptionZh:
获取法国土地登记文件的即时定价：抵押状态报告 (état Hypothécaire)、财产契约副本、公寓法规 (RDC) 和描述性分割声明 (EDD)。

该应用程序引用每项服务的公开价格，模拟各个订阅级别的价格，并指导您找到适合您职业的服务——律师、银行、信贷经纪人、物业经理、房地产经纪人或公证人。然后它会提供指向订单页面的直接链接。

非常适合在不离开对话的情况下准备房地产文件、验证房产所有权或制定抵押贷款搜索预算。法国土地登记范围自 1956 年起。

plugin_asdk_app_6957a9916c0c8191a1e69ca3.productIntro: Neurnav 通过 ChatGPT 内的 Git 风格工作流程帮助您管理长篇文档（例如研究笔记和报告）。打开报告，准确查看您正在处理的分支和修订版本，并与清晰的差异、分阶段编辑和审查就绪的集成请求进行协作。每个更改都可以携带来源元数据（人工智能建议与人工批准），以便您可以放心地发布和共享。您可以共享最新快照的公共链接，而不会丢失可追溯性或上下文。
plugin_asdk_app_6957a9916c0c8191a1e69ca3.productIntroEn: Neurnav helps you manage long-form documents—like research notes and reports—with Git-style workflows inside ChatGPT. Open a report, see exactly which branch and revision you’re working on, and collaborate with clear diffs, staged edits, and review-ready integration requests. Every change can carry provenance metadata (AI suggestion vs.
plugin_asdk_app_6957a9916c0c8191a1e69ca3.longDescription: Neurnav helps you manage long-form documents—like research notes and reports—with Git-style workflows inside ChatGPT. Open a report, see exactly which branch and revision you’re working on, and collaborate with clear diffs, staged edits, and review-ready integration requests. plugin_asdk_app_6a94ee278a70819185e41702.productIntro: Page2AI 将单个公共网页（仅您明确提供的 URL）转换为 LLM 上下文的干净 Markdown：提取主要内容、删除样板、保留标题、代码块、表格和链接、带有源 URL 和标题的可选 YAML frontmatter。按需且只读：无爬行、无账户、应用程序不存储数据。它不会绕过付费墙、登录、速率限制或任何网站的访问控制；私有网络和云元数据 URL 被拒绝；响应的上限为 10 MB，并具有强制超时和每个 IP 的速率限制。
plugin_asdk_app_6a94ee278a70819185e41702.productIntroEn: Page2AI converts a single public web page — only the URL you explicitly provide — into clean Markdown for LLM context: main content extracted, boilerplate dropped, headings, code blocks, tables and links preserved, optional YAML frontmatter with the source URL and title. On-demand and read-only: no crawling, no accounts, no data stored by the application.
plugin_asdk_app_6a94ee278a70819185e41702.longDescription: Page2AI converts a single public web page — only the URL you explicitly provide — into clean Markdown for LLM context: main content extracted, boilerplate dropped, headings, code blocks, tables and links preserved, optional YAML frontmatter with the source URL and title. On-demand and read-only: no crawling, no accounts, no data stored by the application. It does not bypass paywalls, logins, rate limits or any site's access controls; private-network and cloud-metadata URLs are refused; responses are capped at 10 MB with enforced timeouts and per-IP rate limits. The identical MIT-licensed engine is available as a local MCP server (npx -y page2ai-mcp) for fully private workflows.

plugin_asdk_app_6a8803ef01748191be0b2d93.productIntroEn: May or Shall isa workspace for legal matters. You read the case bundle, and every passage worth keeping becomes a card that permanently carries its exact quote and its source: the document, the page, the paragraph.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8803ef01748191be0b2d93.longDescription:
May or Shall isa workspace for legal matters. You read the case bundle,
and every passage worth keeping becomes a card that permanently carries its
exact quote and its source: the document, the page, the paragraph.

Connected to ChatGPT, it lets you draft from that material rather than from
memory. Search everything you have saved across your matters, pull the
chronology in date order, and ask which paragraphs of a plaint still lack a
specific denial, which under Order VIII Rule 5 CPC risk being treated as
admitted. You can also save a passage into a matter from inside a
conversation, and it keeps its citation.

What ChatGPT receives has already been chosen and categorised by you, so the
material it works from is grounded and filtered rather than a pile of PDFs.

Built by a practising litigator. Free to use, and open source under the AGPL.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8803ef01748191be0b2d93.longDescriptionZh:
May 或Shall 是处理法律事务的工作空间。您阅读了案例包，
每一段值得保留的段落都会成为一张永久承载其意义的卡片
准确引用及其来源：文档、页面、段落。

连接到 ChatGPT，它可以让您从该材料而不是从
记忆。搜索您在事务中保存的所有内容，然后拉出
按日期顺序排列，并询问申诉的哪些段落仍然缺乏
具体拒绝，根据命令 VIII 第 5 条 CPC 的规定，这种拒绝可能会被视为
承认了。您还可以从问题内部保存一段段落
对话，并保留其引用。

ChatGPT 收到的内容已由您选择和分类，因此
它的工作材料是经过基础和过滤的，而不是一堆 PDF。

由执业诉讼律师建造。免费使用，并在 AGPL 下开源。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5cb08939488191b11c6c56.name: PostFast
plugin_asdk_app_6a5cb08939488191b11c6c56.productIntro: PostFast 是一款社交媒体管理工具。该插件连接您现有的 PostFast 工作区，以便您可以在对话中运行发布工作流程，而无需打开仪表板。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5cb08939488191b11c6c56.productIntroEn: PostFast is a social media management tool. This plugin connects your existing PostFast workspace so you can run your posting workflow in conversation instead of opening the dashboard.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5cb08939488191b11c6c56.longDescription:
PostFast is a social media management tool. This plugin connects your existing PostFast workspace so you can run your posting workflow in conversation instead of opening the dashboard.

Plan and schedule
Draft a post, choose which of your connected accounts it goes to, attach an image or video, and place it on the calendar for a specific time. Save it as a draft, route it for approval, or approve one that is already waiting. Review what is queued and remove a scheduled post. Supported accounts: X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, Threads, YouTube, Bluesky, Telegram, and Google Business Profile.

Check how posts did
Look up the performance of a published post, or how an account's follower count has moved day by day. Analytics cover Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest Business accounts, and LinkedIn company pages.

Add an account
Generate a link that opens PostFast's account connection flow when you want to add a new social profile.

How it works
PostFast connects to each social network under its own app registrations and platform credentials, and stores your drafts, scheduled posts, media and comment history in your own PostFast workspace. This plugin is a first-party interface to that product, not a generic pass-through layer. Some tools do call a platform live, for example when publishing a post, and each of those is labelled as such.

You sign in with your existing PostFast account over OAuth. Viewing accounts, writing posts, and reading analytics are separate permissions that you grant individually, and you can disconnect at any time. The connector also exposes comment management tools used by other clients, which are not part of the workflows described here.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5cb08939488191b11c6c56.longDescriptionZh:
PostFast 是一款社交媒体管理工具。该插件连接您现有的 PostFast 工作区，以便您可以在对话中运行发布工作流程，而无需打开仪表板。

计划和时间表
起草帖子，选择将其发送到哪个关联帐户，附加图像或视频，然后将其放置在日历上的特定时间。将其保存为草稿，将其发送以供批准，或批准已在等待的草稿。查看排队的内容并删除预定的帖子。支持的帐户：X、LinkedIn、Instagram、Facebook、TikTok、Pinterest、Threads、YouTube、Bluesky、Telegram 和 Google Business Profile。

检查帖子效果如何
查看已发布帖子的表现，或者帐户的关注者数量每天的变化情况。分析涵盖 Instagram、Facebook、Threads、TikTok、YouTube、Pinterest Business 帐户和 LinkedIn 公司页面。

添加帐户
当您想要添加新的社交资料时，生成一个打开 PostFast 帐户连接流程的链接。

它是如何运作的
PostFast 通过自己的应用程序注册和平台凭证连接到每个社交网络，并将您的草稿、预定帖子、媒体和评论历史记录存储在您自己的 PostFast 工作区中。该插件是该产品的第一方接口，而不是通用传递层。有些工具确实会实时调用平台，例如在发布帖子时，并且每个工具都会如此标记。

您可以通过 OAuth 使用现有的 PostFast 帐户登录。查看帐户、撰写帖子和阅读分析是您单独授予的单独权限，并且您可以随时断开连接。连接器还公开其他客户端使用的评论管理工具，这些工具不属于此处描述的工作流程的一部分。

Plugin_b0672f102c2081919b893649fdcfeeaa.description: 跨互联来源查找决策、文档和项目背景
Plugin_b0672f102c2081919b893649fdcfeeaa.originalDescription: Find decisions, documents, and project context across connected sources
Plugin_b0672f102c2081919b893649fdcfeeaa.productIntro: 公司知识可帮助您在公司的互联来源中查找决策、文档、所有者和最近的项目更新。提出问题并获得带有引文的简洁答案，以便您可以查看信息的来源。
Plugin_b0672f102c2081919b893649fdcfeeaa.productIntroEn: Company Knowledge helps you find decisions, documents, owners, and recent project updates across your company's connected sources. Ask a question and get a concise answer with citations so you can review where the information came from.
Plugin_b0672f102c2081919b893649fdcfeeaa.longDescription:
Company Knowledge helps you find decisions, documents, owners, and recent project updates across your company's connected sources. Ask a question and get a concise answer with citations so you can review where the information came from.

Use it to catch up on a project, find the right document, understand why a decision was made, or identify who owns the next step. Depending on your workspace setup, sources can include Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Drive, SharePoint, Notion, GitHub, Linear, email, calendars, and meeting notes.
Plugin_b0672f102c2081919b893649fdcfeeaa.longDescriptionZh:
公司知识可帮助您在公司的互联来源中查找决策、文档、所有者和最近的项目更新。提出问题并获得带有引文的简洁答案，以便您可以查看信息的来源。

使用它来跟进项目、找到正确的文档、了解做出决定的原因或确定下一步的负责人。根据您的工作区设置，来源可以包括 Slack、Microsoft Teams、Google Drive、SharePoint、Notion、GitHub、Linear、电子邮件、日历和会议记录。
defaultPrompts: Summarize the latest updates on this project across messages, docs, and code
Find the canonical document, recent decisions, and owners for this topic
What feedback has this feature received, and what should the team do next?
defaultPromptsZh: 通过消息、文档和代码总结该项目的最新更新
查找该主题的规范文档、最近的决策和所有者
